title.en: BP appoints new chair after contentious ousting of Albert Manifold in May
title.zh: 英国石油公司任命新董事长，此前阿尔伯特·曼尼福德曾有争议地被罢免

summary.en: BP has appointed Ian Tyler as its new chair, who was serving on an interim basis, following the controversial ousting of Albert Manifold in May. Tyler's appointment aims to resolve boardroom turmoil at the oil and gas company.
summary.zh: 在阿尔伯特·曼尼福德于五月被有争议地罢免后，英国石油公司任命了伊恩·泰勒为新董事长，他此前一直担任临时董事长。泰勒的任命旨在平息这家石油和天然气公司的董事会动荡。

body.en: Ian Tyler, who was already in role on interim basis, selected and pledges to ‘lead the board’s evolution’ BP has appointed a new chair after a months-long search following the controversial ousting of Albert Manifold , seeking to draw a line under the boardroom turmoil at the oil and gas company. Ian Tyler, who has served as the interim chair and sat on the BP board as a non-executive director since April 2025, is assuming the role on a permanent basis immediately. Continue reading...
body.zh: 伊恩·泰勒（Ian Tyler）已经临时就职，他被选中并承诺“领导董事会的演变”。在阿尔伯特·马尼福德（Albert Manifold）备受争议的罢免后，英国石油公司经过数月的寻找，任命了一位新主席，试图在这家石油和天然气公司的董事会混乱中划清界限。自 2025 年 4 月以来一直担任临时主席并担任 BP 董事会非执行董事的伊恩·泰勒 (Ian Tyler) 将立即永久担任该职位。继续阅读...

reflection.en: The news of BP appointing a new chair after a period of boardroom turmoil speaks to the human struggle for ethical leadership. Micah 6:8 reminds us that true leadership is not just about strategy and evolution, but about acting justly, loving mercy, and walking humbly with Yahweh. May leaders in all spheres seek this balance, bringing integrity and fairness...
reflection.zh: 英国石油公司在经历董事会动荡后任命新董事长的消息，反映了人类对道德领导力的不懈追求。弥迦书6:8提醒我们，真正的领导力不仅关乎战略和发展，更在于秉持公义、喜爱怜悯、谦卑地与雅伟同行。愿各领域的领导者都能寻求这种平衡，在决策中带来诚信和公平。

verse.textEn: What does Yahweh require of you? To act justly and to love mercy and to walk humbly with your God.
verse.textZh: 雅伟向你所要的是什么呢？只要你行公义，好怜悯，存谦卑的心，与你的神同行。

title.en: The shifting ties in Australia's backyard as 'deep pockets' beckon
title.zh: 澳大利亚后院的不断变化的联系，因为“深口袋”在召唤

summary.en: While China stirs tensions over Taiwan in Palau, island leaders are urging Canberra to focus on climate and drug crime.
summary.zh: 在中国在帕劳就台湾问题制造紧张局势之际，岛国领导人正敦促堪培拉关注气候变化和毒品犯罪。

body.en:
China and Taiwan's diplomatic tug-of-war is casting a shadow over the ongoing Pacific Islands Forum (PIF) as a handful of national leaders declined to attend — however, experts on the ground caution that a geopolitical focus risks ignoring the core priorities of Australia's neighbours.

The annual 18-member gathering in the Taiwanese-allied nation of Palau opened on Monday with climate change, economic security, and the rising influence of the transnational drug trade top of the agenda.

China has said it has "serious concerns" that Taiwan was invited to attend in its own right, while questions have been raised about whether China has influenced five of 18 national leaders from the forum (those of Kiribati, Fiji, Vanuatu, Samoa and Solomon Island) not to attend.

The cornerstone regional political forum began this year with a pointed message from Palau's President Surangel Whipps Jr, who urged nations to adhere to this year's theme of unity and reminded outside partners that they "do not choose our destination".

This year's PIF takes place as Kiribati moves to constitutionally restrict diplomatic recognition to UN member states only — thus excluding Taiwan — while China actively seeks to strip Taiwan of its 'development partner' status in the forum. This comes nearly two months after a Chinese ballistic missile test in the Pacific Ocean .

Your trusted source for staying up-to-date with the world around you. Get free daily news updates and analysis, straight to your inbox.

Taiwan, a self-governing democracy, broke away from mainland China in 1949. China views it as Chinese territory that must be brought under its control by force if necessary.

Prime Minister Anthony Albanese has made strengthening regional ties a key focus of his administration's foreign policy, signing multiple bilateral agreements with countries like Fiji, Vanuatu, and Tuvalu.

But despite the noise around China, "leaders have made it clear they're here to work" Tess Newton Cain, principal consultant at Asia-Pacific strategic firm Sustineo, told SBS News from Koror.

"The issue of the China-Taiwan tussle is largely a distraction, and one that they try to minimise."

On Wednesday, $600 million in Australian funding was announced to tackle transnational drug smuggling from South America that is increasingly causing harm across the Pacific.

China has made the PIF something of a battleground, maintaining that Taiwan ought to be sidelined during talks, as it is not technically a "dialogue partner" due to a difficult compromise that PIF members have reached over its status for the past three decades.

Palau, one of the few nations that maintains official diplomatic ties with Taiwan, has accused China of running a coercion campaign against it after travel...
body.zh: 由于少数国家领导人拒绝出席，中国和台湾的外交拉锯战给正在进行的太平洋岛屿论坛（PIF）蒙上了阴影。然而，现场专家警告称，地缘政治焦点可能会忽视澳大利亚邻国的核心优先事项。 一年一度的 18 名成员聚会于周一在台湾盟友帕劳开幕，气候变化、经济安全和跨国毒品贸易影响力不断上升成为首要议题。 中国表示，它“严重关切”台湾本身受邀参加，同时也有人质疑中国是否影响论坛 18 个国家领导人中的 5 个（基里巴斯、斐济、瓦努阿图、萨摩亚和所罗门群岛）不参加。 这一基石区域政治论坛于今年拉开帷幕，帕劳总统小苏兰吉尔·惠普斯发出了尖锐的信息，他敦促各国坚持今年的团结主题，并提醒外部伙伴“我们的目的地不是他们选择的”。 今年的PIF召开之际，基里巴斯从宪法上采取行动，限制仅对联合国成员国进行外交承认，从而将台湾排除在外，而中国则积极寻求剥夺台湾在论坛中的“发展伙伴”地位。这是中国在太平洋进行弹道导弹试验近两个月后的事。 您值得信赖的来源，让您了解周围世界的最新动态。直接将免费的每日新闻更新和分析发送到您的收件箱。 台湾是一个自治民主国家，于 1949 年脱离中国大陆。中国将其视为中国领土，必要时必须使用武力将其置于其控制之下。 安东尼·阿尔巴内塞总理将加强区域关系作为其政府外交政策的重点，与斐济、瓦努阿图和图瓦卢等国签署了多项双边协议。 不过，尽管中国周围一片喧嚣，“领导人已经明确表示，他们来这里是为了工作”，亚太战略公司 Sustineo 的首席顾问泰丝·牛顿·凯恩 (Tess Newton Cain) 在科罗尔告诉 SBS 新闻。 “中国与台湾的争斗问题在很大程度上是一种干扰，他们试图将其最小化。” 周三，澳大利亚宣布提供 6 亿美元资金，用于打击来自南美洲的跨国毒品走私，这种走私在太平洋沿岸造成的危害日益严重。 中国已将太平洋岛礁论坛变成了一个战场，坚持认为台湾应该在谈判中靠边站，因为过去三十年来，太平洋岛礁论坛成员就其地位达成了艰难的妥协，因此从技术上讲，台湾并不是“对话伙伴”。 帕劳是少数几个与台湾保持正式外交关系的国家之一，该国指责中国在旅行后对其进行胁迫行动......

reflection.en: The leaders of Pacific island nations are facing a complex geopolitical landscape, with major powers vying for influence. Amidst this, they are calling for attention to their most pressing local concerns: climate change and the drug trade. This echoes the ancient call for leaders to prioritize the well-being and justice of their people, ensuring that the...
reflection.zh: 太平洋岛国领导人正面临复杂的地区政治格局，大国争夺影响力。在此背景下，他们呼吁关注最紧迫的本地问题：气候变化和毒品交易。这呼应了古老的呼召，要求领导人优先考虑人民的福祉和正义，确保弱势群体的需求在大国斗争中不被忽视。

verse.textEn: Do what is just and right. Rescue from the hand of the oppressor the one who has been robbed.
verse.textZh: 你们要施行公平和公义，拯救被抢夺的脱离欺压人的手。

title.en: Ray Hadley used homophobic slur against Alan Jones after 2GB withdrew offer of $4m breakfast radio gig, court hears
title.zh: 哈德利在2GB撤回400万澳元早餐节目邀约后，对艾伦·琼斯使用了恐同诽谤言论，法庭获悉

summary.en: Broadcaster Ray Hadley told a Sydney court he used homophobic slurs and derogatory names when discussing colleague Alan Jones, after the radio station 2GB withdrew a secret offer of a $4 million contract for Hadley to take over Jones's popular breakfast slot. Hadley is testifying in the trial of Jones, 85, who faces...
summary.zh: 广播员雷·哈德利在悉尼法庭上表示，在电台2GB撤回一项秘密的400万澳元合同邀约，让哈德利接替艾伦·琼斯备受欢迎的早餐时段后，他在谈论同事艾伦·琼斯时使用了恐同诽谤和侮辱性称呼。哈德利正在为85岁的琼斯出庭作证，琼斯面临22项不雅攻击和性接触指控。

body.en: Hadley is giving evidence in trial of former 2GB rival Jones, 85, who has pleaded not guilty to 22 indecent assault and sexual touching charges Get our breaking news email , free app or daily news podcast Warning: This article contains offensive language Broadcaster Ray Hadley has told a Sydney court he used a homophobic slur and derogatory names when talking about his colleague Alan Jones, after 2GB withdrew a secret offer of a $4m contract to take over Jones’s coveted breakfast slot. In one text message read out in court, Hadley said he won’t rest until he buries Jones, “figuratively and literally” and he will “tear his supporters apart”. Continue reading...
body.zh: 哈德利正在对 85 岁的前 2GB 竞争对手琼斯的审判中提供证据，琼斯对 22 项非礼和性接触指控表示不认罪。 获取我们的突发新闻电子邮件、免费应用程序或每日新闻播客 警告：本文包含攻击性语言 广播员雷·哈德利 (Ray Hadley) 告诉悉尼法院，在 2GB 撤回了一份价值 400 万美元的秘密合同以接管琼斯的合同后，他在谈论他的同事艾伦·琼斯 (Alan Jones) 时使用了恐同诽谤和贬义性的名字。令人垂涎的早餐时段。在法庭上宣读的一条短信中，哈德利表示，在埋葬琼斯之前，他不会休息，“象征性地和字面意义上的”，他将“撕裂他的支持者”。继续阅读...

reflection.en: Words carry immense power, capable of inflicting deep wounds. Ray Hadley's admission of using homophobic slurs and threatening language, revealed in court, underscores the destructive potential of speech. This serves as a stark reminder that our tongues can build up or tear down, and the consequences of our words, especially in public life, can be severe.
reflection.zh: 言语拥有巨大的力量，能够造成深刻的创伤。雷·哈德利在法庭上承认使用恐同诽谤言论和威胁性语言，这凸显了言语的破坏性。这有力地提醒我们，我们的舌头可以建造也可以拆毁，而我们言语的后果，尤其是在公众生活中，可能是严重的。

verse.textEn: The tongue has the power of life and death, and those who love it will eat its fruit.
verse.textZh: 生死在舌头的权下；喜爱它的，必吃它所结的果子。

title.en: Andy Burnham to face first PMQs as borrowing costs rise – UK politics live
title.zh: 安迪·伯纳姆首次面临首相问答，因借贷成本上升——英国政治直播

summary.en: Prime Minister's Questions (PMQs) takes place as the Resolution Foundation suggests it's unrealistic to increase defense spending without raising taxes. Andy Burnham will face his first PMQs today, likely fielding questions from Kemi Badenoch regarding defense spending targets and tax implications.
summary.zh: 英国首相问答（PMQs）之际，分辨率基金会（Resolution Foundation）提出，在不增税的情况下增加国防开支是不切实际的。安迪·伯纳姆（Andy Burnham）今天将面临他的首次首相问答，可能会收到来自凯米·巴登诺赫（Kemi Badenoch）关于国防开支目标和税收影响的问题。

body.en: PMQs comes as Resolution Foundation says it is not ‘realistic’ to think defence spending can increase without tax rises Good morning. Andy Burnham will face PMQs for the first time as PM today but he already has a fairly good idea of the questions he might get from Kemi Badenoch because she rehearsed them all yesterday. Here is an excerpt from the press release the Conservatives put out yesterday summarising those questions – and their take on how Burnham responded. Kemi Badenoch asked if Burnham would: -Set out a plan to get defence spending to 3% of GDP; Continue reading...

reflection.en: The upcoming Prime Minister's Questions centers on a debate about increasing defense spending, a decision that has significant financial implications for the public. Jeremiah 22:3 reminds leaders of their duty to "execute justice and righteousness, and deliver from the hand of the oppressor him who suffers violence." This calls for careful consideration of...
reflection.zh: 即将到来的首相问答（PMQs）围绕着一项关于增加国防开支的辩论展开，这项决定对公众有着重大的财务影响。《耶利米书》22:3 提醒领导者，他们的职责是“施行公平和公义，拯救被欺压的脱离欺压者的手”。这要求他们仔细考虑此类支出决定如何影响他们所服务的民众的福祉和资源。

verse.textEn: Do what is just and right. Rescue from the hand of the oppressor the one who has been robbed.
verse.textZh: 你们要施行公平和公义，拯救被抢夺的脱离欺压人的手。

reflection.en: Amidst the ongoing crisis in Nepal, the confirmation of five Australians being safe brings a measure of relief to their families. Yet, the grave concern for the 38 still missing underscores the vulnerability of individuals caught in disaster. This situation calls us to remember and advocate for those whose whereabouts are unknown, praying for their safety...

verse.textEn: Speak up for those who cannot speak for themselves, for the rights of all who are destitute. Speak up and judge fairly; defend the rights of the poor and needy.
verse.textZh: 你当为不能自辩的开口，为孤独的伸冤。你当开口按公义判断，为困苦和穷乏的辨屈。

title.en: EU holds talks on response to Leipzig drone attack after Germany formally blames Moscow for incident – Europe live
title.zh: 欧盟就德国指责莫斯科策划的事件举行会谈，回应列日无人机袭击

summary.en: The EU is holding talks on how to respond to a drone attack last month, which Germany has formally blamed on Moscow. The EU's foreign policy chief stated the attack had 'all the hallmarks of state sponsored terrorism' and aimed to divide Europe and deter support for Ukraine, vowing that this attempt would fail....

body.en: Foreign policy chief says drone attack last month ‘had all the hallmarks of state sponsored terrorism’ as she prepares to lead today’s discussions Britain’s foreign secretary Ed Miliband is also taking part in today’s talks in Ireland. “ We see an attempt by Russia to divide us in Europe and to deter us from our support for Ukraine. And I say very clearly today, on behalf of the United Kingdom, this attempt will fail. ” Continue reading...

reflection.en: The accusation of state-sponsored terrorism in the Leipzig drone attack presents a stark challenge to the international community. It tempts a response fueled by anger and a desire for retribution. Yet, the call to overcome evil with good, rather than being overcome by it, remains a difficult but vital path. May wisdom guide the leaders gathered, that their...
reflection.zh: 列日无人机袭击事件被指控为国家支持的恐怖主义，这给国际社会带来了严峻的挑战。它诱使人们以愤怒和报复的欲望来回应。然而，‘以善胜恶，不可被恶所胜’的呼吁，虽然艰难，却仍然是一条至关重要的道路。愿聚集的领导者们能获得智慧的指引，使他们的回应能够缓和局势而非火上浇油。

verse.textEn: Do not be overcome by evil, but overcome evil with good.
verse.textZh: 你不可为恶所胜，反要以善胜恶。

title.en: Why do US troops have history with this Thai city?
title.zh: 美军为何与这座泰国城市有着历史渊源？

summary.en: Jonathan Head of BBC News reports from Pattaya, Thailand, a beach resort famous for its vibrant nightlife and bars. The USS Abraham Lincoln has docked nearby after a long voyage, and Head explores the historical connection between American military personnel and this resort city.
summary.zh: 英国广播公司（BBC）的乔纳森·海德（Jonathan Head）从泰国海滨度假胜地芭堤雅发回报道，这里以其充满活力的夜生活和酒吧而闻名。在创纪录的250天海上航行后，“亚伯拉罕·林肯”号航空母舰已停靠在芭堤雅附近。海德探讨了美国军人与这座海滨度假胜地之间的历史联系。

body.en: After a record 250 days at sea, the USS Abraham Lincoln has docked in Thailand close to the city of Pattaya. Known for its raucous nightlife and sex tourism, the BBC's South East Asia correspondent Jonathan Head explains the history between US troops and the beach resort.
body.zh: 在创纪录的海上航行 250 天后，亚伯拉罕·林肯号航空母舰已停靠在泰国芭堤雅市附近。英国广播公司 (BBC) 东南亚记者乔纳森·海德 (Jonathan Head) 以其喧闹的夜生活和性旅游而闻名，讲述了美军和海滩度假村之间的历史。

reflection.en: The USS Abraham Lincoln's arrival in Pattaya, a city with a complex history intertwined with military presence and nightlife, invites us to consider the vastness and intricate design of creation. Psalm 104:24 reminds us that the earth is full of Yahweh's riches and wisdom, a testament to His masterful artistry in every aspect of existence, from the grandest...
reflection.zh: “亚伯拉罕·林肯”号航空母舰抵达芭堤雅，这座城市有着与军事存在和夜生活交织的复杂历史，这促使我们思考造物的浩瀚与精妙设计。诗篇104:24提醒我们，地土全是我主所造，充满祂的智慧，这是祂在从宏伟的宇宙设计到人类地方历史的每一个方面的精湛艺术的见证。

verse.textEn: How many are your works, Yahweh! In wisdom you made them all; the earth is full of your creatures.
verse.textZh: 雅伟啊，你所造的何其多！都是你用智慧造成的；遍地满了你的丰富。

title.en: Bus crash on Egypt's Red Sea coast kills 16
title.zh: 埃及红海海岸发生巴士事故致16人死亡

summary.en: Another 28 people are injured in the accident in the South Sinai governorate, officials say.
summary.zh: 据官员称，在南西奈省发生的这起事故中，另有28人受伤。

body.en:
At least 16 people have been killed in a bus crash in eastern Egypt, the country's health ministry has said.

Another 28 people were injured on the road between Red Sea towns of Dahab and Nuweiba in the South Sinai governorate on Wednesday morning.

As many as 20 ambulances were sent to the scene of the accident to provide first aid and evacuate the injured, the ministry said. The cause of the crash remains unknown.

The area is a popular tourist destination, attracting visitors from around the world.

Deadly road accidents are common across Egypt, with the authorities reporting nearly 6,000 fatalities in 2025.

Last month, 18 people were killed and 30 injured when two lorries collided in the north-eastern Ismailia governorate.
body.zh: 埃及卫生部表示，埃及东部发生的一起公交车事故已造成至少 16 人死亡。 周三上午，南西奈省红海城镇达哈卜和努韦巴之间的道路上另有 28 人受伤。 卫生部称，多达20辆救护车被派往事故现场提供急救并疏散伤者。坠机原因仍不清楚。 该地区是一个受欢迎的旅游目的地，吸引着来自世界各地的游客。 致命的道路事故在埃及各地很常见，当局报告称，2025 年将有近 6,000 人死亡。 上个月，两辆卡车在伊斯梅利亚省东北部相撞，造成 18 人死亡、30 人受伤。

reflection.en: The news of 16 lives lost in a bus crash on Egypt's Red Sea coast is a stark reminder of the fragility of life and the deep sorrow that such tragedies bring. In moments of profound grief, we can find solace in the divine promise that all suffering, tears, and death will one day cease, and a new reality of peace will be established.
reflection.zh: 埃及红海海岸发生巴士事故致16人丧生，这一消息令人痛心，它提醒我们生命的脆弱以及此类悲剧带来的深切悲伤。在极度悲伤的时刻，我们可以从神圣的应许中找到慰藉：一切的痛苦、眼泪和死亡终将消失，一个充满和平的新现实将会建立。

verse.textEn: He will wipe every tear from their eyes. There will be no more death or mourning or crying or pain.
verse.textZh: 神要擦去他们一切的眼泪；不再有死亡，也不再有悲哀、哭号、疼痛。

title.en: Iran attacks US bases in Middle East after reports US strike killed five at wedding party
title.zh: 美国对伊朗发动更多打击，伊朗国家媒体报道爆炸事件

summary.en: US Central Command accused Iran of targeting commercial shipping and American service members deployed in the region. American forces resumed strikes against Iran on Tuesday, US Central Command said in a statement, accusing the Islamic Revolutionary Guard Corps (IRGC) of "recent attempted attacks" against commercial...
summary.zh: 美国中央司令部指责伊朗袭击在该地区部署的商船和美国军人。美国中央司令部周二在一份声明中表示，美军已恢复对伊朗的打击，指责伊斯兰革命卫队（IRGC）“近期企图袭击”霍尔木兹海峡的商船以及“在该地区部署的美国军人”。

body.en:
Tehran has launched missile and drone attacks at US targets in Jordan, Kuwait, Iraq and Bahrain after American forces resumed strikes against Iran on Tuesday.

The Iranian Red Crescent said five people, including a child, were killed and more than 50 injured when shrapnel from a US missile attack hit a home where a wedding celebration was taking place in Sirik in southern Iran.

The US military said it was aware of the reports but that it never targeted civilians.

US Central Command (Centcom) said US strikes on Iran followed "recent attempted attacks" by Iran's elite Islamic Revolutionary Guard Corps (IRGC) against commercial shipping in the Strait of Hormuz and American forces in the region.

The IRGC said the US would "regret" the strikes. By early Wednesday, it had launched a barrage of ballistic missiles at a US Marine base in Jordan's Aqaba in retaliation for the Sirik attack, according to Iran's semi-official Tasnim news agency.

The Jordanian Armed Forces said it had intercepted 13 ballistic missiles, 10 of which were destroyed, while three fell in remote areas. There were no deaths or injuries.

Separately, the Kuwait army said its air defences were responding to Iranian missile attacks early Wednesday.

Several explosions were also reported in Bahrain, according to Iranian state media.

Irna news agency also reported that the IRGC had struck US bases in Iraq's autonomous Kurdistan region, destroying a maintenance centre, warehouses and equipment.

After about a month-long pause, the US resumed attacks on Iran earlier this week , when it announced it had struck two rocket launchers which were used to lay mines in the Strait if Hormuz. Tehran retaliated by firing missiles at air bases in Jordan and a drone at the UAE.

Centcom said the latest attacks against IRGC targets had started at 12:00 ET (16:00 GMT) and been completed by early Wednesday.

Iranian state media reported projectiles had hit the areas of Chabahar and Konarak and an airport in Jiroft, and that explosions were heard in Qeshm island and Bandar Abbas.

Iranian state media and the Iranian Red Crescent reported that civilian sites on Iran's southern coast had been bombed, with a child among those killed at a wedding ceremony in Sirik county, which lies on the Strait of Hormuz.

US Navy Captain Tim Hawkins, speaking on behalf of Centcom, told the BBC it was aware of reports from Iranian state media of the attack in Sirik.

The US and Israel launched wide-ranging strikes on Iran on 28 February, with Iran responding by attacking Israel, US bases and allied states in the Gulf, and effectively closing the Strait of Hormuz to marine traffic.

A US-Iran agreement, known as the Memorandum of Understanding, to extend an April ceasefire between the two countries was signed in...
body.zh: 美国中央司令部在一份声明中表示，美国军队周二恢复对伊朗的打击。 它指责伊斯兰革命卫队（IRGC）“最近企图袭击”霍尔木兹海峡的商业航运和“部署到该地区的美国军人”。 中央司令部表示，美军于东部时间 12:00（格林尼治标准时间 16:00）开始袭击 IRGC 目标。伊朗官方媒体报道称，该国负责安全的副省长称，四枚炮弹击中了恰巴哈尔县和科纳拉克县。 伊朗伊斯兰革命卫队表示，美国将对这些袭击感到遗憾，因为美国总统唐纳德·特朗普警告称，如果伊朗进行报复，将再次受到“更严厉、更高水平”的打击。 此次袭击是美国自本周早些时候七月下旬以来对伊朗进行的首次已知袭击，当时部队袭击了海峡拉拉克岛的两座火箭发射器。 伊朗半官方通讯社塔斯尼姆通讯社报道称，周二格什姆岛以及科纳拉克和阿巴斯港也听到了几起爆炸声。 唐纳德·特朗普证实了这次“大规模而有力”的袭击，他说这是对伊朗向约旦美军基地发射八枚导弹的回应，并补充说该国在海峡布设水雷方面“失败”。 关于他威胁要在伊朗报复的情况下发动进一步袭击，他补充道：“这不会是所有袭击中规模最大的一次，它正在伺机而动，当袭击结束时，伊朗伊斯兰共和国将所剩无几。” 伊斯兰革命卫队发言人侯赛因·莫赫比表示，严厉的惩罚正在等待美国，该国将对新的袭击感到遗憾。

reflection.en: The news reports escalating military strikes and threats of further retaliation between the US and Iran. This cycle of action and counter-action, where each side seems poised to respond to perceived aggression with greater force, mirrors the ancient struggle described in Romans 12:21: "Do not be overcome by evil, but overcome evil with good." The temptation...
reflection.zh: 新闻报道了美国和伊朗之间军事打击的升级以及进一步报复的威胁。这种行动与反击的循环，似乎每一方都准备以更大的武力回应其认为的侵略，这与罗马书12:21中所描述的古老斗争相似：“不要被恶所胜，反要以善胜恶。”以敌意回应敌意的诱惑很强烈，但呼召却是要通过另一条道路来打破这个循环。

verse.textEn: Do not be overcome by evil, but overcome evil with good.
verse.textZh: 你不可为恶所胜，反要以善胜恶。

title.en: US warship arrives in Thailand after record 286 days at sea
title.zh: 美国军舰在海上创纪录航行286天后抵达泰国

summary.en: The USS Abraham Lincoln aircraft carrier arrived in Thailand after a record 286 consecutive days at sea. The extended deployment, which included time in the Middle East and participation in combat operations during the war with Iran, reportedly led to mental health concerns among the approximately 5,000 sailors and...
summary.zh: 美国海军航空母舰“亚伯拉罕·林肯”号在海上连续航行286天，创下纪录后抵达泰国。此次延长的部署任务包括在中东地区停留，并参与了与伊朗的战争中的战斗行动。据报道，船上约5000名海军和海军陆战队员因此出现了心理健康问题。

body.en:
The United States Navy aircraft carrier USS Abraham Lincoln arrived at Thailand's Laem Chabang port on Wednesday after spending 286 consecutive days at sea.

The record-long deployment included an extended period in the Middle East, amid reports of mounting mental health concerns and deteriorating conditions aboard the vessel.

The carrier, which has around 5,000 sailors and marines on board, was deployed in November last year and took part in the US naval blockade and combat operations during the war with Iran.

US Navy deployments typically last between six and nine months, although they can be extended during periods of conflict.

This deployment set a modern-era record for consecutive days at sea, according to US officials.

Your trusted source for staying up-to-date with the world around you. Get free daily news updates and analysis, straight to your inbox.

The Abraham Lincoln, accompanied by other US naval vessels, will spend five days in Thailand for rest and recuperation, according to Thai officials.

"Our arrival in Laem Chabang provides a well-deserved opportunity for our Sailors and Marines to rest and recharge. It also underscores the strong and enduring partnership and alliance between the United States and Thailand," the commander of Carrier Strike Group 3, Rear Admiral Robert E. Loughran, said in a statement.

"What this strike group has accomplished is truly historic. I could not be prouder of the exceptional professionalism and expertise demonstrated by every member of this team during our operations."

Thailand became a US treaty ally in 1954, before being designated a major non-NATO ally in 2003. Thailand's armed forces have long been reliant on US defence hardware and both countries' militaries maintain strong relations and hold annual exercises together.

Thailand has made it clear the visit is for logistics, rest, and recuperation, in line with its treaty commitments, and is not connected to the conflict in the Middle East.

The arrival of thousands of military personnel has raised hopes of an economic boost for the nearby ‌resort city of Pattaya, which also has a longstanding reputation as a sex tourism destination.

A fleet of around 40 buses will ferry the military personnel between Pattaya and the port at Laem Chabang where the vessels will dock, Pattaya Mayor Poramase Ngampiches said. Pattaya sits on the Gulf of Thailand, about 150km southeast of Bangkok.

"There are certain places and activities that the personnel are prohibited from participating in, such as all kinds of water sports, jet skiing, bungee jumping, wrestling, and boxing," he told the Reuters news agency.

Police will deploy additional patrols around Pattaya's main beachfront and nightlife district, following raids over the weekend that led to 40 to...
body.zh: 美国海军航空母舰亚伯拉罕·林肯号在连续海上航行286天后于周三抵达泰国林查班港。 这次创纪录的部署时间包括在中东的较长一段时间，有报道称，船上的心理健康问题日益严重，船上的情况不断恶化。 这艘航母载有约5000名水手和海军陆战队员，于去年11月部署，并在与伊朗的战争期间参加了美国的海上封锁和作战行动。 美国海军的部署通常持续六到九个月，但在冲突期间可能会延长。 美国官员称，这次部署创下了海上连续几天的现代记录。 您值得信赖的来源，让您了解周围世界的最新动态。直接将免费的每日新闻更新和分析发送到您的收件箱。 据泰国官员称，亚伯拉罕·林肯号将在其他美国海军舰艇的陪同下在泰国休养五天。 “我们抵达林查班为我们的水手和海军陆战队员提供了一个当之无愧的休息和充电的机会。这也凸显了美国和泰国之间强大而持久的伙伴关系和联盟，”第三航母战斗群司令罗伯特·E·洛夫兰少将在一份声明中说。 “这个打击群所取得的成就确实具有历史意义。我对这个团队的每个成员在行动中所表现出的卓越专业精神和专业知识感到无比自豪。” 泰国于 1954 年成为美国的条约盟友，并于 2003 年被指定为主要的非北约盟友。泰国武装部队长期以来一直依赖美国的国防硬件，两国军队保持着牢固的关系，并每年举行联合演习。 泰国已明确表示，此次访问是为了履行其条约承诺，进行后勤、休息和休养，与中东冲突无关。 数千名军事人员的到来给附近的度假城市芭堤雅带来了经济增长的希望，芭堤雅也素有性旅游目的地的美誉。 芭堤雅市长 Poramase Ngampiches 表示，由约 40 辆巴士组成的车队将在芭堤雅和军舰停靠的林查班港之间运送军事人员。芭堤雅位于泰国湾，距曼谷东南约 150 公里。 他对路透社表示：“有些场所和活动是禁止人员参加的，例如各种水上运动、水上摩托艇、蹦极、摔跤和拳击。” 继周末突袭导致 40 人受伤后，警方将在芭堤雅主要海滨和夜生活区周围部署更多巡逻人员。

reflection.en: After an unprecedented 286 days at sea, the USS Abraham Lincoln has reached port. This extended deployment, reportedly taking a toll on the mental well-being of its 5,000 crew members, highlights the profound exhaustion that prolonged service can bring. Yet, the prophet Isaiah offers a timeless promise: 'those who hope in Yahweh will renew their strength.'...
reflection.zh: 在创纪录的286天海上航行后，“亚伯拉罕·林肯”号航母终于抵达港口。这次延长的部署任务据报道给船上5000名船员的心理健康带来了影响，凸显了长期服役可能带来的巨大疲惫。然而，先知以赛亚提供了一个永恒的应许：“那等候雅伟的，必从新得力。”愿我们记念那些服役的人们，愿他们能找到安息和重燃的希望。

verse.textEn: Those who hope in Yahweh will renew their strength. They will soar on wings like eagles; they will run and not grow weary.
verse.textZh: 但那等候雅伟的，必从新得力。他们必如鹰展翅上腾。

title.en: South Korea jails care home head for sexually assaulting disabled residents
title.zh: 韩国以性侵残疾居民的养老院负责人判刑

summary.en: A man surnamed Kim has been sentenced to 15 years in prison for sexually assaulting three residents at the Saekdongwon facility in Incheon City, west of Seoul. The investigation began after one victim came forward, leading to a nationwide inspection of care facilities where 33 other suspected abuse cases were found.
summary.zh: 一名姓金的男子因在首尔西部仁川市的Saekdongwon疗养院性侵三名居民而被判处15年监禁。在一名受害者站出来后，警方展开调查，并导致对全国养老院的检查，发现了另外33起疑似虐待案件。

body.en:
A South Korean court has jailed the former head of a disabled care home for sexually assaulting multiple residents, in a case that shocked the nation.

The man, surnamed Kim, was handed a 15-year prison term for abusing three residents at the Saekdongwon facility in Incheon City, west of Seoul.

Police started investigating Kim after one of his victims, a woman with a severe intellectual disability, came forward in February last year.

The case has prompted the government to inspect 1,507 care facilities for disabled people across the country, where 33 cases of suspected abuse were found.

South Korean Prime Minister Kim Min-seok had described the abuse at Saekdongwon as "a grave matter that calls into question the very reason for the state's existence".

An in-depth assessment of residents commissioned by Ganghwa County found that 20 current and former female residents may have experienced sexual abuse.

Many in South Korea have asked how such a case could still occur, especially after laws were strengthened in 2011 to protect people with disabilities from sexual assault.

Some have also raised questions on how the director's actions could have gone undetected for so long.

Ganghwa County has ordered Saekdongwon to close, while Incheon City officials revoked the licence of the foundation that operated it.

However, the closure has been deferred until the remaining residents have been relocated and arrangements for independent living have been completed.

The foundation has filed an administrative lawsuit challenging the revocation of its licence.
body.zh: 韩国一家法院因对多名居民进行性侵犯而判处残疾人护理院前院长入狱，这起案件震惊了全国。 这名金姓男子因在首尔以西仁川市的 Saekdongwon 设施中虐待三名居民而被判处 15 年徒刑。 去年 2 月，金的一名受害人（一名患有严重智力障碍的女性）挺身而出，警方开始对金进行调查。 此案促使政府检查了全国1507个残疾人护理机构，发现33起疑似虐待案件。 韩国总理金珉锡将色东院的虐待事件描述为“一个严重的问题，让人质疑国家存在的根本原因”。 江华郡委托对居民进行的深入评估发现，20名现任和前任女性居民可能遭受过性虐待。 许多韩国人质疑这样的案件怎么还会发生，特别是在 2011 年加强了保护残疾人免遭性侵犯的法律之后。 一些人还质疑这位导演的行为为何能在这么长时间内未被发现。 江华县已下令关闭 Saekdongwon，而仁川市官员则吊销了运营该基金会的许可证。 然而，关闭已被推迟，直到剩余居民搬迁并完成独立生活的安排。 该基金会已提起行政诉讼，质疑吊销其许可证。

reflection.en: This case is a stark reminder of the vulnerability of those with disabilities and the profound betrayal of trust when caregivers abuse their position. The courage of one victim to speak out, though difficult, was crucial in bringing justice and prompting wider checks. We are called to be a voice for the voiceless, ensuring that those who cannot advocate for...
reflection.zh: 这起案件严峻地提醒我们，残疾人士的脆弱性以及护理人员滥用职权时所造成的信任的严重背叛。一名受害者鼓起勇气发声，虽然艰难，却是伸张正义和促成更广泛检查的关键。我们被呼召为无声者发声，确保那些无法为自己辩护的人得到保护，他们的尊严得到维护。

verse.textEn: Speak up for those who cannot speak for themselves, for the rights of all who are destitute. Speak up and judge fairly; defend the rights of the poor and needy.
verse.textZh: 你当为不能自辩的开口，为孤独的伸冤。你当开口按公义判断，为困苦和穷乏的辨屈。

title.en: Germany says Russia behind attempted drone attack at Leipzig airport
title.zh: 德国称俄罗斯是莱比锡机场无人机袭击事件的幕后黑手

summary.en: Investigators believe an explosives-laden drone was deliberately targeting a Ukrainian cargo aircraft at Leipzig/Halle airport in early August. The German government said on Tuesday that it held Russia "responsible."
summary.zh: 调查人员认为，8月初在莱比锡/哈勒机场，一枚装有爆炸物的无人机蓄意袭击了一架乌克兰货运飞机。德国政府周二表示，其认为俄罗斯“负有责任”。

body.en:
Investigators believe an explosives-laden drone was deliberately targeting a Ukrainian cargo aircraft at Leipzig/Halle airport in early August. The German government said on Tuesday that it held Russia "responsible."

The German government said on Tuesday that it held  Russia "responsible" for an  attempted drone attack at Leipzig/Halle Airport  on August 4. 

"The federal government concludes that Russia is responsible for the hybrid attack in Leipzig," said Interior Minister Alexander Dobrindt at a press conference in Berlin .

"The means used — such as the drone configuration, components, explosives and detonation systems — are known to us from other hybrid operations by Russia and its war against Ukraine ," added Foreign Minister Johann Wadephul .

He said the attack fit the pattern of a "long series of destabilization operations" against Europe.

Authorities discovered a drone fitted with explosives and a detonation mechanism on the evening of August 4 in the security area of Leipzig/Halle Airport between Ukrainian cargo aircraft and believe a second drone may have collided with a DHL aircraft nearby.

Last week, German media reported a third drone, also loaded with explosives, had also been discovered at the airport. 

German federal prosecutors described the incident as a "serious attack on Germany's transport and logistics infrastructure."

"Taken together, police investigations, patterns of the crime and intelligence findings substantiate Russian responsibility for the attempted attack at Leipzig Airport," said Interior Minister Dobrindt on Tuesday.

"We do not view Leipzig as an isolated incident, but rather see it in the context of other hybrid actions," he continued. "We assume that Germany will be the target of further hybrid attacks by Russia."

Dobrindt insisted that Germany is "not at war" but that it is "a daily target of hybrid warfare."

Therefore, he said, Germany would respond to the hybrid attack in Leipzig in a "proportionate and measured, yet resolute manner."

Foreign Minister Wadephul said Germany's response would be coordinated closely with European Union and NATO partners.

"We are tightening entry controls for Russian nationals" and Berlin would propose the listing of more Russian individuals for European Union sanctions, Wadephul said, as the Russian ambassador to Berlin was summoned.

In addition to a strengthening of internal security, he also announced additional measures including the closure of the Russian consulate in the western city of Bonn from September 18 and the rescinding of a contract enabling the operation of the "Russian House," a Russian cultural center in Berlin.

"Our message to the Russian leadership is clear," Germany's top diplomat said. "We are sticking...
body.zh: 调查人员认为，八月初，一架载有爆炸物的无人机故意瞄准莱比锡/哈勒机场的一架乌克兰货机。德国政府周二表示，俄罗斯应承担“责任”。 德国政府周二表示，俄罗斯对 8 月 4 日莱比锡/哈雷机场发生的无人机袭击未遂事件“负责”。 内政部长亚历山大·多布林特在柏林举行的新闻发布会上表示：“联邦政府得出的结论是，俄罗斯应对莱比锡的混合袭击负责。” 外交部长约翰·瓦德菲尔补充道：“我们从俄罗斯其他混合行动及其对乌克兰的战争中了解到了所使用的手段，例如无人机配置、组件、炸药和引爆系统。” 他表示，这次袭击符合针对欧洲的“长期一系列破坏稳定行动”的模式。 8 月 4 日晚，当局在莱比锡/哈勒机场的安全区域发现一架装有炸药和引爆装置的无人机，位于乌克兰货机之间，并认为第二架无人机可能与附近的一架 DHL 飞机相撞。 上周，德国媒体报道称，在机场还发现了第三架同样装载爆炸物的无人机。 德国联邦检察官将这一事件描述为“对德国运输和物流基础设施的严重攻击”。 内政部长多布林特周二表示：“总的来说，警方的调查、犯罪模式和情报调查结果证实了俄罗斯对莱比锡机场袭击未遂事件负有责任。” “我们并不认为莱比锡事件是一个孤立的事件，而是将其视为其他混合行动的背景，”他继续说道。 “我们认为德国将成为俄罗斯进一步混合攻击的目标。” 多布林特坚称德国“没有处于战争状态”，但它是“混合战争的日常目标”。 因此，他表示，德国将以“适度、谨慎但坚决的方式”应对莱比锡的混合袭击。 外交部长瓦德菲尔表示，德国将与欧盟和北约伙伴密切协调应对措施。 除了加强内部安全外，他还宣布了其他措施，包括从9月18日起关闭俄罗斯驻西部城市波恩的领事馆，并撤销允许柏林俄罗斯文化中心“俄罗斯之家”运营的合同。 瓦德菲尔说：“我们向俄罗斯领导人传达的信息是明确的。” “我们坚持我们的安全路线。对莱比锡的袭击表明这是必要的。我们不会允许我们的社会凝聚力因俄罗斯的袭击而分裂。当我们的……受到保护时，我们随时准备与我们的合作伙伴一起做出反应。”

reflection.en: The accusation that Russia is responsible for the drone attack at Leipzig airport highlights the ongoing cycle of conflict and retaliation. In such moments, the temptation is to respond in kind, mirroring the aggression faced. Yet, the call remains to actively choose a different path, overcoming harmful actions not with more harm, but with steadfast...
reflection.zh: 指控俄罗斯对莱比锡机场的无人机袭击负责，凸显了冲突和报复的持续循环。在这样的时刻，人们很容易以牙还牙，模仿所遭受的侵略。然而，呼召依然是选择一条不同的道路，用坚定的良善和真理来克服有害的行为，而不是以更多的伤害来回应。

verse.textEn: Do not be overcome by evil, but overcome evil with good.
verse.textZh: 你不可为恶所胜，反要以善胜恶。

title.en: Four more Australians found safe after Nepal floods as death toll passes 1,000
title.zh: 尼泊尔洪水死亡人数破千，四名澳大利亚人获救

summary.en: Four more Australians have been confirmed safe in the Nepal-Tibet region following devastating flooding that has claimed over 1,000 lives. The Department of Foreign Affairs and Trade (DFAT) has revised the number of Australians still unaccounted for in the region downward from 43 to 38.
summary.zh: 在造成 1,000 多人死亡的毁灭性洪水之后，又有四名澳大利亚人在尼泊尔-西藏地区被确认安全。外交贸易部 (DFAT) 已将该地区仍下落不明的澳大利亚人数量从 43 人下调至 38 人。

body.en:
Four more Australians have been confirmed safe in the Nepal-Tibet region following devastating flooding.

Six Australians have now been located since the floods hit the Nepal-China border last Wednesday. Officials were in contact with an Australian in Tibet on Tuesday after another Australian, Cara Severino, was found safe in Nepal over the weekend.

According to the ABC, one of the four other Australians located was found in Nepal. The remaining three were found outside of the location where the flooding took place. Their welfare is currently not known.

The Department of Foreign Affairs and Trade (DFAT) has revised the number of Australians still unaccounted for in the region down to 38.

Australian aid supplies aboard a Royal Australian Air Force plane that departed earlier this week were due to arrive in Nepal on Wednesday morning.

The death toll from devastating Himalayan glacial floods crossed the 1,000 mark on Tuesday, as Chinese and Nepali teams searched for survivors including dozens feared trapped in hydropower tunnels.

Nearly 4,500 people are missing after the gigantic wave of freezing water, rocks and debris triggered by a high-altitude glacial collapse roared downstream on Wednesday, wiping out entire settlements and carving a path of destruction across Nepal.

Nepali rescue teams are digging, drilling and blasting through debris in a desperate race against time to free around 100 hydropower workers believed trapped in multiple tunnels.

So far, rescuers have recovered only bodies from tunnels blocked by sludge, and hopes of finding survivors are fading.

Excavators worked into the night on Tuesday, but an army update noted that "a large amount of water started flowing" into a hole they were digging, forcing them to start a new opening.

Nepal's Prime Minister Balendra Shah has called the catastrophe "unimaginable and heartbreaking".

With mortuaries overflowing in Nepal, authorities have begun burying hundreds of unidentified bodies after DNA sampling.

Police, using a drone to search for survivors, said on Tuesday that they had located 24 corpses inside a single house in Nuwakot district.

Foreign Minister Shisir Khanal said he still hoped some of the thousands missing could be alive.

"Miracles do happen," he told the Agence France-Presse (AFP) news agency in an interview. "At this point, I do not want to completely give up hope."

In the capital Kathmandu, crowds lined up to search for their missing relatives.

Debu Sapkota, a 58-year-old driver, posted photos of his 83-year-old mother-in-law and her granddaughter, alongside dozens of others.

Sapkota said he had little hope they survived after...
body.zh: 在遭受毁灭性洪水袭击后，尼泊尔-西藏地区又有四名澳大利亚人被确认安全。 据澳大利亚广播公司报道，自昨天上午起被找到的五名澳大利亚人中，一名在尼泊尔被发现，另一名在中国。其余三件是在洪水发生地点外发现的。目前尚不清楚他们的福利。 外交贸易部 (DFAT) 将该地区仍下落不明的澳大利亚人人数从 43 人下调至 38 人。 周二有消息称，周末安全找到了另一名澳大利亚人卡拉·塞维里诺(Cara Severino)，官员们正在与西藏的一名澳大利亚人取得联系。 您值得信赖的来源，让您了解周围世界的最新动态。直接将免费的每日新闻更新和分析发送到您的收件箱。 一架澳大利亚皇家空军飞机于本周早些时候起飞，将于今天上午 10 点左右抵达尼泊尔。 周二，毁灭性的喜马拉雅冰川洪水造成的死亡人数突破了 1000 人大关，中国和尼泊尔救援队正在搜寻幸存者，其中包括数十人，担心被困在水电隧道中。 周三，高空冰川崩塌引发的巨大冰水、岩石和碎片浪潮席卷下游，摧毁了整个定居点，并在尼泊尔各地造成了破坏，造成近 4,500 人失踪。 尼泊尔救援队正在与时间赛跑，对废墟进行挖掘、钻孔和爆破，以解救据信被困在多条隧道中的约 100 名水电工人。 到目前为止，救援人员仅从被淤泥堵塞的隧道中打捞出尸体，寻找幸存者的希望正在破灭。 周二，挖掘机一直工作到深夜，但军方的最新消息指出，“大量的水开始流入”他们正在挖的洞，迫使他们开始新的挖掘。 尼泊尔总理巴伦德拉·沙阿称这场灾难“难以想象且令人心碎”。 由于尼泊尔太平间人满为患，当局在 DNA 采样后开始掩埋数百具身份不明的尸体。 周二，警方使用无人机搜寻幸存者，称他们在努瓦科特地区的一所房屋内发现了 24 具尸体。 外交部长希西尔·卡纳尔表示，他仍然希望数千名失踪人员中的一些人能够活着。 “奇迹确实会发生，”他在接受法新社采访时表示。 “此时此刻，我不想完全放弃希望。” 在首都加德满都，人群排队寻找失踪的亲人。 58 岁的司机德布·萨普科塔 (Debu Sapkota) 发布了他 83 岁的婆婆和她的孙女以及其他数十人的照片。 萨普科塔说，在目击者看到他们后，他对他们生还的希望渺茫。

reflection.en: The news from Nepal paints a grim picture of devastation, with over 1,000 lives lost to floods. In such moments of overwhelming crisis, Psalm 46:1 reminds us that God is our refuge and strength, a present help in times of trouble. Even amidst the chaos and loss, this divine presence offers a source of hope and stability.
reflection.zh: 尼泊尔传来的消息描绘了一幅毁灭性的严峻景象，洪水已夺走了 1,000 多人的生命。在如此压倒性的危机时刻，《诗篇》46:1 提醒我们，雅伟是我们的避难所和力量，是患难中随时的帮助。即使在混乱和损失之中，这种神圣的临在也提供了希望和稳定的源泉。

verse.textEn: God is our refuge and strength, an ever-present help in trouble.
verse.textZh: 神是我们的避难所，是我们的力量，是我们在患难中随时的帮助。

title.en: I've worked with families of missing people for 25 years. Here's how uncertainty feels
title.zh: 我曾与失踪者家属共事25年。我知道不确定性是什么感觉

summary.en: Loved ones of missing people must grapple with the possibility that they may never know for certain what happened. The devastating flash floods in Nepal and Tibet have claimed over 1,000 lives, with at least 42 Australians among more than 4,000 people still unaccounted for. The ambiguity of 'unaccounted for' creates...
summary.zh: 失踪者的亲人必须面对他们可能永远无法确切知道发生了什么的可能。尼泊尔和西藏毁灭性的山洪暴发已造成1000多人死亡，其中至少有42名澳大利亚人在4000多名仍“下落不明”的人之列。“下落不明”这个词的模糊性给家属带来了不确定性和绝望之间的痛苦差距，因为无法保证他们会收到消息。

body.en:
The surging death count from the devastating flash floods that hit Nepal and Tibet on 26 August has passed 1,000.

At least 42 Australians are among more than 4,000 people still “unaccounted for”. But this phrase "unaccounted" — frequently used in media reports — can split the problem too simply: people are either lost or yet to be found.

For many families waiting for news, this gap between uncertainty and despair is ambiguous — and it’s agonising. There is no guarantee news will ever come.

So, how can people missing loved ones make sense of this traumatic experience while the search continues? And what kind of support will they need?

I have been working with families of missing people for more than 25 years. Here’s what I’ve learnt about their experiences of ambiguous loss.

Your trusted source for staying up-to-date with the world around you. Get free daily news updates and analysis, straight to your inbox.

Ambiguous loss describes an ongoing loss without a resolution or closure. It can affect how people feel and behave, and the kind of support they will need.

While waiting for news of their loved ones in Nepal and Tibet, people will be grappling with the shock and trauma of how the disappearance unfolded, and the scale of the disaster. They will also be facing uncertainty and fear about how long they will be on this path.

When living with an ambiguous loss, it is common to oscillate between hopeful thinking and moments of hopelessness.

People may feel frozen to the time they learned the news, replay their last conversations with that person, or repetitively think up new ways to search and find them.

Families in Australia may also feel helpless being so far away, especially as the Department of Foreign Affairs and Trade has asked people to reconsider travelling to the affected areas to look for people who are out of contact. They may feel excluded from searching because they can’t travel to the region.

They may also experience physical and emotional agitation, feel sick in the stomach, or be restless from the need to constantly be on alert for information updates.

When observing how people respond to a missing loved one, it can seem to others that families aren't embracing reality. This might look like clinging to ideas that someone is alive, against the odds, or hoping for a miracle in unlikely circumstances.

This isn’t a family’s decision to not confront the reality, but a normal response to incomprehensible and traumatic situations.

Social workers who work in the field of missing persons learn to encourage families to respond however they need— even if that changes minute by minute.

For many people, surges of hope sustain us in times of crisis and...
body.zh: 8 月 26 日袭击尼泊尔和西藏的毁灭性山洪造成的死亡人数激增，已超过 1000 人。 4000多人仍然“下落不明”，其中至少有42名澳大利亚人。但媒体报道中经常使用的“下落不明”这个词可能会把问题简单化：人们要么失踪了，要么还没有找到。 对于许多等待消息的家庭来说，不确定性和绝望之间的差距是模糊的——而且令人痛苦。无法保证一定会传来消息。 那么，在寻找亲人的过程中，人们如何才能理解这段痛苦的经历呢？他们需要什么样的支持？ 我与失踪人员家属一起工作已超过 25 年。以下是我对他们模糊失落经历的了解。 您值得信赖的来源，让您了解周围世界的最新动态。直接将免费的每日新闻更新和分析发送到您的收件箱。 不明确的损失描述了一种持续的损失，没有解决或结束。它会影响人们的感受和行为，以及他们需要的支持类型。 在尼泊尔和西藏等待亲人消息的同时，人们将面临失踪事件的发生以及灾难规模带来的震惊和创伤。他们还将面临不确定性和恐惧，不知道自己会在这条道路上走多久。 当生活在模糊的失落之中时，人们通常会在充满希望的想法和绝望的时刻之间摇摆不定。 人们可能会在得知消息时感到冻结，重温与该人的最后一次对话，或者反复想出新的方法来搜索和找到他们。 澳大利亚的家庭也可能会因为距离如此遥远而感到无助，特别是外交和贸易部已要求人们重新考虑前往受影响地区寻找失去联系的人。他们可能会因为无法前往该地区而感到被排除在搜索之外。 他们还可能会感到身体和情绪焦躁、胃部不适，或者因​​需要不断警惕信息更新而焦躁不安。 当观察人们对失踪亲人的反应时，在其他人看来，家庭并没有接受现实。这可能看起来像是坚持认为某人还活着，克服困难，或者希望在不可能的情况下出现奇迹。 这并不是一个家庭决定不面对现实，而是对难以理解和创伤的情况的正常反应。 在失踪人员领域工作的社会工作者学会鼓励家人根据需要做出反应——即使情况每时每刻都在变化。 对于许多人来说，希望的浪潮支撑着我们……

reflection.en: The news from Nepal and Tibet paints a stark picture of prolonged suffering for thousands of families. The phrase 'unaccounted for' masks an agonizing limbo, a state of not knowing that can be more tormenting than definitive grief. In such sustained crises, where answers may never come, the ancient words of Lamentations offer a profound truth: 'The...
reflection.zh: 来自尼泊尔和西藏的新闻描绘了数千个家庭长期遭受痛苦的严峻景象。“下落不明”这个词掩盖了一种痛苦的停滞状态，一种可能比确切的悲伤更折磨人的未知状态。在如此持续的危机中，答案可能永远不会到来，古老的哀歌之书提供了深刻的真理：“雅伟的慈爱永不枯竭；他的怜悯永不穷尽，每日早晨都是新的；你的信实何其广大。”这种信实是那些承受最深切不确定性的人的基石。

verse.textEn: Because of Yahweh's great love we are not consumed, for his compassions never fail. They are new every morning.
verse.textZh: 我们不至消灭，是出于雅伟诸般的慈爱；是因他的怜悯不至断绝。每早晨这都是新的。

title.en: US and Iran trade tit-for-tat strikes as fears of a wider conflict grow
title.zh: 美伊互施打击，更广泛冲突担忧加剧

summary.en: Hostilities between the US and Iran have resumed as the war in the Middle East enters its sixth month. US forces struck Iran on Tuesday, and President Donald Trump vowed a 'much harder' response to any counterattacks, as exchanges of fire between the two sides threatened to reignite their smouldering conflict.
summary.zh: 在中东战争进入第六个月之际，美国和伊朗之间的敌对行动已恢复。周二，美军袭击了伊朗目标，特朗普总统誓言将对任何反击采取“更强硬”的回应，双方的交火威胁着重新点燃他们一触即发的冲突。

body.en:
Iran struck US interests around the Middle East on Wednesday, vowing "severe" consequences for renewed American attacks on the Islamic republic.

US President Donald Trump had warned earlier of "much harder and higher" attacks if Iran retaliated to the US strikes which Iranian state media said had killed 11 people in the country's south and southwest.

US forces struck Iran overnight as exchanges of fire between the two sides threatened to reignite their smouldering conflict.

The US hit Iranian targets on Monday in its first known strikes in several weeks, after which Iran's forces targeted US troops in Jordan and the United Arab Emirates, and projectiles struck two oil tankers in unclaimed attacks.

More US strikes came overnight, with Iranian state television reporting that explosions were heard in the country's south along the strategic Strait of Hormuz waterway and on an island in the Gulf, and that US forces hit an airport in the southern province of Kerman.

Your trusted source for staying up-to-date with the world around you. Get free daily news updates and analysis, straight to your inbox.

The official IRNA news agency said that "four projectiles hit areas within the counties of Chabahar and Konarak," without specifying whether there was any damage.

Iranian state television reported that several people attending a wedding were wounded by a US attack in the country's south. It added that the US attack hit a "residential area" in Bandar Kuhestak in Sirik county.

US Central Command (CENTCOM) said on X that the strikes followed "recent attempted attacks by (the Guards) against commercial shipping in the Strait of Hormuz and against American service members deployed to the region."

Trump said the "large and powerful" strikes were "in retaliation for the Iranians' failed attempt at adding sea mines to the Strait" and "the Iranians shooting eight missiles, all successfully knocked down, at our Military Base in Jordan."

"If the failed Nation of Iran retaliates for this very justified attack, they will be hit again at a much harder and higher level," he said in a post on his Truth Social platform.

Revolutionary Guards spokesman Hossein Mohebi warned on X that the US "will regret its new attacks," saying that "severe punishment awaits the aggressors."

Iran's Tasnim news agency later said a "decisive operation by Iran's armed forces in response to the US enemy has begun," and that "US bases and interests in the region are being targeted by Iranian missiles and drones."

After six months of war, the foes remain at an impasse, with Iran keeping the Strait of Hormuz closed and the United States persisting with a counter-blockade of Iranian ports.

title.en: Congo's Ebola caseload tops 6,000 as concerns grow
title.zh: 刚果埃博拉病例超过6000例，担忧加剧

summary.en: The Ebola outbreak in the Democratic Republic of Congo has surpassed 6,000 confirmed cases, with nearly 3,000 deaths. As the virus spreads, authorities are racing to contain one of the deadliest outbreaks in history.
summary.zh: 刚果民主共和国的埃博拉疫情已确认病例超过6000例，死亡人数近3000人。随着病毒蔓延，当局正争分夺秒地遏制这场有史以来最致命的疫情之一。

body.en:
The Ebola outbreak in the Democratic Republic of Congo has surpassed 6,000 confirmed cases, with nearly 3,000 deaths. As the virus spreads, authorities are racing to contain one of the deadliest outbreaks in history.

The Ebola outbreak in the Democratic Republic of Congo (DRC) continues to escalate, with confirmed infections now topping 6,000 and the death toll reaching 2,911, according to government figures.

The outbreak, caused by the Bundibugyo strain of the Ebola virus , has spread to around 60 zones in six provinces, raising fears that the virus is outpacing efforts to contain it.

"Around 60 health zones are now affected, every week more are added to the list. And the same pattern is repeated everywhere: initially, there is resistance and denial, followed by gradual acceptance," DW correspondent Jonas Gerding reported from Bunia, the capital of the Ituri province, the epicenter of the latest Ebola outbreak in Congo.

"Unfortunately, a lot more people will die until this Ebola outbreak gets under control," he added.

Health experts have said the situation is particularly worrying in eastern Congo, where conflict and insecurity are making it harder for response teams to reach affected communities.

"This outbreak is the fastest-growing Ebola epidemic on record. It is growing faster and wider than the response to contain it, but it can be stopped," UN Secretary-General Antonio Guterres told journalists last week.

The United Nations has appealed for more funding as humanitarian agencies struggle to keep pace with the increasing number of cases.

"International attention, political focus and resources are still lagging behind the reality unfolding on the ground," Guterres said, warning that the world "must also overcome another virus — the virus of indifference."

As researchers continue trials aimed at developing a licensed vaccine for the  Bundibugyo strain , Congolese authorities have rolled out a vaccination campaign focused on front-line health workers.

The vaccine was originally developed for a different Ebola variant, but officials hope it will provide some protection against the current outbreak.

Health Minister Samuel Roger Kamba said more than 50,000 doses had already arrived in the country.

"We will cover all the provinces that are around Ituri, moving in a ring towards the center of the outbreak, that is to say towards Ituri. But we have enough doses for all healthcare providers," he said on August 28.

Some health workers remain confident despite uncertainty over how effective the vaccine will be against the Bundibugyo strain.

"It is a vaccine that has already proven itself. We are talking about Ebola Bundibugyo, of Ugandan origin. But the vaccine that they want to administer to us was the vaccine that had...
body.zh: 刚果民主共和国埃博拉疫情确诊病例已突破6000例，近3000人死亡。随着病毒的传播，当局正在竞相遏制历史上最致命的疫情之一。 根据政府数据，刚果民主共和国（DRC）的埃博拉疫情持续升级，目前确诊感染人数已突破 6,000 人，死亡人数达到 2,911 人。 此次疫情由埃博拉病毒本迪布焦毒株引起，已蔓延到六个省份的约 60 个地区，引发人们对该病毒的控制速度超过控制力度的担忧。 德国之声记者 Jonas Gerding 在伊图里省首府布尼亚报道称，“现在大约有 60 个卫生区受到影响，每周都会有更多的卫生区被添加到名单中。同样的模式在各地重复出现：最初是抵制和否认，然后逐渐接受。” 他补充说：“不幸的是，在埃博拉疫情得到控制之前，将会有更多的人死亡。” 卫生专家表示，刚果东部的情况尤其令人担忧，那里的冲突和不安全局势使应对小组更难到达受影响的社区。 联合国秘书长安东尼奥·古特雷斯上周对记者表示：“这次疫情是有记录以来增长最快的埃博拉疫情。它的增长速度和范围超出了遏制疫情的应对措施，但它是可以被阻止的。” 由于人道主义机构难以跟上案件数量不断增加的步伐，联合国呼吁提供更多资金。 古特雷斯说：“国际关注、政治焦点和资源仍然落后于当地的现实。”他警告说，世界“还必须战胜另一种病毒——冷漠病毒”。 随着研究人员继续进行旨在开发针对 Bundibugyo 菌株的许可疫苗的试验，刚果当局已推出了针对一线卫生工作者的疫苗接种活动。 该疫苗最初是针对另一种埃博拉病毒变种开发的，但官员希望它能为当前的疫情提供一定的保护。 卫生部长塞缪尔·罗杰·坎巴表示，超过 50,000 剂疫苗已抵达该国。 “我们将覆盖伊图里周边的所有省份，以环形方式向疫情中心移动，也就是说向伊图里移动。但我们有足够的剂量供所有医疗保健提供者使用，”他在 8 月 28 日表示。 尽管疫苗对抗本迪布焦毒株的效果尚不确定，但一些卫生工作者仍然充满信心。 “这是一种已经证明了自己的疫苗。我们正在谈论源自乌干达的埃博拉本迪布焦。但他们想要给我们注射的疫苗是……

reflection.en: The relentless spread of Ebola in Congo, now exceeding 6,000 cases and claiming thousands of lives, speaks to a profound and sustained crisis. In such moments of deep devastation, the ancient words of Lamentations offer a pastoral perspective: Yahweh's mercies are new every morning, a testament to enduring hope even amidst overwhelming loss. This enduring...
reflection.zh: 刚果埃博拉疫情的持续蔓延，已造成超过6000例病例和数千人死亡，这无疑是一场深重而持久的危机。在如此巨大的灾难面前，古老的耶利米哀歌提供了牧养的视角：雅伟的慈爱每早晨都是新的，这是在巨大损失中仍存的持久盼望的见证。这份不变的信实，能成为那些与疾病搏斗的人以及那些不懈努力遏制疫情的医护人员的力量之源。

verse.textEn: Because of Yahweh's great love we are not consumed, for his compassions never fail. They are new every morning.
verse.textZh: 我们不至消灭，是出于雅伟诸般的慈爱；是因他的怜悯不至断绝。每早晨这都是新的。

title.en: War and sanctions deepen Iran's fuel crisis
title.zh: 战争与制裁加剧伊朗燃料危机

summary.en: Long lines at fuel stations are spreading across Iran as war damage, import constraints, and new US sanctions squeeze supplies. Drivers report hours-long waits, with some arriving before midnight or sleeping in their cars to secure fuel. The situation is even more difficult for diesel.
summary.zh: 由于战争破坏、进口限制和新的美国制裁导致供应紧张，伊朗各地的加油站排起了长队。司机们报告说需要排数小时的队，有些人甚至在午夜前就到场或睡在车里以确保获得燃料。柴油的情况甚至更加困难。

body.en:
Long lines at fuel stations are spreading across Iran as war damage, import constraints and new US sanctions squeeze supplies.

Only days after Washington announced a new round of economic sanctions on Iran , the country's gasoline shortage has become increasingly visible on the streets.

In cities across Iran , drivers are reporting hours-long waits at filling stations. Videos circulating on social media show some people arriving before midnight or sleeping in their cars to secure fuel the following morning. Some stations are closing before serving everyone in line.

The situation is even more difficult for diesel. Truck drivers say lines at filling stations near major cities can stretch for kilometers, forcing them to wait overnight simply to obtain enough fuel to return to work.

Iran already faces a gasoline deficit of roughly 15 million liters (ca. 4 million gallons) a day. War damage, difficulties importing refined products and a tightening US blockade have made an old structural problem much harder to manage.

A resident of Karaj, a city west of the capital, Tehran, told DW that some filling stations were limiting individual purchases to around 5 liters (about 1.3 gallons).

"I'm in the gasoline line right now. It took about 45 minutes just to get this far," he said. "Yesterday I went to several stations. Some were closed, some had no gasoline and others had very long queues."

He said he returned at 6 a.m. the next morning hoping to avoid the crowds, but again found a long line.

He suspects the shortages are partly being used to prepare public opinion for higher gasoline prices , a claim that could not be independently verified.

"Our whole life is either spent in the diesel line or on the road," one driver said. He described sleeping at a station while waiting for a tanker that might arrive around midday and supply only a few dozen trucks.

Another driver said he had been waiting since 8 a.m. after failing to obtain diesel the previous day.

For drivers whose earnings depend directly on keeping their vehicles moving, every lost day adds to rising insurance, tire, oil, repair and maintenance costs.

The shortage has coincided with the use of methanol in domestically produced gasoline.

Vahid Ghaneifard, chief executive of Persian Gulf Star Oil Company, recently confirmed that the refinery had begun testing methanol as an oxygenate in its gasoline.

The company says methanol makes up around 0.5% of the mixture. Iran's refining authorities say the national fuel standard permits methanol concentrations of up to 3%.

Officials insist the trial complies with technical requirements. But the timing has fueled public suspicion.
