body.zh: 根据最近的一份报告，澳大利亚似乎避免了前几年出现的冬季 COVID-19 病例激增的情况。 联邦监测数据显示，今年迄今已报告 64,357 例 COVID-19 病例，比 2025 年同期记录的 146,232 例减少了 56%。 最新数据描绘了澳大利亚 COVID-19 的不同寻常的景象，尽管整个社区的病例开始上升，但感染率仍远低于去年的水平。 澳大利亚疾病控制中心在最新的呼吸监测报告中表示：“与往年相比，2026年迄今为止的全国数据尚未显示出明显的冬季高峰。” 专家表示，病毒行为的改变和人群免疫力的改变是可能的解释。 您值得信赖的来源，让您了解周围世界的最新动态。直接将免费的每日新闻更新和分析发送到您的收件箱。 迪肯大学流行病学系主任凯瑟琳·贝内特教授表示，没有出现明显的冬季高峰是很重要的。 她说，澳大利亚的经验反映了人们通过之前的感染和疫苗接种逐渐对病毒产生了更强的免疫力。 她说：“当变异病毒在循环中停留较长时间时，更多的人针对该变异病毒的免疫力会自然增强，从而降低感染率。” 贝内特说，与大流行早期相比，正在传播的变种发生的重大变化较少，可能有助于人们现有的免疫力提供针对严重感染的更大保护。 澳大利亚并不是每隔几个月就会出现一种本质上不同的变种，而是相同的显性变种继续传播，从而使人群中的免疫力保持“准备就绪”。 流行病学家 Adrian Esterman 教授告诉 SBS 新闻，过去几年来，COVID-19 的爆发模式发生了显着变化。 “我们实际上不再看到波浪，或者即使我们确实有波浪，它们也非常小，”他说。 埃斯特曼说，现在病例的较小增加往往与一种能够更好地传播或逃避现有免疫力的变种的出现同时发生。 专家表示，病毒基因的重大变化仍可能引发更大的浪潮，但表示目前几乎没有证据表明病毒正在形成。 埃斯特曼说：“除非病毒发生巨大的基因转变……这是唯一可能破坏事物并引发另一波浪潮的因素。” 报告病例的急剧下降引发了一个问题：感染 COVID-19 的澳大利亚人是否减少了，或者检测到的感染是否减少了。 报告的 COVID-19 病例仅占所有感染的一部分，这意味着监测数据无法捕获所有感染该病毒的人……

reflection.en: In a world often marked by recurring challenges, it's encouraging to see unexpected relief. Australia's experience with lower COVID-19 rates this winter offers a moment of respite, reminding us that even in the face of persistent threats, seasons of weariness can give way to renewed strength. May we find hope and endurance, trusting that even after...
reflection.zh: 在一个常常充满反复挑战的世界里，看到意想不到的缓解令人鼓舞。澳大利亚今年冬季较低的COVID-19感染率提供了一个喘息的机会，提醒我们，即使面对持续的威胁，疲惫的季节也可能让位于新的力量。愿我们找到希望和忍耐，相信即使在艰难时期之后，也能找到力量。

verse.textEn: Those who hope in Yahweh will renew their strength. They will soar on wings like eagles; they will run and not grow weary.
verse.textZh: 但那等候雅伟的，必从新得力。他们必如鹰展翅上腾。

title.en: Who can still get a free COVID vaccine? Australia's new rules explained
title.zh: 谁仍能免费接种 COVID 疫苗？澳大利亚新规解读

summary.en: As COVID vaccine access changes, experts warn against drawing the wrong conclusion. From 1 October, free COVID-19 vaccines will be limited to those most at risk of severe disease, a move that some experts believe could leave certain vulnerable populations unprotected.
summary.zh: 随着 COVID 疫苗接种政策的改变，专家警告不要得出错误的结论。从 10 月 1 日起，免费的 COVID-19 疫苗将仅限于那些最有可能患重症的人群，一些专家认为此举可能会让某些弱势群体面临风险。

body.en:
Australia is preparing to wind back its universal COVID-19 vaccination program, but experts warn the change shouldn't be interpreted as a sign the virus is no longer a public health concern.

From 1 October, the National COVID-19 Vaccine Program will transition into the National Immunisation Program (NIP), with free COVID-19 vaccines becoming limited to people considered most at risk of severe disease.

But professor Adrian Esterman, chair of biostatistics and epidemiology at the University of Adelaide, said the new eligibility rules could leave some people vulnerable.

"There are lots and lots of people with diabetes, with other chronic conditions, autoimmune conditions, that would be hundreds of thousands of people who were getting a free shot and aren't getting one now," Esterman said.

The change comes as the latest federal government surveillance data shows COVID-19 cases increased over the past fortnight.

Your trusted source for staying up-to-date with the world around you. Get free daily news updates and analysis, straight to your inbox.

However, experts say 2026 has been unusual, with Australia yet to experience the clear winter COVID peak seen in previous years.

SBS News has contacted the Department of Health for comment, but it previously told the Royal Australian College of General Practitioners that COVID-19 is now endemic in Australia and that vaccination policy should focus on maintaining protection among those most vulnerable to severe disease.

From 1 October, free COVID-19 vaccination under the NIP will be available to adults aged 75 and over every six months, and adults aged 65 to 74 every 12 months.

Aboriginal and Torres Strait Islander people aged 50 to 74 will also remain eligible for an annual dose, as will adults aged 18 and over who are severely immunocompromised.

People outside those groups will still be able to access COVID-19 vaccines, but may have to pay for them.

Catherine Bennett, chair of Epidemiology at Deakin University, said the change should be viewed alongside Australia's broader vaccination program.

She said COVID-19 was now behaving differently from earlier in the pandemic, with population immunity helping to reduce severe illness.

"It's important that this is actually now being taken into a national immunisation program because that means that we have a sustained commitment to COVID alongside the other respiratory diseases," Bennett said.

She told SBS News that the lower vaccination rates among healthy adults had not translated into a comparable increase in severe disease.

Esterman said a bigger concern was whether Australians who most need protection were actually taking up the vaccines already available to them.

He said just 25 per cent of people aged 75 and over had received a COVID-19 vaccine in...
body.zh: 澳大利亚正准备取消其通用的 COVID-19 疫苗接种计划，但专家警告称，这一变化不应被解释为该病毒不再是公共卫生问题的迹象。 从 10 月 1 日起，国家 COVID-19 疫苗计划将转变为国家免疫计划 (NIP)，免费的 COVID-19 疫苗仅限于被认为最有可能罹患严重疾病的人群。 但阿德莱德大学生物统计学和流行病学系主任阿德里安·埃斯特曼教授表示，新的资格规则可能会让一些人变得脆弱。 埃斯特曼说：“有很多很多人患有糖尿病、其他慢性病、自身免疫性疾病，这将有数十万人原本可以免费注射，但现在却没有注射。” 这一变化发生之际，最新的联邦政府监测数据显示，过去两周 COVID-19 病例有所增加。 您值得信赖的来源，让您了解周围世界的最新动态。直接将免费的每日新闻更新和分析发送到您的收件箱。 然而，专家表示，2026 年是不同寻常的一年，澳大利亚尚未经历前几年出现的明显冬季新冠疫情高峰。 SBS 新闻已联系卫生部征求意见，但该部门此前曾告诉澳大利亚皇家全科医生学院，COVID-19 目前在澳大利亚流行，疫苗接种政策应侧重于维持对最易患严重疾病的人群的保护。 从 10 月 1 日起，根据 NIP，75 岁及以上的成年人每六个月可免费接种一次新冠肺炎 (COVID-19) 疫苗，65 岁至 74 岁的成年人每 12 个月可免费接种一次新冠肺炎 (COVID-19) 疫苗。 50 岁至 74 岁的原住民和托雷斯海峡岛民以及 18 岁及以上免疫功能严重低下的成年人也将有资格每年接种一次疫苗。 这些群体之外的人仍然能够获得 COVID-19 疫苗，但可能需要付费。 迪肯大学流行病学系主任凯瑟琳·贝内特表示，这一变化应与澳大利亚更广泛的疫苗接种计划一起看待。 她说，COVID-19 现在的表现与大流行早期不同，人群免疫力有助于减少严重疾病。 贝内特说：“重要的是，现在实际上已将其纳入国家免疫计划，因为这意味着我们对新冠病毒和其他呼吸道疾病有持续的承诺。” 她告诉 SBS 新闻，健康成年人的疫苗接种率较低并没有转化为严重疾病的相应增加。 埃斯特曼说，更令人担忧的是最需要保护的澳大利亚人是否真的接种了他们已经可以获得的疫苗。 他说，75 岁及以上的人中只有 25% 接种了 COVID-19 疫苗……

reflection.en: Australia's shift in COVID vaccine accessibility underscores the critical need for wise counsel in public health policy. Experts caution that limiting free access could inadvertently leave vulnerable groups exposed, reminding us that thoughtful deliberation and expert advice are essential when making decisions that impact community well-being.
reflection.zh: 澳大利亚在 COVID 疫苗接种可及性方面的转变，凸显了公共卫生政策中明智咨询的关键必要性。专家们警告说，限制免费接种可能会无意中使弱势群体暴露于风险之中，这提醒我们，在做出影响社区福祉的决定时，深思熟虑和专家建议至关重要。

verse.textEn: For lack of guidance a nation falls, but victory is won through many advisers.
verse.textZh: 无智谋，民就败落；谋士多，人便安居。

title.en: SBS confirmed as Australia's home of the 2030 FIFA World Cup
title.zh: SBS确认成为2030年国际足联世界杯在澳大利亚的转播平台

summary.en: SBS has secured exclusive national rights to broadcast the FIFA World Cup 2030, promising live and free access to all 104 matches for football fans across Australia via television, video, and radio.
summary.zh: SBS已获得2030年国际足联世界杯的独家全国转播权，承诺通过电视、视频和广播为澳大利亚各地的足球迷提供所有104场比赛的免费直播。

body.en:
SBS has cemented its place as Australia’s spiritual home of football, securing exclusive national rights to the FIFA World Cup 2030.

Football-loving Australians will have access to all 104 matches of the 2030 tournament via SBS television, video and radio programming.

SBS managing director Jane Palfreyman said the broadcaster is "without question" Australia’s home of the World Cup.

"The FIFA World Cup is one of the few sporting events that truly brings Australians together across all cultures, languages and communities," she said.

"In 2030 audiences will once again be able to experience every match live and free on SBS."

Your trusted source for staying up-to-date with the world around you. Get free daily news updates and analysis, straight to your inbox.

Celebrating its centenary year, the 2030 FIFA World Cup will be the most geographically diverse tournament in the competition’s history.

It will be the first in history to be played across six host nations — with the opening three matches taking place in Argentina, Paraguay and Uruguay before the tournament moves to primary host countries Morocco, Portugal and Spain.

The deal between SBS and FIFA cements a 40-year relationship that dates back to 1986.

"We are delighted to continue our long-standing partnership with SBS," FIFA director of media and partnerships and FIFA+ Jean-Christophe Petit said.

"SBS’s innovative programming, in-depth coverage, nationwide exposure and commitment to showcasing the rich cultural celebration of FIFA World Cup 2026 set new benchmarks for the tournament in Australia this year."

Petit said the new agreement will bring "Australian fans an exceptional viewing experience" of the "landmark edition of the tournament".

Palfreyman said the "important partnership" reflects a "long-standing commitment to making the world’s biggest sporting moments accessible to all Australians".

The agreement follows a massively successful 2026 World Cup for SBS, with the tournament watched by more than 18 million viewers.

Delivering full matches and recaps in 30-minute, 12-minute and three-minute clips on SBS On Demand, SBS reached 209 million hours of consumption — with around 55 per cent being solely digital.

"SBS has always approached the FIFA World Cup as much more than a sporting event," said SBS director of sport Ken Shipp.

"Our job is to capture the football, the stories, the cultures and the emotion that make it unlike anything else in world sport. We’re incredibly proud to have the opportunity to do that again in 2030."

For the latest from SBS News, download our app and subscribe to our newsletter .
body.zh: SBS 巩固了其作为澳大利亚足球精神家园的地位，获得了 2030 年 FIFA 世界杯的独家国家转播权。 热爱足球的澳大利亚人将可以通过 SBS 电视、视频和广播节目观看 2030 年锦标赛的全部 104 场比赛。 SBS 董事总经理简·帕尔弗里曼 (Jane Palfreyman) 表示，该广播公司“毫无疑问”是澳大利亚世界杯的主场。 “国际足联世界杯是为数不多的真正将不同文化、语言和社区的澳大利亚人聚集在一起的体育赛事之一，”她说。 “到 2030 年，观众将再次能够在 SBS 上免费直播每场比赛。” 您值得信赖的来源，让您了解周围世界的最新动态。直接将免费的每日新闻更新和分析发送到您的收件箱。 为庆祝其一百周年，2030 年 FIFA 世界杯将成为赛事历史上地域最多元化的赛事。 这将是历史上首次在六个主办国举行的比赛——前三场比赛将在阿根廷、巴拉圭和乌拉圭举行，然后比赛将移至主要主办国摩洛哥、葡萄牙和西班牙。 SBS 和 FIFA 之间的协议巩固了自 1986 年以来长达 40 年的合作关系。 “我们很高兴继续与 SBS 建立长期合作伙伴关系，”国际足联媒体和合作伙伴兼 FIFA+ 总监让-克里斯托夫·佩蒂特 (Jean-Christophe Petit) 表示。 “SBS 的创新节目、深入报道、全国曝光度以及对展示 2026 年 FIFA 世界杯丰富文化庆祝活动的承诺，为今年在澳大利亚举办的赛事树立了新的基准。” 佩蒂特表示，新协议将为“具有里程碑意义的赛事”带来“澳大利亚球迷非凡的观看体验”。 帕尔弗里曼表示，这一“重要的合作伙伴关系”反映了“让所有澳大利亚人都能参与世界上最盛大的体育赛事的长期承诺”。 该协议是在 SBS 举办的 2026 年世界杯取得巨大成功之后签署的，该赛事有超过 1800 万观众观看。 SBS 在 SBS On Demand 上提供 30 分钟、12 分钟和 3 分钟的完整比赛和回顾片段，观看时长达到 2.09 亿小时，其中约 55% 是完全数字化的。 “SBS 始终将 FIFA 世界杯视为一场体育赛事，”SBS 体育总监肯·希普 (Ken Shipp) 说道。 “我们的工作是捕捉足球、故事、文化和情感，使其与世界体育运动中的其他任何项目不同。我们非常自豪有机会在 2030 年再次做到这一点。” 如需了解 SBS 新闻的最新动态，请下载我们的应用程序并订阅我们的时事通讯。

reflection.en: The FIFA World Cup, as described, has a unique power to bridge divides and bring people together. It's a powerful reminder of the biblical vision where people from every nation, tribe, people, and language will stand together in unity. This global event, even in the realm of sport, offers a glimpse of that future hope.
reflection.zh: 正如报道所述，国际足联世界杯具有弥合分歧、团结人心的独特力量。它有力地提醒我们圣经中的异象：万国万族、各民各方的人都将一同站立，合而为一。这项全球性的体育赛事，哪怕只是在体育领域，也让我们得以一窥那未来的盼望。

verse.textEn: A great multitude that no one could count, from every nation, tribe, people and language, standing before the throne.
verse.textZh: 许多的人，没有人能数过来，是从各国、各族、各民、各方来的，站在宝座……前。

title.en: Hong Kong Desk
title.zh: 香港快讯

strap.en: News, policy, and public life in Hong Kong.
strap.zh: 聚焦香港时事、政策与社会动态。

title.en: Joshua Wong pleads guilty to foreign collusion
title.zh: 黄之锋承认勾结外国

summary.en: Former activist Joshua Wong has pleaded guilty to charges of colluding with foreign entities to endanger national security. The prosecution stated that Wong and Nathan Law agreed in 2016 to use 'international lobbying' for political aims, requesting sanctions against Hong Kong and China before the national security...
summary.zh: 前活动家黄之锋周三在庭上承认勾结外国或外部势力危害国家安全罪。控方称，黄之锋和罗冠聪在2016年达成协议，通过“国际游说”实现政治目标。在香港国安法生效前，两人曾请求外国机构、组织和个人对香港特区及中国实施制裁或其他敌对行动。控方表示，国安法实施后，黄之锋继续支持此类行动。

body.en: Former activist Joshua Wong pleaded guilty in court on Wednesday to the charge of collusion with a foreign country or with external elements to endanger national security. The prosecution told the High Court that Wong and Nathan Law had reached an agreement in 2016 to achieve political goals through "international lobbying". The court heard that before the enactment of the city's national security law, Wong and Law had requested foreign institutions, organisations, and individuals to impose sanctions or take other hostile actions against the SAR and China. The prosecution said that after the implementation of the Hong Kong National Security Law, Wong continued to support such efforts through foreign media and social media platforms. In mitigation, the defence lawyer said Wong has been in jail since he was 24 and is now almost 30. The lawyer said that, excluding the current case, Wong was already serving a sentence that would run until January 2027. He urged the court to set a lower starting point for Wong's sentence. Justice Tam adjourned the case to a later date. Edited by Altis Wong
body.zh: 前活动人士黄之锋周三在法庭上认罪，罪名是与外国或外部势力勾结危害国家安全。检方告诉高等法院，黄与罗冠聪已于2016年达成协议，通过“国际游说”实现政治目标。法庭获悉，在香港国家安全法颁布前，黄和罗曾要求外国机构、组织和个人对特区和中国实施制裁或采取其他敌对行动。检方表示，香港国安法实施后，黄继续通过外国媒体和社交媒体平台支持此类努力。辩护律师表示，黄某从24岁起就入狱，现在已经快30岁了。律师表示，除去本案，黄某已经在服刑，刑期将持续到2027年1月。他敦促法院为黄某定一个较低的刑期起点。谭法官将案件押后审理。编辑：Altis Wong

reflection.en: Joshua Wong's guilty plea to charges of colluding with foreign elements brings to mind the ancient prophetic call for justice. The prophet Amos declared, 'Let justice roll on like a river, righteousness like a never-failing stream!' This highlights the enduring human struggle to balance political action, perceived justice, and the legal frameworks that...
reflection.zh: 黄之锋承认勾结外国势力危害国家安全的罪名，令人想起先知阿摩司对公义的呼唤：“惟愿公平如大水滚滚， योग्य如江河滔滔！”这凸显了人类在政治行动、所认定的正义与规范社会的法律框架之间寻求平衡的持久挣扎。

verse.textEn: Let justice roll on like a river, righteousness like a never-failing stream!
verse.textZh: 惟愿公平如大水滚滚，使公义如江河滔滔。

title.en: CityU probes orientation camp misconduct
title.zh: 城大调查迎新营不当行为

summary.en: The City University of Hong Kong announced on Wednesday that it will pursue disciplinary action after reports surfaced regarding inappropriate conduct during its orientation camp. This response follows the circulation of an online video clip that appeared to show a topless male carrying a partially undressed female,...
summary.zh: 香港城市大学周三表示，在接获有关其迎新营期间不当行为的报告后，将采取纪律处分。该校此举是对网上流传的一段视频的回应，视频中似乎显示一名赤裸上身的男子抱着一名仅穿胸罩的女子。两人据信当时正在参加迎新活动。大学在一份声明中表示，对由学生会附属机构组织的迎新营中某些个人出现的“严重管理不善和不当行为”表示担忧。

body.en: The City University of Hong Kong on Wednesday said it would take disciplinary action following reports of inappropriate behaviour that allegedly occurred during its orientation camp. The university was responding to a video clip circulating online that purportedly showed a topless male carrying a female wearing nothing but a bra on the upper part of her body. The pair were believed to be taking part in some of the orientation activities. In a statement, the university expressed concern regarding the orientation camp organised by an affiliate of the students’ union that involved “serious mismanagement and inappropriate behaviour” by certain individuals. “We are also deeply concerned about the unnecessary disturbance experienced by participating students,” the university said. “A Student Discipline Panel has been established without delay. Meetings with the organisers are being scheduled, and information is also being gathered from participants. “Depending on the seriousness of the incident, disciplinary action will be taken in accordance with University procedures.” The university said it has zero tolerance towards any form of improper conduct, adding all students are required to maintain good discipline and treat their peers with respect during orientation and campus activities. Student organisations hosting orientation camps must also comply with university guidelines and complete training, it said. The university went on to say that it would not tolerate any behaviour that undermines its reputation. It also called on students who encounter difficulties during orientation activities to seek help. Edited by Tony Sabine
body.zh: 香港城市大学周三表示，针对据称在迎新营期间发生不当行为的报道，该校将采取纪律处分。该大学正在对网上流传的一段视频做出回应，该视频据称显示一名赤裸上身的男性抱着一名上半身只穿胸罩的女性。据信两人正在参加一些迎新活动。该大学在一份声明中对学生会附属机构组织的迎新营表示担忧，该营涉及某些人的“严重管理不善和不当行为”。该大学表示：“我们也对参与学生遭受不必要的干扰深感担忧。” “学生纪律小组已立即成立。正在安排与组织者的会议，并向参与者收集信息。“根据事件的严重程度，将根据大学程序采取纪律处分。”该大学表示，对任何形式的不当行为都采取零容忍态度，并补充说，所有学生都必须在迎新活动和校园活动中保持良好的纪律并尊重同龄人。报告称，举办迎新营的学生组织还必须遵守大学指导方针并完成培训。该大学接着表示，不会容忍任何损害其声誉的行为。并呼吁在迎新活动中遇到困难的学生寻求帮助。托尼·萨宾编辑

reflection.en: The news from City University of Hong Kong highlights a failure in leadership and oversight during a student-organized event. The university's commitment to disciplinary action underscores the importance of accountability when boundaries are crossed and mismanagement leads to inappropriate behavior. This situation calls for a renewed focus on ethical...
reflection.zh: 香港城市大学的这则新闻凸显了在学生组织活动中领导和监督的失职。大学承诺采取纪律处分，强调了在越界和管理不善导致不当行为时问责的重要性。这种情况要求重新关注所有组织活动中的道德行为和负责任的管理，确保学生福祉和尊严至上。

verse.textEn: What does Yahweh require of you? To act justly and to love mercy and to walk humbly with your God.
verse.textZh: 雅伟向你所要的是什么呢？只要你行公义，好怜悯，存谦卑的心，与你的神同行。

title.en: 9 children, 5 others injured after 2 buses collide at Hong Kong primary school
title.zh: 香港一所小学发生两辆巴士相撞事故，9名儿童和另外5人受伤

summary.en: Fourteen people, including nine children, were injured when two school buses collided at a Hong Kong girls' primary school. The Fire Services Department responded with 10 ambulances to the accident at Good Hope Primary School cum Kindergarten.
summary.zh: 在香港一所女子小学发生的两辆校车相撞事故中，包括九名儿童在内的十四人受伤。消防部门派出十辆救护车赶赴位于乐富道381号的 प्रकल्प小学暨幼儿园处理事故。

body.en: Fourteen people, including nine children, have been injured in a collision involving two school buses at a Hong Kong girls’ primary school. The Fire Services Department said on Wednesday that it dispatched 10 ambulances to handle the accident at 1.26pm at Good Hope Primary School cum Kindergarten, located at No 381 Jat’s Incline in Ngau Chi Wan. Eight of the 14 injured people were sent to United Christian Hospital in Kwun Tong for treatment, while another five were admitted to Kwong Wah Hospital...
body.zh: 香港一所女子小学发生两辆校车相撞事故，造成 14 人受伤，其中包括 9 名儿童。消防处周三表示，已于下午1时26分派出10辆救护车前往位于牛池湾甲斜道381号德望小学暨幼稚园处理事故。 14名伤者中，8人被送往观塘基督教联合医院救治，另有5人被送往广华医院留医……

reflection.en: The collision at Good Hope Primary School is a stark reminder of how quickly safety can be compromised, especially for the young. This incident underscores the importance of advocating for the well-being and protection of children, ensuring their voices are heard and their needs met.
reflection.zh: प्रकल्प小学暨幼儿园发生的碰撞事故，令人警醒地提醒我们安全可能如何迅速受到威胁，尤其是对年幼的儿童而言。这一事件凸显了为儿童的福祉和保护发声的重要性，确保他们的声音被听见，他们的需求得到满足。

verse.textEn: Speak up for those who cannot speak for themselves, for the rights of all who are destitute. Speak up and judge fairly; defend the rights of the poor and needy.
verse.textZh: 你当为不能自辩的开口，为孤独的伸冤。你当开口按公义判断，为困苦和穷乏的辨屈。

title.en: CityU vows ‘zero tolerance’ as orientation ‘disco night’ video triggers probe
title.zh: CityU 承诺“零容忍”，因“迪斯科之夜”视频引发调查

summary.en: Hong Kong’s City University is investigating a student-led orientation activity after a video emerged showing a half-naked man carrying a woman in minimal clothing. The university has pledged "zero tolerance" for improper conduct.
summary.zh: 香港城市大学正在调查一场学生主导的迎新活动，此前一段视频曝光，显示一名半裸男子抱着一名衣着暴露的女子。该大学承诺对不当行为“零容忍”。

body.en: Hong Kong’s City University has launched an investigation into an alleged indecent incident during a student-led orientation activity after a video surfaced showing a half-naked man carrying a woman wearing only a bra and shorts. The university issued a statement on Wednesday pledging “zero tolerance” for improper conduct, after a social media clip appeared to show intimate behaviour among individuals believed to be students during what the video caption described as a “disco night”. The clip...
body.zh: 香港城市大学对学生主导的迎新活动中涉嫌不雅事件展开调查，此前一段视频显示一名半裸男子抱着一名只穿着胸罩和短裤的女子。该大学周三发表声明，承诺对不当行为“零容忍”，此前社交媒体剪辑似乎显示了据信是学生的个人在视频标题所描述的“迪斯科之夜”期间的亲密行为。剪辑...

reflection.en: A video clip has surfaced, leading to an immediate investigation and public outcry regarding an alleged indecent incident at City University. This situation underscores the power of viral content to shape narratives and judgments before all facts are known. The ancient wisdom of Proverbs 18:17 reminds us that "the first to speak in a lawsuit, turns out to...
reflection.zh: 一段视频片段的出现，引发了对香港城市大学一起涉嫌不雅事件的立即调查和公众的强烈反应。这种情况凸显了病毒式传播内容在事实全部明了之前塑造叙事和判断的力量。箴言18:17的古老智慧提醒我们：“先说话的似乎有理，直到别人来辩论，就显出破绽。” 在我们急于谴责之时，愿我们牢记寻求全部真相并允许正当程序的重要性。

verse.textEn: In a lawsuit the first to speak seems right, until someone comes forward and cross-examines.
verse.textZh: 先诉情由的，似乎有理；但邻舍来到，就察出实情。

title.en: Hong Kong pro-democracy activist Joshua Wong pleads guilty in second national security case
title.zh: 香港民主派活动人士黄之锋承认在第二起国安案中认罪

summary.en: Joshua Wong, a prominent pro-democracy activist in Hong Kong, pleaded guilty on Wednesday to charges under the national security law, specifically conspiring to seek foreign sanctions against China. The charge carries a maximum penalty of life imprisonment.
summary.zh: 香港一位著名的民主派活动人士黄之锋周三承认触犯国安法，罪名是共谋寻求外国制裁中国，该罪名最高可判处无期徒刑。

body.en: Wong, 29, is accused of urging foreign powers to impose sanctions, blockades and other hostile measures against China Joshua Wong , one of Hong Kong’s most prominent pro-democracy activists, pleaded guilty on Wednesday to conspiring to seek foreign sanctions against Hong Kong and China, a national security charge that carries a maximum life sentence. Prosecutors have accused Wong, 29, of working with the exiled Hong Kong activist Nathan Law to urge foreign powers to impose sanctions, blockades or other hostile measures against China. Continue reading...
body.zh: 29 岁的黄之锋被指控敦促外国势力对中国实施制裁、封锁和其他敌对措施。香港最著名的民主活动人士之一黄之锋周三承认密谋寻求外国对香港和中国实施制裁，这一国家安全指控最高可判处无期徒刑。检察官指控 29 岁的黄与流亡香港活动人士罗冠聪合作，敦促外国势力对中国实施制裁、封锁或其他敌对措施。继续阅读...

reflection.en: Joshua Wong, a young activist known for his role in Hong Kong's democracy movement, has pleaded guilty to charges under the national security law. This situation brings to the fore the difficult tension between civic obedience and deeply held convictions. The apostles' unwavering stance, 'We must obey God rather than human beings,' offers a timeless...
reflection.zh: 香港一位以其在民主运动中角色而闻名的年轻活动人士黄之锋，已承认触犯国安法。这一局面凸显了公民服从与内心深处信念之间的艰难张力。使徒们坚定的立场——“顺从神，过于顺从人”——为这种良心冲突提供了永恒的视角。

verse.textEn: We must obey God rather than human beings!
verse.textZh: 顺从神，不顺从人，是应当的。

title.en: Higher typhoon signal possible, depending on Saudel’s course after rare resurgence
title.zh: 可能发出更高台风信号，取决于“海神”的后续路径

The Observatory said the standby No 1 typhoon signal would remain in force on...
summary.zh: 香港天文台表示，随着热带气旋“海神”罕见地重新增强并可能改变其在南海的路径，逼近珠江三角洲，周末前可能发出更高的台风信号。天文台称，周三“海神”横跨南海东北部时，一号戒备信号将继续生效。

body.en: Hong Kong’s weather forecaster may issue a higher typhoon signal closer to the weekend after Tropical Cyclone Saudel experienced a rare resurgence and could change its course over the South China Sea, edging towards the Pearl River Delta. The Observatory said the standby No 1 typhoon signal would remain in force on Wednesday, as Saudel moved across the northeastern South China Sea. “Under the combined effect of Saudel and the northeast monsoon, local winds are occasionally strong offshore and on...
body.zh: 热带气旋“萨德尔”罕见地卷土重来，并可能改变其在南中国海的航线，向珠江三角洲移动，香港天气预报员可能会在接近周末时发出更强的台风信号。天文台表示，随着萨德尔穿越南海东北部，周三备用的一号台风信号将继续有效。 “在萨德尔和东北季风的共同影响下，近海和海上局部风力偶尔较强......

reflection.en: As Tropical Cyclone Saudel unexpectedly strengthens and shifts course toward the Pearl River Delta, residents may feel a sense of unease about the approaching storm. In times of natural uncertainty, the ancient words of Psalm 46:1 remind us that God is our refuge and strength, a present help in times of trouble. May we find peace not in the absence of...
reflection.zh: 随着热带气旋“海神”出乎意料地增强并改变路径，朝向珠江三角洲逼近，居民们可能会对即将到来的风暴感到不安。在自然界的不确定时期，诗篇46:1古老的言语提醒我们，雅伟是我们的避难所和力量，是患难中随时的帮助。 愿我们能在风暴平息之时找到平安，更能在我们创造主的坚定同在中找到平安，祂即使在最猛烈的风暴中也提供庇护。

verse.textEn: God is our refuge and strength, an ever-present help in trouble.
verse.textZh: 神是我们的避难所，是我们的力量，是我们在患难中随时的帮助。

title.en: Medical centres denounced for fake vaccine claims
title.zh: 医疗中心因虚假疫苗宣传而受到谴责

summary.en: David Lam, a medical sector lawmaker, accused several medical centers of fraud on Wednesday for allegedly claiming to offer a vaccine that prevents multiple cancers without clinical data. The Department of Health is investigating the matter, including enforcement actions, after being alerted in July that HK Pacific...
summary.zh: 医疗界议员林大辉周三指控多家医疗中心欺诈，声称提供一种未经临床数据支持的、可预防多种癌症的疫苗。卫生署此前表示正在跟进此事，包括采取执法行动。卫生署于七月接获通报，指香港太平洋亚洲医疗中心及其关联机构在社交媒体上声称提供一种名为WT1的疫苗。卫生署提醒公众，WT1疫苗并非香港注册的药品，且在药品监管机构中查无相关注册记...

body.en: Medical sector lawmaker David Lam on Wednesday accused several medical centres of fraud for claiming to offer a vaccine that prevents multiple cancers without supporting clinical data. The Department of Health said in an earlier statement that it was following up on the matter, including carrying out enforcement actions. The department was alerted in July that HK Pacific Asia Medical Centre and its affiliated organisations claimed on social media that they offered the Wilms' tumor 1 (WT1) vaccine. The department reminded the public that the WT1 vaccine is not a registered pharmaceutical product in Hong Kong, and no relevant registration records could be found with drug regulatory authorities on the mainland or overseas. The department added that the treatment claims were misleading and could be fraudulent, adding it could delay people from seeking proper treatment. Speaking on an RTHK radio programme, Lam called on authorities to take down relevant advertisements for the jab. “The Department of Health – or relevant law enforcement agencies – should liaise with those platforms to have them remove the advertisements, and carry out investigations and prosecute organisations that issue these advertisements,” he said. “This is very important to the public's health. If we allow these kinds of advertisements to be widely circulated, it will pose a major health threat to the public.” Lam denounced those offering the vaccine for their “unethical” behaviour by making use of people’s fear of cancer and patients’ desperate mindsets to lure them to take the jab. He condemned them for offering false hopes to patients. While media reports said that the WT1 vaccine had been supplied to hospitals, Lam pointed out that it is only being used for scientific research, not for treatment, adding that the vaccine had not reached a stage where it could be considered safe for clinical applications. He called on the public to seek medical advice before using any new pharmaceutical products. Edited by Tony Sabine
body.zh: 医疗界议员林大卫周三指责几家医疗中心存在欺诈行为，因为它们声称提供一种预防多种癌症的疫苗，但没有临床数据支持。卫生部在早些时候的一份声明中表示，正在跟进此事，包括采取执法行动。卫生署于七月获悉，香港亚太医疗中心及其附属机构在社交媒体上声称，他们提供威尔姆斯氏瘤1（WT1）疫苗。卫生署提醒市民，WT1疫苗并非香港注册药剂制品，亦未能在内地或海外药品监管部门查到相关注册记录。该部门补充说，治疗声明具有误导性，并且可能具有欺诈性，并补充说这可能会延误人们寻求适当的治疗。林郑月娥在香港电台广播节目中呼吁当局撤下相关疫苗广告。他说：“卫生部或相关执法机构应与这些平台联络，让他们删除广告，并对发布这些广告的组织进行调查和起诉。” “这对公众的健康非常重要。如果我们允许此类广告广泛传播，将对公众的健康构成重大威胁。”林郑月娥谴责那些提供疫苗的人利用人们对癌症的恐惧和患者的绝望心态来引诱他们接种疫苗，这是“不道德”的行为。他谴责他们向患者提供虚假的希望。虽然媒体报道称WT1疫苗已供应给医院，但林郑月娥指出，该疫苗仅用于科学研究，而非用于治疗，并补充说该疫苗尚未达到可安全用于临床的阶段。他呼吁公众在使用任何新药品之前寻求医疗建议。托尼·萨宾编辑

reflection.en: The pursuit of profit can tragically lead some to exploit people's fears and hopes, especially concerning health. When claims of miraculous cures, like a vaccine for multiple cancers, lack scientific backing, it becomes a form of fraud that preys on vulnerability. This reminds us that true healing and well-being are not commodities to be manipulated for...
reflection.zh: 追求利润有时会以悲剧性的方式导致一些人利用人们的恐惧和希望，尤其是在健康方面。当像预防多种癌症的疫苗这样的神奇疗法声称缺乏科学依据时，这便成为一种欺诈，利用了人们的脆弱性。这提醒我们，真正的治愈和福祉并非可以被操纵以获取经济利益的商品。

verse.textEn: For the love of money is a root of all kinds of evil.
verse.textZh: 贪财是万恶之根。

title.en: ICAC sets integrity standards for govt computers
title.zh: 廉政公署为政府电脑系统设定诚信标准

summary.en: The ICAC has introduced new integrity assurance standards for government computer systems, comprising 12 control measures to boost security and monitor unusual activities. Starting in July, government departments will need to self-assess these standards when seeking funds for new computer systems. The guidelines were...
summary.zh: 廉政公署已推出一套新的政府电脑系统诚信保证标准，包含12项核心控制措施，旨在加强系统安全和追踪不当活动。从7月起，政府部门在申请购置新电脑系统的拨款时，必须根据这些标准进行自我评估。廉署执行处长表示，该标准咨询了学者和数字政策办公室的意见，以确保其切合实际和相关性。

body.en: The ICAC has launched a new set of integrity assurance standards for government computer systems, featuring 12 core control measures designed to enhance system security and track irregular activity. Starting in July, government bureaus and departments must perform a self-assessment against these standards whenever applying for funding to purchase new computer systems. Officiating at the unveiling ceremony on Wednesday, ICAC Commissioner Danny Woo said the watchdog had consulted with academics and the Digital Policy Office to ensure the guidelines are as practical and relevant as possible. "To give a few examples, we have introduced user authentication and clearly defined permissions to prevent unauthorised access to confidential information," he said. "We've also integrated conflict-of-interest declarations and approval processes directly into the system to ensure critical steps aren't skipped or overlooked." "On top of that, we've added access logs, anomaly detection, and automated alerts to help departments catch suspicious incidents early." Woo stressed that implementing measures outlined in the standards are necessary investments to enhance the departments’ overall efficiency. In the long-term, this approach can reduce the likelihood of corruption, sparing substantial costs for ICAC investigations and system repairs, while minimising the risk of public relation crises, he added. Acting Secretary for Innovation, Technology and Industry Lillian Cheong, for her part, said the government has always put safety and development on an equal footing. The standards, she said, provide ICAC additional tools to support its core value of upholding integrity governance. Edited by Wendy Wong
body.zh: 廉政公署推出了一套新的政府电脑系统完整性保证标准，包括12项核心控制措施，旨在增强系统安全和追踪违规活动。由七月起，政府各局及部门在申请资助购买新电脑系统时，必须根据这些标准进行自我评估。廉政公署专员胡丹尼在周三主持揭牌仪式时表示，该监管机构已咨询学者和数字政策办公室，以确保该指南尽可能实用和相关。 “举几个例子，我们引入了用户身份验证和明确定义的权限，以防止未经授权访问机密信息，”他说。 “我们还将利益冲突声明和审批流程直接集成到系统中，以确保不会跳过或忽视关键步骤。” “最重要的是，我们添加了访问日志、异常检测和自动警报，以帮助部门及早发现可疑事件。”胡强调，实施标准中列出的措施是提高部门整体效率的必要投资。他补充说，从长远来看，这种做法可以减少腐败的可能性，节省廉署调查和系统修复的大量成本，同时最大限度地减少公共关系危机的风险。署理创新科技及工业局局长张丽莲表示，政府一向将安全与发展放在同等地位。她说，这些标准为廉政公署提供了额外的工具，以支持其维护诚信治理的核心价值观。编辑者：Wendy Wong

reflection.en: In Hong Kong, the Independent Commission Against Corruption (ICAC) is implementing new integrity standards for government computer systems. This initiative, involving 12 control measures, aims to bolster security and detect irregularities. It reflects a commitment to ethical governance and accountability in public administration, reminding us that integrity...
reflection.zh: 在香港，廉政公署正为政府电脑系统推行新的诚信标准。这项措施包含12项控制要点，旨在加强安全并侦测不当行为。这体现了在公共行政中对道德治理和问责制的承诺，提醒我们系统中的诚信与个人诚信同样重要。

verse.textEn: What does Yahweh require of you? To act justly and to love mercy and to walk humbly with your God.
verse.textZh: 雅伟向你所要的是什么呢？只要你行公义，好怜悯，存谦卑的心，与你的神同行。

title.en: Joshua Wong admits instigating sanctions against Beijing, Hong Kong governments
title.zh: 黃之鋒承認煽動制裁北京及香港政府

summary.en: Jailed Hong Kong opposition activist Joshua Wong Chi-fung has admitted to instigating international sanctions against central and local authorities six years ago. This included urging foreign businesses to avoid investment in mainland China and petitioning an Israeli forensic tech firm to terminate its services to the...
summary.zh: 被監禁的香港反對派活動家黃之鋒承認，六年前曾煽動針對中央及地方當局實施國際制裁。這包括敦促外國企業避免投資中國內地，以及請求一家以色列法證科技公司終止向香港警方提供服務。現年29歲的黃之鋒被指控與他人合謀爭取國際支持。

body.en: Jailed Hong Kong opposition activist Joshua Wong Chi-fung has admitted instigating international sanctions against central and local authorities six years ago, such as urging foreign businesses to avoid investment in mainland China and petitioning an Israeli forensic tech firm to terminate its services to the city’s police force. The High Court heard on Wednesday that Wong, 29, had conspired with fugitive ex-lawmaker Nathan Law Kwun-chung, 33, and others to garner international support for their...
body.zh: 被监禁的香港反对派活动人士黄之峰承认，六年前煽动国际社会对中央和地方当局实施制裁，例如敦促外国企业避免在中国大陆投资，并请愿一家以色列法医技术公司终止为香港警察部队提供服务。高等法院周三获悉，29 岁的黄与 33 岁的逃亡前立法会议员罗冠中等人串谋，为他们的行为争取国际支持。

reflection.en: Joshua Wong has admitted to actions aimed at pressuring governments through international sanctions. This raises questions about the limits of obedience to earthly authorities when one believes a higher moral or divine imperative is at stake. The principle of obeying God rather than human authorities, even when it leads to conflict or punishment, is a...
reflection.zh: 黃之鋒承認採取行動，試圖通過國際制裁向政府施壓。這引發了關於當人們認為有更高的道德或神聖命令時，對地上權威服從界限的問題。順服神而非人的權威，即使會導致衝突或懲罰，這一原則在信仰傳統中反覆出現。

verse.textEn: We must obey God rather than human beings!
verse.textZh: 顺从神，不顺从人，是应当的。

title.en: Jailed Hong Kong pro-democracy campaigner Joshua Wong pleads guilty to foreign collusion charge
title.zh: 快讯：被监禁的香港民主活动家黄之锋承认外国勾结罪

summary.en: Hong Kong pro-democracy campaigner Joshua Wong has pleaded guilty to conspiracy to collude with foreign forces, his second conviction under a Beijing-imposed national security law following a landmark subversion case. Wong entered a guilty plea on Wednesday at the High Court over the foreign collusion charge. The...
summary.zh: 香港民主活动家黄之锋承认串谋勾结外国势力罪，这是他在一项里程碑式的颠覆案之后，根据北京强加的国家安全法被定罪的第二次。黄之锋周三在高等法院就外国勾结指控认罪。这位29岁的活动家被指控在2020年与流亡的活动家罗冠聪等人密谋，要求外国对香港或中国实施制裁、封锁或采取其他敌对行动。此罪行最高可判处无期徒刑。黄之锋目前因另一...

body.en: Hong Kong pro-democracy campaigner Joshua Wong has pleaded guilty to conspiracy to collude with foreign forces – his second conviction under a Beijing-imposed national security law following a landmark subversion case. Joshua Wong. File photo: Studio Incendo. Appearing at the High Court on Wednesday, Wong, speaking in a clear voice, answered “guilty” to the charge, read out in full by Judge William Tam due to the “high level of public interest” in the case. The 29-year-old was accused of conspiring with self-exiled activist Nathan Law and others in 2020 to request that foreign countries impose sanctions and blockades or engage in other hostile activities directed against the governments of Hong Kong and mainland China. The offence carries a maximum penalty of life behind bars. ‘International battlefront’ Reading out a court document known as the summary of facts, prosecutors told the court that Wong and Law had pursued the notion of “democratic self-determination” under the pro-democracy party Demosisto, which they founded in 2016. The pair were accused of having requested foreign sanctions by engaging in an “international battlefront” in the wake of the 2019 protests and unrest. Representatives of foreign consulates in Hong Kong leave the High Court on September 2, 2026, after attending a hearing during which activist Joshua Wong pleaded guilty to conspiracy to collude with foreign forces. Photo: Kyle Lam/HKFP. Wong was said to have conducted international lobbying for sanctions against the Special Administrative Region or central governments, requesting that the US introduce the Hong Kong Human Rights and Democracy Act in 2019 and imploring other Western countries to impose Magnitsky-style sanction programmes. He continued his international lobbying campaign despite the enactment of the Beijing-imposed national security law in June 2020, prosecutors said, while Law flew out of the city to carry on their cause overseas. “The defendant, who remained in Hong Kong, would continue to support the advancement of the international battlefront via foreign media outlets and social media platforms” to request foreign sanctions, prosecutor Mingme Yeung said. No remission Wong wore thick black-rimmed glasses and a navy shirt as he was led into the dock on Wednesday. He appeared thinner as he nodded to friends and supporters sitting the public gallery. Among the attendees were past members of Scholarism, the now-disbanded student activism group he founded in 2011. He is currently serving a prison term of four years and eight months for conspiracy to subvert state power in the landmark national security case known as the “Hong Kong 47,” in which he was among 45 prominent campaigners convicted and sentenced in 2024. A...
body.zh: 香港民主运动人士黄之锋承认与外国势力串谋共谋罪，这是他在一起具有里程碑意义的颠覆案件后，根据北京实施的国家安全法第二次被定罪。黄之锋.资料照片：Studio Incendo。黄周三在高等法院就涉外勾结指控认罪。这名29岁的男子被指控与自流亡的活动人士罗冠聪等人密谋，要求外国在2020年对香港或中国实施制裁、封锁或从事其他敌对活动。该罪行最高可判处终身监禁。黄目前因在被称为“香港47”的具有里程碑意义的国家安全案件中串谋颠覆国家政权而被判处四年八个月的徒刑，在这起案件中，他是2024年被定罪的45名著名活动人士之一。他原本预计将于2027年刑满，但新的涉外勾结定罪可能会延长他的刑期。该活动人士去年六月在赤柱监狱被警方国安部门逮捕。他自 2020 年 11 月起一直入狱。2026 年 9 月 2 日，高等法院外的警察。照片：Kyle Lam/HKFP。检察官指控黄在 2016 年与罗先生共同创立了现已解散的民主党众志，在 2019 年抗议和骚乱之后，通过参与“国际阵线”请求外国制裁。据称，黄之锋曾进行国际游说，要求制裁香港或中国，要求美国在2019年出台《香港人权与民主法案》，并恳求其他西方国家实施马格尼茨基式的制裁行为。检察官称，尽管北京于 2020 年 6 月颁布了国家安全法，但他仍继续开展国际游说活动，而罗飞出香港以维持他们的海外事业。经过一年的民主抗议和骚乱后，北京于 2020 年 6 月将国家安全立法直接纳入香港小宪法。它将颠覆、分裂国家、与外国势力勾结和恐怖主义行为定为刑事犯罪——广义上包括破坏交通和其他基础设施。此举赋予警方全面的新权力，并导致数百人在新的法律先例中被捕，同时数十个民间社会团体消失。当局表示，此举恢复了这座城市的稳定与和平，但拒绝接受贸易伙伴、联合国和非政府组织的批评。香港国安法生效当天，众志宣布解散。香港国安警察对罗先生进行通缉，并悬赏100万港元以提供线索将其逮捕。

reflection.en: Joshua Wong has pleaded guilty to charges under Hong Kong's national security law, facing a potential life sentence. His actions, and the conviction itself, speak to a deep conviction about his political beliefs and the pursuit of democracy. When human laws and deeply held moral or political convictions clash, individuals often face profound choices about...
reflection.zh: 黄之锋已承认香港国安法下的指控，面临可能被判处无期徒刑。他的行为以及定罪本身，都体现了他对自己政治信念和追求民主的坚定信念。当人的法律与根深蒂固的道德或政治信念发生冲突时，个人常常面临关于其最终效忠何处的深刻抉择。

verse.textEn: We must obey God rather than human beings!
verse.textZh: 顺从神，不顺从人，是应当的。

title.en: Hong Kong tax chief apologises after online interface error leads to 33,000 unfiled returns
title.zh: 香港税务局局长就电子税务平台界面错误导致 33,000 份未申报退税致歉

summary.en: Hong Kong's tax chief has apologized after the government's watchdog found that over 33,000 taxpayers failed to file their tax returns via the electronic eTAX platform due to "unclear" wording. This error, which in some cases led to penalties, is being addressed by the Inland Revenue Department, with plans to refund...
summary.zh: 香港税务局局长就政府监察机构发现超过 33,000 名纳税人因“措辞不清”而未能通过电子 eTAX 平台提交税务申报表示歉意。此错误在某些情况下导致了罚款，香港税务局正对此进行处理，并计划为约 800 名受影响的纳税人退还罚款或取消罚款。

body.en: Hong Kong’s tax chief has apologised after the government’s watchdog found that more than 33,000 taxpayers failed to file their tax returns via the electronic eTAX platform due to “unclear” wording, in some cases facing penalties as a result. Hong Kong’s Inland Revenue Department. File photo: Kyle Lam/HKFP. Commissioner of Inland Revenue Benjamin Chan said on Tuesday that his department will arrange refunds or cancel the penalties issued to some 800 taxpayers in the 2025-26 tax year. The statement came a day after the Office of the Ombudsman said eTAX ‘s unclear interface misled users into believing that they had successfully completed their tax returns when in fact their submissions were still incomplete. In a report released on Monday, the Office of the Ombudsman said it launched an investigation into the Inland Revenue Department (IRD) after receiving multiple complaints regarding unsuccessful deliveries of electronic tax returns. “Our investigation revealed that between May 2025 and January 2026, IRD did not receive the tax returns filed by over 33,000 taxpayers via eTAX using a digital signature completed with ‘iAM Smart,’” said Ombudsman Jack Chan. The problem stemmed from unclear wording on the eTAX submission and signature interface. Many users mistakenly believed that the process was concluded after successfully signing via the iAM Smart digital services platform, but they needed to return to eTAX until a confirmation page appeared, the watchdog said. Ex-official among affected taxpayers Speaking on Commercial Radio programme “On a Clear Day” on Tuesday, tax chief Benjamin Chan said the two electronic platforms have been revamped this year. iAM Smart will remind users that they have to return to eTAX to complete their tax return, which will clearly indicate if the filing has been completed, he said. Commissioner of Inland Revenue Benjamin Chan (middle) hosts a press conference on May 4, 2026. File photo: GovHK Chan also said that among the 33,000 taxpayers who failed to file their tax returns via eTAX last year, about 26,000 had corrected their filings afterwards. Only around 800 received a ticket for a fine, he added. Speaking on the same programme, Luk Che-chung, a former chief executive of the Hospital Authority’s Hong Kong East Cluster, revealed that he was one of those slapped with a HK$600 penalty for failing to file his returns on time. Luk said he was shocked when the IRD accused him of not having filed his tax returns, and that he soon paid the penalty on the advice of friends familiar with taxation. At first he was convinced it was his own mistake, he said. “I am over 60 years old, and I thought my memory was failing. I didn’t even know that I hadn’t filed my taxes after signing,” he said in...
body.zh: 香港政府监管机构发现超过 33,000 名纳税人因措辞“不明确”而未能通过电子税务平台提交纳税申报表，并在某些情况下面临处罚，香港税务局局长对此表示歉意。香港税务局。资料照片：Kyle Lam/HKFP。税务局局长陈本杰周二表示，该部门将在 2025-26 纳税年度安排退款或取消向约 800 名纳税人发出的罚款。就在该声明发表的前一天，监察员办公室称“税务易”界面不清晰，误导用户相信他们已成功完成纳税申报表，而事实上他们提交的资料仍然不完整。在周一发布的一份报告中，监察员办公室表示，在收到多起有关电子纳税申报表发送失败的投诉后，对税务局（IRD）展开了调查。申诉专员 Jack Chan 表示：“我们的调查显示，在 2025 年 5 月至 2026 年 1 月期间，税务局没有收到超过 33,000 名纳税人通过‘税务易’使用‘iAM Smart’填写的数字签名提交的纳税申报表。”问题源于“税务易”提交及签名界面的措辞不明确。监管机构表示，许多用户误以为通过iAM Smart数字服务平台成功签署后，流程已结束，但他们需要返回“税务易”，直到出现确认页面。受影响纳税人中的前官员周二在商业广播节目“晴朗的一天”中发表讲话时，税务局长本杰明·陈表示，这两个电子平台今年已进行了改造。他表示，iAM Smart将提醒用户必须返回“税务易”以完成报税表，这将清楚地表明报税表是否已完成。税务局局长陈启宗（中）于2026年5月4日主持记者会。资料图片：香港政府一站通陈启宗还表示，去年有33,000名未能通过“税务易”提交报税表的纳税人中，约有26,000人事后已更正。他补充说，只有大约 800 人收到了罚款单。医院管理局港岛东联网前行政总裁陆志聪在同一节目中透露，他是因未能按时提交报税表而被罚款600港元的人之一。陆说，当税务局指控他没有提交纳税申报表时，他感到很震惊，而且他很快就根据熟悉税务的朋友的建议缴纳了罚款。他说，起初他确信这是他自己的错误。 “我已经60多岁了，我以为我的记忆力衰退了。我什至不知道我签字后还没有报税，”他在...

reflection.en: When systems fail and cause hardship, leaders are called to account. The Commissioner's apology and commitment to rectify the errors for 800 taxpayers demonstrate a step toward justice and mercy. This echoes the prophet Micah's call to 'act justly and to love mercy and to walk humbly with your God,' reminding us that accountability and compassion are...
reflection.zh: 当系统出现故障并造成困难时，领导者有责任承担责任。税务局局长的道歉以及为 800 名纳税人纠正错误的承诺，表明了迈向公正和怜悯的一步。这呼应了先知弥迦的呼吁：“只当公义行道，喜爱怜悯，谦卑与你的雅伟同行”，提醒我们问责制和同情心在公共服务中至关重要。

verse.textEn: What does Yahweh require of you? To act justly and to love mercy and to walk humbly with your God.
verse.textZh: 雅伟向你所要的是什么呢？只要你行公义，好怜悯，存谦卑的心，与你的神同行。

title.en: China says solar power capacity surpasses coal for first time
title.zh: 中国太阳能发电装机容量首次超过煤电

summary.en: China's National Energy Administration announced that the country's installed solar power capacity has exceeded that of coal-fired power for the first time as of the end of July this year. This milestone comes as China, the world's largest greenhouse gas emitter, has pledged to peak carbon emissions by 2030 and...
summary.zh: 中国国家能源局周二宣布，截至今年7月底，中国太阳能发电装机容量已首次超过煤电装机容量。中国是世界上最大的温室气体排放国，已承诺在2030年前达到碳排放峰值，并在2060年前实现碳中和。

body.en: China’s installed solar energy capacity has surpassed that of coal-fired power for the first time, the national energy body said Tuesday, hailing the milestone. Installation of solar photovoltaic panels on the roofs of the Hongqiao Passenger Rail Terminal in Shanghai, China, in 2010. Photo: Climate Group, via Flickr. China, the world’s largest emitter of greenhouse gases that drive climate change, has pledged to peak carbon emissions by 2030 and achieve carbon neutrality by 2060. “As of the end of July this year, China’s installed solar power capacity reached 1.286 billion kilowatts,” the National Energy Administration (NEA) said. “For the first time, photovoltaic installed capacity surpassed coal-fired power, becoming the largest power source category in China,” it added. The country’s coal-fired power installed capacity, the energy body said, stood at 1.285 billion kilowatts. Solar generation rose 15.5 percent on-year in the first seven months of 2026 to 802.4 billion kilowatt-hours, about one-eighth of the country’s total, the NEA said in another statement. It did not detail in these statements what the total generation of coal-powered energy was for the first seven months of this year. Lamma power station. File photo: Tom Grundy/HKFP. The NEA said China’s installed solar power capacity and power generation “have maintained a steady trend of rapid growth”, with it playing an “increasingly prominent role” in guaranteeing electricity supply and driving the energy transition. Coal has been China’s key power generation source for decades and a key driver of its planet-warming emissions. But the country’s coal-fired power generation fell by nearly two percent in 2025, despite rising energy demand in the world’s largest emitter, data reviewed by AFP showed in February. It marked the first decline in six years, with some analysts saying it was the first time on record that coal generation dropped at the same time as power demand rose. China has seen an explosive growth in its renewable installation, with coal’s share in its energy mix edging down in recent years. The country installed a record 315 gigawatts of solar power and 119 gigawatts of wind power capacity last year — over 80 percent of total newly installed power generation capacity, according to the China Electricity Council.
body.zh: 国家能源机构周二表示，中国太阳能装机容量首次超过燃煤发电，并赞扬这一里程碑。 2010 年，中国上海虹桥客运码头屋顶安装太阳能光伏板。照片：气候组织，来自 Flickr。中国是全球最大的温室气体排放国，导致气候变化，并承诺到2030年实现碳排放峰值，到2060年实现碳中和。国家能源局表示，“截至今年7月底，中国太阳能发电装机容量达到12.86亿千瓦”。报告补充称：“光伏装机容量首次超过煤电，成为中国第一大电源类别。”该能源机构称，中国煤电装机容量为12.85亿千瓦。国家能源局在另一份声明中表示，2026 年前 7 个月太阳能发电量同比增长 15.5%，达到 8024 亿千瓦时，约占全国发电总量的八分之一。该公司在这些声明中没有详细说明今年前七个月的煤电发电总量是多少。南丫岛发电厂。资料照片：Tom Grundy/HKFP。国家能源局表示，中国太阳能发电装机容量和发电量“保持平稳较快增长态势”，在保障电力供应、推动能源转型方面“作用日益凸显”。几十年来，煤炭一直是中国的主要发电来源，也是导致地球变暖的排放的主要驱动因素。但法新社 2 月份查阅的数据显示，尽管全球最大排放国的能源需求不断上升，但该国的燃煤发电量到 2025 年仍下降了近 2%。这标志着六年来的首次下降，一些分析师表示，这是有记录以来首次煤炭发电量在电力需求上升的同时下降。中国的可再生能源装机量呈爆炸性增长，但近年来煤炭在能源结构中的份额逐渐下降。中国电力企业联合会的数据显示，去年中国太阳能发电装机容量达到创纪录的315吉瓦，风电装机容量达到119吉瓦，占新增发电装机容量的80%以上。

reflection.en: The news that China's solar power capacity has now surpassed its coal capacity marks a significant shift in energy production. This development underscores humanity's role in stewarding the planet's resources, reminding us that all the earth and everything in it belongs to the Creator. May this transition inspire further responsible care for creation.
reflection.zh: 中国太阳能发电装机容量现已超过煤电的消息标志着能源生产的一个重要转变。这一发展凸显了人类在管理地球资源方面的作用，提醒我们，地和其中万物都属于造物主。愿这一转变能激励我们进一步负责任地爱护受造界。

verse.textEn: The earth is Yahweh's, and everything in it, the world, and all who live in it.
verse.textZh: 地和其中所充满的，世界和住在其间的，都属雅伟。

title.en: Shein shares slide on fast-fashion retailer’s stock market debut
title.zh: Shein股票上市首日下跌，快时尚零售商估值缩水

summary.en: Shares of the fast-fashion brand Shein fell as much as 10% on their debut on the Hong Kong stock exchange. The company, founded in China and now headquartered in Singapore, was valued at just over $26 billion, a significant drop from its previous valuation of nearly $100 billion.
summary.zh: 快时尚品牌Shein在香港证券交易所上市首日股价下跌高达10%。这家中国创立、现总部设在新加坡的公司，估值略高于260亿美元，远低于其此前近1000亿美元的估值。

body.en: Hong Kong flotation at $26bn by firm once valued at $100bn follows failure to list in US and UK Shares in the fast-fashion brand Shein slumped by as much as 10% as the China-founded company made its long-anticipated trading debut on the Hong Kong stock exchange. The Singapore-headquartered company, once valued at almost $100bn (£74bn), went public on Tuesday pricing shares at HK$48.56, valuing the business at just over $26bn. Continue reading...
body.zh: 曾估值 1000 亿美元的公司在香港发行 260 亿美元，此前该公司未能在美国和英国上市。快时尚品牌 Shein 在香港证券交易所首次上市后，其股价下跌了 10%。这家总部位于新加坡的公司一度估值近 1000 亿美元（740 亿英镑），周二上市，股价为 48.56 港元，业务估值略高于 260 亿美元。继续阅读...

reflection.en: The dramatic drop in Shein's valuation on its Hong Kong stock market debut, from nearly $100 billion to just over $26 billion, serves as a potent reminder of the volatile nature of commerce. Proverbs 16:3 encourages us to commit our endeavors to Yahweh, trusting that He will establish our plans, a wisdom that transcends market highs and lows.
reflection.zh: Shein在香港股市上市首日估值从近1000亿美元暴跌至略高于260亿美元，这有力地提醒我们商业的波动性。箴言16:3鼓励我们将所做的事交托给雅伟，信靠祂必成就我们的计划，这智慧超越了市场的起伏。

verse.textEn: Commit to Yahweh whatever you do, and he will establish your plans.
verse.textZh: 你所做的，要交托雅伟，你所谋的，就必成立。

title.en: The London stock market dodged a bullet with Shein | Nils Pratley
title.zh: 伦敦股市避开了 Shein 这颗“子弹”

summary.en: Shein, the Chinese fast-fashion giant, is set to list in Hong Kong with a reduced valuation after a potential London IPO stalled. Despite intense wooing by UK politicians seeking to revitalize the local market with 'tech adrenalin,' significant concerns regarding Shein's business model and ethical practices led to a...
summary.zh: 中国快时尚巨头 Shein 在伦敦上市计划搁置后，将转往香港上市，但估值有所缩水。尽管英国政界此前为了振兴当地市场而积极拉拢，希望注入“技术兴奋剂”，但由于对其商业模式和伦理实践存在重大疑虑，伦敦金融界对于未能成事反而感到一种解脱。

body.en: China’s fashion giant will list in Hong Kong with a shrunken price tag – and big questions over its business model In a parallel world, we might now be preparing for the arrival on the London stock market of Shein, the giant Chinese-founded fast-fashion retailer. Or it could have happened already. The possibility of a London flotation was a running story during 2024 and into last year as politicians from both main parties engaged in behind-the-scenes wooing. Shein was seen as a shot of tech adrenalin for a listless local listings scene, and an opportunity to advertise the UK’s openness to international capital. Continue reading...
body.zh: 中国时尚巨头将以更低的价格在香港上市——其商业模式面临重大质疑在另一个平行世界中，我们现在可能正在为中国创办的大型快时尚零售商 Shein 登陆伦敦股市做准备。或者它可能已经发生了。从 2024 年到去年，随着两大主要政党的政治家都在幕后拉拢，在伦敦上市的可能性一直是一个热门话题。 Shein 被视为为当地无精打采的上市场景注入一剂科技肾上腺素，也是宣传英国对国际资本开放的机会。继续阅读...

reflection.en: The pursuit of rapid economic growth often tempts leaders to overlook the long-term health and ethical foundations of their institutions. While the 'tech adrenalin' of a massive IPO is attractive, true prudence involves recognizing when a short-term gain carries risks that outweigh the benefits. Yahweh values the wisdom that looks beyond the surface of a...
reflection.zh: 对经济快速增长的追求往往诱使领导者忽视机构的长期健康和伦理基础。虽然大规模 IPO 带来的“技术兴奋剂”极具吸引力，但真正的谨慎在于识别短期利益何时携带了超过收益的风险。雅伟看重那种能看透“缩水的价格标签”表面、审视内在工作诚信的智慧。

verse.textEn: The prudent see danger and take refuge, but the simple keep going and pay the penalty.
verse.textZh: 通达人见祸藏躲；愚蒙人前往受害。

title.en: The Guardian view on the Tiananmen vigil convictions: Hong Kong too has been silenced. Others should speak out | Editorial
title.zh: 《卫报》对天安门维权人士定罪的评论：香港也已被噤声。其他人应发声

summary.en: Two activists who organized commemorations of the bloody crackdown on China’s 1989 pro-democracy protests now face jail. Remembering is not a crime. For decades, Hong Kong mourned when the mainland could not. Its huge annual Tiananmen vigil kept alive the memory of the 1989 pro-reform protests in Beijing, and of the...
summary.zh: 两名组织纪念中国1989年镇压亲民主抗议活动的活动家现在面临牢狱之灾。铭记历史并非犯罪。几十年来，当中国大陆无法哀悼时，香港却在哀悼。香港每年举办的大型天安门纪念活动，让人们记住了1989年北京的改革抗议活动以及镇压它们的屠杀。与澳门一起，香港是中国唯一能够公开纪念这一周年并保存真相的地方。但2019年香港起义遭到镇压...

body.en: Two activists who organised commemorations of the bloody crackdown on China’s 1989 pro-democracy protests now face jail. Remembering is not a crime For decades, Hong Kong mourned when the mainland could not. Its huge annual Tiananmen vigil kept alive the memory of the 1989 pro-reform protests in Beijing, and of the massacre that suppressed them. Along with Macau, it was the only place in China where the anniversary could be publicly marked and the truth preserved. But the crackdown on the 2019 uprising in Hong Kong has crushed the freedoms that the region once enjoyed. That year’s vigil was the last. On Friday, two leaders of the Hong Kong Alliance, which organised the commemoration, were convicted of incitement to subversion under the draconian national security law. Lee Cheuk-yan, 69, and Chow Hang-tung, 41, face up to 10 years in jail. Do you have an opinion on the issues raised in this article? If you would like to submit a response of up to 300 words by email to be considered for publication in our letters section, please click here . Continue reading...
body.zh: 两名组织纪念中国 1989 年民主抗议活动血腥镇压的活动人士现在面临牢狱之灾。铭记不是犯罪 几十年来，香港一直在哀悼，而大陆却无法铭记。一年一度的天安门守夜活动让人们牢牢记住了1989年北京支持改革的抗议活动以及镇压抗议活动的大屠杀。它与澳门一样，是中国唯一可以公开纪念这一周年并保存真相的地方。但2019年香港起义的镇压摧毁了该地区曾经享有的自由。那一年的守夜活动是最后一次。周五，组织这次纪念活动的香港联盟的两名领导人根据严厉的国家安全法被判犯有煽动颠覆罪。 69 岁的李卓人和 41 岁的周恒东将面临最高 10 年的监禁。您对本文提出的问题有什么看法吗？如果您想通过电子邮件提交最多 300 字的回复，以便考虑在我们的信件部分发布，请单击此处。继续阅读...

reflection.en: The conviction of Hong Kong activists for organizing a Tiananmen Square commemoration highlights a profound tension between state authority and the human need to remember truth. When authorities demand silence on historical events, the call to "obey God rather than human beings" becomes a guiding principle for those who feel compelled to bear witness.
reflection.zh: 香港活动家因组织天安门事件纪念活动而被定罪，这凸显了国家权威与人类铭记真相需求的深刻矛盾。当当局要求对历史事件保持沉默时，“顺从神，不顺从人”的呼召就成为那些感到有义务作见证者的指导原则。

verse.textEn: We must obey God rather than human beings!
verse.textZh: 顺从神，不顺从人，是应当的。

title.en: Science & Nature Desk
title.zh: 自然科学

strap.en: Discoveries in nature, climate, health, and the wider cosmos.
strap.zh: 自然、气候、健康与宇宙万象的新发现。

title.en: Global warming will exceed limit, UN says in a report that maps path to get back below danger zone
title.zh: 全球变暖将超标，联合国报告称有办法回到危险区以下

summary.en: In a strategic retreat in the fight against climate change, the United Nations has acknowledged that Earth has lost its chance to prevent some of the worst of global warming's harms. So now the world must figure out how to get temperatures below the danger zone and back to safety, officials say.
summary.zh: 在应对气候变化的斗争中采取战略性撤退，联合国承认地球已失去阻止全球变暖最坏影响的机会。官员们说，现在世界必须想办法将气温降至危险区以下并恢复安全。

body.en:
This article has been reviewed according to Science X's editorial process and policies . Editors have highlighted the following attributes while ensuring the content's credibility:

In a strategic retreat in the fight against climate change, the United Nations has acknowledged that Earth has lost its chance to prevent some of the worst of global warming's harms. So now the world must figure out how to get temperatures below the danger zone and back to safety, officials say.

Earth is soon going to exceed the safe temperature threshold agreed upon by the world in the 2015 Paris climate accord because of warming from the burning of coal, oil and gas, according to a bleak first-of-its-kind report issued by the United Nations Environment Programme Wednesday.

Instead of giving up, scientists and U.N. officials recommend trying to limit excessive warming and then bring the temperature back down to the agreed-upon threshold. But it still will mean decades of increased weather-related disasters, rising seas, extinctions and melting ice and glaciers.

"Humanity is speeding past the limit to avoid climate catastrophe," United Nations Secretary-General António Guterres said.

After a period of over-the-limit warming, the new strategy envisions getting back below the limit by ending fossil fuel use and developing some kind of way to suck industries' carbon dioxide out of the air.

"It's a reality check. We have to live with this warmer world," said report co-author Richard Betts, a climate scientist at the University of Exeter. "But there's still a lot we can do to limit warming."

After the Paris climate accord, the United Nations ordered its climate science arm to study different warming limits. A goal of 1.5 Celsius (2.7 Fahrenheit) above mid-19th century temperatures became generally accepted after the scientists found dramatic impacts that affect people and the planet at 2 degrees Celsius (3.8 degrees Fahrenheit) but not at 1.5 degrees.

The world is now at 1.4 C (2.5 F) above pre-industrial levels, some scientists have calculated. The measure is based on a 20-year average, rather than a single year's temperatures.

Despite experts saying there's no way to limit warming to 1.5 degrees, U.N. officials long maintained the 1.5 window was still open. Wednesday's report finally admitted that the world will cross the 1.5 threshold "in the next few years."

The report said the most optimistic scenario has warming peaking at 1.8 C (3.2 F) around mid-century if countries pursue ambitious climate goals, but that governments' current policies should push temperatures to 2.6 C (4.7 F) above pre-industrial levels by 2100.

body.zh: 本文已根据 Science X 的编辑流程和政策进行审阅。编辑在确保内容可信度的同时强调了以下属性： 在应对气候变化的战略撤退中，联合国承认地球已经失去了防止全球变暖带来的一些最严重危害的机会。官员们表示，因此现在世界必须弄清楚如何使气温低于危险区域并恢复到安全范围。 联合国环境规划署周三发布的首份惨淡报告显示，由于煤炭、石油和天然气燃烧造成的变暖，地球很快将超过 2015 年巴黎气候协议中世界各国商定的安全温度阈值。 科学家和联合国官员建议不要放弃，而是尝试限制过度变暖，然后将温度降至商定的阈值。但这仍然意味着几十年来与天气相关的灾害、海平面上升、物种灭绝以及冰和冰川融化将会增加。 联合国秘书长安东尼奥·古特雷斯表示：“人类正在加速超越避免气候灾难的极限。” 经过一段时间的超限变暖之后，新战略设想通过停止化石燃料的使用并开发某种方法从空气中吸收工业二氧化碳来将温度降至极限以下。 报告合著者、埃克塞特大学气候科学家理查德·贝茨说：“这是一次现实检验。我们必须适应这个变暖的世界。” “但我们仍然可以做很多事情来限制变暖。” 巴黎气候协议签订后，联合国命令其气候科学部门研究不同的变暖限制。科学家们发现，气温升高 2 摄氏度（3.8 华氏度）而不是 1.5 度会对人类和地球产生巨大影响，因此，比 19 世纪中叶升高 1.5 摄氏度（2.7 华氏度）的目标被普遍接受。 一些科学家计算出，目前世界气温比工业化前水平高出 1.4 摄氏度（2.5 华氏度）。该测量基于 20 年平均气温，而不是单一年份的气温。 尽管专家表示没有办法将气温升高限制在 1.5 度以内，但联合国官员长期以来坚称 1.5 度的窗口仍然开放。周三的报告最终承认，世界将在“未来几年内”跨越1.5的门槛。 报告称，如果各国追求雄心勃勃的气候目标，最乐观的情况是气温在本世纪中叶左右达到峰值1.8摄氏度（3.2华氏度），但政府目前的政策应该会在2100年将气温推高至比工业化前水平高2.6摄氏度（4.7华氏度）。 因此，现在联合国表示，它希望政策制定者“为未来做好准备并驾驭未来”，而不是阻止升温 1.5 度，在这个未来中，全球......

reflection.en: The UN's stark assessment that we've passed the point of preventing all climate harm is a sobering reminder of our planet's fragility. Yet, the report also maps a path forward, urging collective action to mitigate further damage. This echoes the ancient truth that the Earth is Yahweh's, and with that ownership comes a profound responsibility for its care.
reflection.zh: 联合国关于我们已错过阻止所有气候损害的严峻评估，提醒我们地球的脆弱性。然而，报告也指明了前进的道路，敦促采取集体行动以减轻进一步的损害。这呼应了一个古老的真理：地和其中所充满的，都属于雅伟，而这种所有权带来了对其负责的深重责任。

verse.textEn: The earth is Yahweh's, and everything in it, the world, and all who live in it.
verse.textZh: 地和其中所充满的，世界和住在其间的，都属雅伟。

title.en: Too much coffee may weaken bones, study finds
title.zh: 研究发现：过量饮用咖啡可能损害骨骼健康

summary.en: A decade-long study following nearly 10,000 women aged 65 and older found that while moderate coffee consumption showed no harm, drinking more than five cups daily was linked to lower bone density. Conversely, tea drinking was associated with slightly higher hip bone density. These findings are significant given the...
summary.zh: 一项为期十年的研究跟踪了近一万名65岁及以上女性，发现适度饮用咖啡似乎没有危害，但每天饮用超过五杯与较低的骨密度有关。相比之下，饮茶与略高的髋骨密度相关。鉴于咖啡和茶的广泛消费以及骨质疏松症这一全球性健康问题，这些发现具有重要意义。

body.en:
Researchers at Flinders University have found new evidence that coffee and tea may have different relationships with bone health in older women.

Published in Nutrients , the study tracked nearly 10,000 women aged 65 and older for 10 years. The researchers examined whether regular coffee and tea consumption was associated with changes in bone mineral density (BMD), an important measure used to assess osteoporosis risk.

Osteoporosis is a major health problem worldwide. It affects roughly one in three women over age 50 and is responsible for millions of fractures each year. Because billions of people drink coffee or tea every day, even small effects on bone health could have broad implications. Previous research on the subject has produced mixed findings, and relatively few studies have followed participants for such a long period.

The Flinders University researchers used data from the Study of Osteoporotic Fractures. They repeatedly assessed participants' beverage habits and measured BMD at both the hip and femoral neck, two areas closely linked to fracture risk.

During the 10-year study period, the women regularly reported how much coffee and tea they drank. Researchers also used advanced imaging methods to monitor changes in their bone density.

The results showed that women who drank tea had slightly higher total hip BMD than those who did not drink tea. The difference was small, but it was statistically significant and could still matter when considered across large populations.

"Even small improvements in bone density can translate into fewer fractures across large groups," says Adjunct Associate Professor Enwu Liu from the College of Medicine and Public Health.

Coffee showed a more complicated pattern. Drinking moderate amounts, about two to three cups per day, was not associated with harm to bone health. However, women who drank more than five cups a day had lower BMD, suggesting that very high coffee consumption could have negative effects.

The relationship also appeared to differ depending on other health and lifestyle factors. Women with higher lifetime alcohol consumption experienced stronger negative effects associated with coffee, while the apparent benefits of tea were more pronounced among women with obesity.

Ryan Liu, co-author on the paper, says that compounds called catechins, abundant in tea, may promote bone formation and slow bone breakdown.

"Coffee's caffeine content, by contrast, has been shown in laboratory studies to interfere with calcium absorption and bone metabolism, though these effects are small and can be offset by adding milk," says Ryan Liu from Flinders University.

Adjunct Associate Professor Enwu Liu adds that the findings suggest that regularly drinking tea could offer a simple way to support bone health...
body.zh: 弗林德斯大学的研究人员发现了新的证据，表明咖啡和茶可能与老年女性的骨骼健康有不同的关系。 该研究发表在《营养》杂志上，对近 10,000 名 65 岁及以上的女性进行了长达 10 年的跟踪调查。研究人员检查了经常饮用咖啡和茶是否与骨矿物质密度（BMD）的变化有关，骨矿物质密度是评估骨质疏松症风险的重要指标。 骨质疏松症是世界范围内的一个主要健康问题。它影响大约三分之一的 50 岁以上女性，每年导致数百万例骨折。由于数十亿人每天喝咖啡或茶，即使对骨骼健康的微小影响也可能产生广泛的影响。之前关于这一主题的研究得出了不同的结果，而且相对较少的研究对参与者进行了如此长时间的跟踪。 弗林德斯大学的研究人员使用了骨质疏松性骨折研究的数据。他们反复评估参与者的饮酒习惯，并测量髋部和股骨颈的骨密度，这两个区域与骨折风险密切相关。 在为期 10 年的研究期间，这些女性定期报告她们喝了多少咖啡和茶。研究人员还使用先进的成像方法来监测骨密度的变化。 结果显示，喝茶的女性髋部总骨密度略高于不喝茶的女性。差异很小，但具有统计显着性，并且在考虑到大量人群时仍然很重要。 医学与公共卫生学院的兼职副教授 Enwu Liu 表示：“即使骨密度的微小改善也可以减少大群体的骨折。” 咖啡呈现出更复杂的模式。适量饮酒（每天约两到三杯）不会对骨骼健康造成损害。然而，每天喝五杯以上的女性的骨密度较低，这表明大量喝咖啡可能会产生负面影响。 这种关系似乎也因其他健康和生活方式因素而异。终生饮酒量较高的女性与咖啡相关的负面影响更强，而茶的明显益处在肥胖女性中更为明显。 该论文的合著者 Ryan Liu 表示，茶叶中富含儿茶素，可能会促进骨骼形成并减缓骨骼分解。 “相比之下，实验室研究表明，咖啡中的咖啡因含量会干扰钙吸收和骨代谢，尽管这些影响很小，可以通过添加牛奶来抵消，”弗林德斯大学的 Ryan Liu 说。 兼职副教授刘恩武补充说，研究结果表明，经常喝茶可以提供一种支持骨骼健康的简单方法......

reflection.en: As researchers uncover how daily habits like coffee consumption might affect our physical well-being, we are reminded of our bodies' fragility. This study on bone density in older women highlights how even common practices can have unintended consequences. Yet, even as we learn more about the risks, we can find comfort in the divine promise to heal the...
reflection.zh: 随着研究人员揭示像饮用咖啡这样的日常习惯如何影响我们的身体健康，我们被提醒身体的脆弱性。这项关于老年女性骨密度的研究表明，即使是常见的做法也可能产生意想不到的后果。然而，即使我们了解了更多风险，我们也可以从神治愈心碎者、恢复力量的应许中找到安慰，鼓励我们以智慧和盼望来照顾我们的身体。

verse.textEn: He heals the brokenhearted and binds up their wounds.
verse.textZh: 他医好伤心的人，裹好他们的伤处。

title.en: Almost half of world’s farmers poisoned by pesticides every year, experts find
title.zh: 专家发现，近一半世界农民每年都遭受农药中毒

summary.en: A study reveals that pesticide poisoning kills 11,000 people annually, with India accounting for nearly 60% of these fatalities. The research, using data from 2006-2023, estimates that 402-433 million cases of unintentional acute pesticide poisoning occur among farmers and farm workers each year globally.
summary.zh: 一项研究显示，每年有11,000人死于农药中毒，其中印度占近60%的死亡人数。该研究使用2006年至2023年的公开数据，估计全球每年发生4.02亿至4.33亿起农民和农业工人的意外急性农药中毒事件。

body.en: Study reveals that pesticide poisoning kills 11,000 people each year, with India accounting for nearly 60% of fatalities Almost half of the world’s farmers are poisoned by pesticides every single year, a study has found. Using publicly available data from 2006-2023, the study, which was commissioned by Pesticide Action Network , found there to be an estimated 402-433m cases of unintentional acute pesticide poisoning of farmers and farm workers every year. Continue reading...
body.zh: 研究显示，农药中毒每年导致 11,000 人死亡，其中印度占死亡人数的近 60%。一项研究发现，全球每年有近一半的农民因农药中毒。这项由农药行动网络委托进行的研究利用 2006 年至 2023 年的公开数据发现，每年估计有 4.02 亿至 4.33 亿农民和农场工人意外急性农药中毒病例。继续阅读...

reflection.en: This study paints a grim picture of the daily reality for millions of farmers, who face severe health risks from the very tools they use to sustain us. The sheer scale of poisoning—hundreds of millions affected each year—demands a response that goes beyond mere statistics. It calls for justice for these essential workers, ensuring their labor does not cost...
reflection.zh: 这项研究描绘了数百万农民的日常现实，他们面临着使用以维持我们生存的工具所带来的严重健康风险。每年有数亿人受到影响的中毒规模，要求我们采取超越统计数字的回应。它呼唤着对这些基本劳动者的公正，确保他们的劳动不会以牺牲健康或生命为代价。

verse.textEn: What does Yahweh require of you? To act justly and to love mercy and to walk humbly with your God.
verse.textZh: 雅伟向你所要的是什么呢？只要你行公义，好怜悯，存谦卑的心，与你的神同行。

title.en: A search for one exotic particle uncovered two strange new structures
title.zh: 寻找一种奇异粒子发现了两种奇怪的新结构

summary.en: A search for one mysterious particle unexpectedly revealed evidence for two different structures that may belong to the bizarre family of exotic subatomic particles known as XYZ states. The findings could help physicists uncover new ways that quarks and gluons combine to create matter.
summary.zh: 一项对一种神秘粒子的搜寻意外地揭示了两种不同结构的证据，它们可能属于被称为XYZ态的奇异亚原子粒子家族。这些发现可能有助于物理学家揭示夸克和胶子结合形成物质的新方式。

body.en:
Physicists have spent decades organizing the growing collection of subatomic particles, yet some discoveries continue to resist easy classification. Researchers at the U.S. Department of Energy's Thomas Jefferson National Accelerator Facility have now identified evidence for two unexpected structures that may help clarify part of this increasingly complicated particle landscape.

The signals could shed light on a puzzling group of objects known as XYZ states. These states do not fit neatly into the conventional picture of particles built from quarks, the fundamental building blocks of matter. For the first time, Jefferson Lab researchers detected two such signals created when a beam of high-energy photons interacted with a proton target.

The findings come from the Gluonic Excitations (GlueX) Collaboration in Experimental Hall D at Jefferson Lab and were recently published in Physical Review Letters . The results could help scientists better understand how one of nature's fundamental forces contributes to the formation of matter.

"We went searching for a confirmed XYZ candidate with a photon beam but instead found two other structures," said Malte Albrecht, a staff scientist at Jefferson Lab. "It's new information."

Beginning in the 1950s, high-energy collision experiments started revealing large numbers of subatomic particles collectively known as hadrons. Hadrons are composite particles containing two or more quarks held together by the strong nuclear force. Familiar examples include protons and neutrons, which each contain three quarks (though they had already been identified decades earlier).

Among the newly discovered hadrons were short-lived particles called mesons. These typically consist of a quark paired with its antimatter counterpart, the antiquark. In 1964, physicists introduced the quark model to organize these bound states. The earliest version contained three quark "flavors": up, down and strange. Up and down quarks, for example, are the ingredients that form protons and neutrons. Up, down and strange are also the three lightest types of quarks.

Particle physics changed dramatically again in 1974 with the discovery of the heavier charm quark. The quark model was eventually expanded to include six flavors. The charm quark discovery helped build the framework that became the Standard Model, the broad theory describing elementary particles and fundamental forces, while also expanding the known spectrum of possible hadronic structures.

As particle accelerators became more powerful and detectors grew increasingly sensitive, researchers gained access to subtler physical processes. After the start of the 21st century, experiments began revealing many hadrons with unusual quantum properties that did not fit comfortably within the...
body.zh: 物理学家花了几十年的时间来组织不断增长的亚原子粒子集合，但一些发现仍然难以简单分类。美国能源部托马斯·杰斐逊国家加速器设施的研究人员现已发现了两种意想不到的结构的证据，这可能有助于澄清这一日益复杂的粒子景观的一部分。 这些信号可以揭示一组令人费解的物体，即 XYZ 态。这些状态并不完全符合由夸克构成的粒子的传统图像，夸克是物质的基本组成部分。杰斐逊实验室的研究人员首次检测到当高能光子束与质子目标相互作用时产生的两个此类信号。 该研究结果来自杰斐逊实验室 D 实验厅的糖激发 (GlueX) 合作，最近发表在《物理评论快报》上。这些结果可以帮助科学家更好地了解自然界的基本力量之一如何促进物质的形成。 杰斐逊实验室的科学家马尔特·阿尔布雷希特 (Malte Albrecht) 表示：“我们用光子束寻找已确认的 XYZ 候选结构，但却发现了另外两个结构。” “这是新信息。” 从 20 世纪 50 年代开始，高能碰撞实验开始揭示出大量统称为强子的亚原子粒子。强子是包含两个或多个通过强核力结合在一起的夸克的复合粒子。熟悉的例子包括质子和中子，它们各自包含三个夸克（尽管它们在几十年前就已经被识别出来）。 新发现的强子中有一种称为介子的短命粒子。它们通常由夸克与其反物质对应物（反夸克）配对组成。 1964年，物理学家引入夸克模型来组织这些束缚态。最早的版本包含三种夸克“风味”：上夸克、下夸克和奇异夸克。例如，上夸克和下夸克是形成质子和中子的成分。上夸克、下夸克和奇异夸克也是最轻的三种夸克。 1974 年，随着更重的粲夸克的发现，粒子物理学再次发生了巨大的变化。夸克模型最终扩展到包括六种风味。粲夸克的发现帮助建立了后来成为标准模型的框架，这是描述基本粒子和基本力的广泛理论，同时也扩展了可能的强子结构的已知谱。 随着粒子加速器变得越来越强大，探测器变得越来越灵敏，研究人员能够了解更微妙的物理过程。进入 21 世纪后，实验开始揭示出许多具有不寻常量子特性的强子，这些特性并不适合......

reflection.en: The universe, from the grandest galaxies to the smallest subatomic particles, is a testament to Yahweh's intricate design. Even when our search for one thing leads to the discovery of another, it reveals more of the Creator's wisdom. This scientific exploration reminds us that creation itself speaks of the profound intelligence behind it all.
reflection.zh: 宇宙从最宏伟的星系到最小的亚原子粒子，都证明了雅伟精妙的设计。即使我们寻找一样东西却发现了另一件，这也揭示了创造者的更多智慧。这次科学探索提醒我们，受造物本身就诉说着其背后深邃的智慧。

verse.textEn: But ask the animals, and they will teach you, or the birds in the sky, and they will tell you; or speak to the earth, and it will teach you, or let the fish in the sea inform you.
verse.textZh: 你且问走兽，走兽必指教你；又问空中的飞鸟，飞鸟必告诉你。或与地说话，地必指教你；海中的鱼也必向你说明。

title.en: Earth may have lost the Sun’s protective shield millions of years ago
title.zh: 地球可能在数百万年前就失去了太阳的保护罩

summary.en: NASA-funded studies suggest Earth’s climate has been influenced by both the Sun’s travels through dense regions of the Milky Way and the violent superflares of its youth. Those events may help explain ancient ice ages as well as how early Earth stayed warm enough for liquid water.
summary.zh: 美国宇航局资助的研究表明，地球的气候受到太阳穿越银河系密集区域以及其早期剧烈超大耀斑的影响。这些事件可能有助于解释古代冰河时代，以及早期地球如何保持足够温暖以支持液态水。

body.en:
The Sun does far more than provide Earth with light and heat. Two recent NASA-funded studies suggest that events from the Sun's distant past may have influenced Earth's climate in unexpected ways, from helping drive ancient temperature shifts to keeping the young planet warm enough for liquid water and possibly life.

One study from NASA's SHIELD (Solar Wind with Hydrogen Ion charge Exchange and Large-Scale Dynamics) center, one of NASA's DRIVE (Diversify, Realize, Integrate, Venture, Educate) Science Centers, examines how the heliosphere moved through the Milky Way over time. The heliosphere is the vast protective bubble produced by the Sun that surrounds the solar system. Researchers found that changes in the galactic environment around this bubble may have affected conditions on Earth.

A separate study led by a NASA scientist explores another ancient puzzle: how a much dimmer young Sun could have kept Earth warm. The findings suggest that powerful solar eruptions may have helped generate strong greenhouse gases in Earth's early atmosphere.

Earth's climate has changed dramatically over tens of millions of years. At various points, major ice ages temporarily lowered global average temperatures by several degrees, while other periods brought repeated swings between warmer and colder conditions.

Scientists have traditionally investigated changes in Earth's orbit, greenhouse gas levels, ice coverage, and other planetary factors to understand these shifts. New research now suggests that changes in the space environment surrounding the Sun may also have played an important role.

The solar system is enclosed within a protective region created by the Sun, somewhat like the way Earth is surrounded by an atmosphere. This region, called the heliosphere, forms as charged particles in the solar wind continuously stream outward from the Sun in every direction.

The entire heliosphere travels around the center of the Milky Way. During the Sun's 4.6-billion-year lifetime, the solar system has moved through many different galactic environments.

In a study published on Aug. 21 in Annual Review of Astronomy and Astrophysics , researchers with NASA's SHIELD center used computer simulations to reconstruct the heliosphere's past trajectory through the galaxy. Their results suggest that some of the regions the solar system encountered may have produced measurable changes on Earth.

Merav Opher, SHIELD's principal investigator at Boston University, and her colleagues simulated encounters between the solar system and extremely cold regions filled with gas and dust. Their work indicates that the Sun passed through such environments at least three times during the past several million years.

body.zh: 太阳的作用远不止为地球提供光和热。美国宇航局最近资助的两项研究表明，太阳遥远过去的事件可能以意想不到的方式影响了地球的气候，从帮助推动远古的温度变化，到让年轻的星球保持足够的温暖，适合液态水和可能的生命存在。 美国宇航局 SHIELD（氢离子电荷交换和大规模动力学太阳风）中心是美国宇航局 DRIVE（多样化、实现、整合、冒险、教育）科学中心之一，该中心的一项研究调查了日光层如何随时间推移穿过银河系。日光层是太阳产生的围绕太阳系的巨大保护气泡。研究人员发现，这个气泡周围银河环境的变化可能影响了地球上的条件。 美国宇航局科学家领导的另一项研究探索了另一个古老的谜题：年轻时亮度低得多的太阳如何使地球保持温暖。研究结果表明，强大的太阳喷发可能有助于在地球早期大气中产生强烈的温室气体。 数千万年来，地球气候发生了巨大变化。在不同时期，主要冰河时期使全球平均气温暂时降低了几度，而其他时期则带来了温暖和寒冷之间的反复波动。 科学家传统上研究地球轨道、温室气体水平、冰覆盖和其他行星因素的变化，以了解这些变化。现在的新研究表明，太阳周围空间环境的变化也可能发挥了重要作用。 太阳系被封闭在太阳创造的保护区内，有点像地球被大气层包围。这个区域被称为日光层，由太阳风中的带电粒子不断从太阳向各个方向向外流动而形成。 整个日光层围绕银河系中心运行。在太阳 46 亿年的生命周期中，太阳系经历了许多不同的银河环境。 在 8 月 21 日发表在《天文学和天体物理学年度评论》上的一项研究中，美国宇航局神盾局中心的研究人员使用计算机模拟来重建日光层过去穿过银河系的轨迹。他们的结果表明，太阳系遇到的一些区域可能已经在地球上产生了可测量的变化。 波士顿大学神盾局首席研究员梅拉夫·奥弗 (Merav Opher) 和她的同事模拟了太阳系与充满气体和尘埃的极冷地区之间的遭遇。他们的工作表明，在过去的几百万年里，太阳至少三次经过这样的环境。 在这些相遇过程中，巨大的星际“冷云”可能会压迫……

title.en: Scientists discover the key ingredients that make birdsong pretty
title.zh: 科学家发现让鸟鸣悦耳的关键要素

summary.en: Researchers have identified the specific acoustic characteristics that contribute to the pleasantness of birdsong. This understanding could inform efforts to improve human experiences in natural and built environments, potentially promoting conservation by highlighting species with appealing songs.
summary.zh: 研究人员已经确定了构成鸟鸣悦耳度的特定声学特征。这种理解有助于改善人类在自然和人造环境中的体验，并可能通过突出具有吸引人歌声的物种来促进保护。

body.en:
This article has been reviewed according to Science X's editorial process and policies . Editors have highlighted the following attributes while ensuring the content's credibility:

What makes birdsong beautiful? Answering this question could help us understand how soundscapes make the natural world relaxing for humans, opening the door to improving parks, upgrading the design of stressful places like waiting rooms and promoting conservation through birds with especially lovely songs.

By asking people to listen to birdsongs and rate them for pleasantness, then cross-referencing this with information about the calls' acoustic characteristics, the scientists identified key aspects that make some birdsongs seem more pleasant than others. But although people who valued birds more rated songs more highly, knowing more about birds didn't influence perceived pleasantness.

"You don't have to be a 'bird person' to find bird sounds beautiful," said lead author Dr. Nadine Kalb of the University of Tübingen, author of the article in Frontiers in Bird Science .

"Being able to recognize birds by their appearance or song did not affect how people rated calls. This suggests that enjoyment of birdsong is connected to something more fundamental than just knowing what you are listening to."

Pleasantness is a subjective measure affected by personal taste. The scientists suspected that some acoustic characteristics, like a high amplitude—perceived as a loud noise—would be associated with a lower pleasantness rating. But they also suspected that some personal characteristics, like individuals' knowledge about birds, would influence pleasantness ratings.

"I have been a birder since I was 10, although at that age I didn't know about ecosystem services or acoustic analyses," said Dr. Christoph Randler of the University of Tübingen, senior author. "I'm very interested in human-bird relationships. Bird sounds are often considered one of the most enjoyable aspects of spending time in nature, and previous research has shown that they can contribute to psychological restoration and well-being . However, not all bird sounds are perceived equally positively."

The scientists recruited 84 people and played them short clips of 123 songs from wild birds commonly found throughout Germany. Participants were then asked to rate each clip on a scale from one to five—the higher, the more pleasant. Participants were also asked questions that measured their birding skills and their perception of birds.

The scientists then analyzed the clips, measuring aspects of each song's amplitude, frequency, complexity—the number and variety of elements in the song—and bandwidth, which captured the range of frequencies a song used. A song with a big difference between its highest and lowest...
body.zh: 本文已根据 Science X 的编辑流程和政策进行审阅。编辑在确保内容可信度的同时强调了以下属性： 是什么让鸟鸣如此美妙？回答这个问题可以帮助我们了解声景如何让自然世界为人类带来放松，为改善公园打开大门，升级候诊室等有压力的地方的设计，并通过鸟类特别可爱的歌声来促进保护。 通过要求人们聆听鸟鸣声并对其愉悦程度进行评分，然后将其与鸟鸣声的声学特征信息进行交叉引用，科学家们确定了使某些鸟鸣声看起来比其他鸟鸣声更令人愉悦的关键方面。但是，尽管更重视鸟类的人对歌曲的评价更高，但更多地了解鸟类并不会影响感知的愉悦感。 “你不必是一个‘鸟人’，也会发现鸟的声音很美，”该文章的主要作者、蒂宾根大学的 Nadine Kalb 博士说，她是《鸟类科学前沿》文章的作者。 “能够通过外观或鸣叫来识别鸟类并不影响人们对鸟鸣声的评价。这表明享受鸟鸣与一些更基本的东西有关，而不仅仅是知道你在听什么。” 愉悦感是一种受个人品味影响的主观衡量标准。科学家们怀疑某些声学特征，例如高振幅（被感知为响亮的噪音）可能与较低的愉悦度等级相关。但他们也怀疑一些个人特征，比如个人对鸟类的了解，会影响愉悦度评级。 “我从 10 岁起就开始观鸟，尽管当时我并不了解生态系统服务或声学分析，”资深作者、图宾根大学的克里斯托夫·兰德勒 (Christoph Randler) 博士说道。 “我对人与鸟的关系非常感兴趣。鸟的声音通常被认为是在大自然中度过的最愉快的方面之一，之前的研究表明，它们有助于心理恢复和幸福感。然而，并非所有鸟的声音都被同样积极地感知。” 科学家招募了 84 个人，并向他们播放了来自德国各地常见的野生鸟类的 123 首歌曲的短片。然后，参与者被要求对每个片段进行从一到五的评分——越高，越令人愉快。参与者还被问到一些问题，以衡量他们的观鸟技能和对鸟类的看法。 然后，科学家们分析了这些剪辑，测量了每首歌曲的振幅、频率、复杂性（歌曲中元素的数量和种类）以及带宽，从而捕获了歌曲使用的频率范围。一首最高音和最低音差别很大的歌……

reflection.en: The intricate beauty of birdsong, now understood through scientific inquiry, reveals the profound wisdom embedded in Yahweh's creation. Observing the natural world, from the smallest chirp to the grandest vista, offers a pathway to deeper understanding and appreciation of the Creator's artistry.
reflection.zh: 鸟鸣的复杂之美，如今通过科学探究得以理解，彰显了雅伟创造物中蕴含的深刻智慧。观察自然世界，从最小的鸣叫到最壮丽的景象，为我们提供了更深入地理解和欣赏创造者艺术性的途径。
