body.en: Hundreds of university staff were stationed at picket lines, calling for stronger protections around the use of AI Follow our Australia news live blog for latest updates Get our breaking news email , free app or daily news podcast The same week union members at the University of Sydney agreed to a 24-hour strike, staff received the results of an internal survey. In the faculty of arts and social sciences, 0% agreed with the statement: “I trust the University of Sydney to act in the best interests of staff, students and the broader community.” Continue reading...
body.zh: 数百名大学工作人员驻扎在纠察线上，呼吁对人工智能的使用采取更强有力的保护。 关注我们的澳大利亚新闻直播博客，了解最新动态 获取我们的突发新闻电子邮件、免费应用程序或每日新闻播客 就在悉尼大学工会成员同意进行 24 小时罢工的同一周，工作人员收到了内部调查结果。在艺术和社会科学学院，0% 的人同意这一说法：“我相信悉尼大学会以教职员工、学生和更广泛社区的最佳利益为出发点。”继续阅读...

reflection.en: When trust erodes and workers feel unheard, collective action like this strike can become a necessary voice. The call for justice, like a mighty river, seeks to reshape systems that no longer serve the common good. May wisdom guide the university's leadership to address these deep concerns with fairness and integrity.
reflection.zh: 当信任破裂，工人们感到不被倾听时，像这样的集体罢工就成为一种必要的发声。对公正的呼求，如同奔腾的江河，旨在重塑不再服务于公共利益的体系。愿智慧引导大学领导层，以公平和诚信来解决这些深切的关切。

verse.textEn: Let justice roll on like a river, righteousness like a never-failing stream!
verse.textZh: 惟愿公平如大水滚滚，使公义如江河滔滔。

title.en: Fake 10 Downing Street listing exposes 'unfit' Booking.com, says consumer group
title.zh: 虚假10号唐宁街房源曝光，消费者团体称Booking.com“不合格”

summary.en: Consumer group Which? reported that it was able to create a fake listing for 10 Downing Street on Booking.com and even leave a review. Despite clear signs of fakery, the listing remained for two months before being removed. Booking.com stated this was a limited test and not representative of their platform.
summary.zh: 消费者团体“Which?”报告称，他们能够在在线旅游巨头Booking.com上创建一个虚假的唐宁街10号房源，甚至留下评论。尽管有明显的虚假迹象，该房源在被移除前仍存在了两个月。Booking.com表示，这是一个有限的测试，不能代表其平台的真实情况。

body.en:
Consumer group Which? says it was able to create a fake listing for 10 Downing Street on travel giant Booking.com.

The UK watchdog said its researchers were able to book a bogus stay at the prime minister's address - as well as leave a fake review noting "hanging out" with resident mouser Larry the cat as a highlight.

It said despite clear signs it was fake, Booking.com did not remove the listing until two months after it was uploaded.

"This limited test is not a true reflection of the experience of millions of listings or reviews published on our platform," a Booking.com spokesperson told the BBC.

They said because Which?'s listing was not "live" on its site across the two months it was present, "some of our automatic fraud controls were not triggered to completely remove the closed listing".

People could only see the listing and request to book the property during a 20-minute window opened by Which? so its researchers could try to book it.

Booking.com's spokesperson added "a range of checks and verification measures" help secure the site, and technologies such as AI "help us detect and remove the majority of fraudulent listings within 24 hours".

But Which? Travel editor Rory Boland said its checks had been shown to be "unfit for purpose".

"If Booking.com's so-called sophisticated AI systems can't spot that 10 Downing Street is not a holiday rental, then it's no wonder scammers can exploit the platform so easily," he said.

"It would be laughable that we were able to list the UK's most famous address for rent, if the consequences weren't so devastating for holidaymakers, who risk losing thousands of pounds to bogus listings and phishing links."

It is not the first time the site has faced criticism over its security efforts and customer service.

Which?'s listing, uploaded to Booking.com on 18 June, advertised a "1 bedroom apartment in the heart of London".

It used images of the iconic 10 Downing Street front door, listed at its address - with a description referring to the one bedroom space as "a prime city centre location".

In the 20 minutes that Which? permitted customers to request a stay at its fake 10 Downing Street property, it said 14 people asked to do so.

Only the booking request from a person known to be a Which? researcher was accepted.

The watchdog's team also sent the researcher a message within Booking.com's system asking them to click an external link to confirm their payment details - something booking sites typically block to prevent customers being scammed.

But Which? said that in this instance, Booking.com did not flag or remove the external link it sent.

Booking.com said it had "visible reminders to not click on links customers are not confident about, and booking confirmations also provide further guidance,...
body.zh: 消费群体是哪个？表示它能够在旅游巨头 Booking.com 上创建唐宁街 10 号的虚假列表。 英国监管机构表示，其研究人员能够在首相住所预订虚假住宿，并留下虚假评论，指出与常驻捕鼠者拉里猫“闲逛”是一个亮点。 该公司表示，尽管有明显迹象表明该信息是假的，但 Booking.com 直到该信息上传两个月后才将其删除。 Booking.com 发言人告诉 BBC：“这项有限的测试并不能真实反映我们平台上发布的数百万条房源或评论的体验。” 他们表示，由于 Which? 的列表在其存在的两个月内并未在其网站上“实时”显示，“我们的一些自动欺诈控制措施没有被触发以完全删除已关闭的列表”。 人们只能在 Which? 打开的 20 分钟窗口内看到房源并请求预订该房产。这样它的研究人员就可以尝试预订它。 Booking.com 发言人补充说，“一系列检查和验证措施”有助于保护网站安全，人工智能等技术“帮助我们在 24 小时内检测并删除大部分欺诈性房源”。 但哪个？旅游编辑罗里·博兰(Rory Boland)表示，其支票已被证明“不适合用途”。 他说：“如果 Booking.com 所谓的复杂人工智能系统无法识别唐宁街 10 号不是度假出租屋，那么诈骗者就能如此轻松地利用该平台也就不足为奇了。” “如果后果对度假者来说不是那么具有破坏性的话，我们能够列出英国最著名的出租地址，那将是可笑的，因为他们冒着因虚假列表和网络钓鱼链接而损失数千英镑的风险。” 这并不是该网站第一次因其安全工作和客户服务而受到批评。 Which? 的房源于 6 月 18 日上传至 Booking.com，广告中标明“位于伦敦市中心的一居室公寓”。 它使用了标志性的唐宁街 10 号前门的图像，并在其地址中列出，并在描述中将一间卧室空间称为“市中心的黄金地段”。 在 20 分钟内哪个？该公司允许顾客要求入住其位于唐宁街 10 号的假酒店，据称有 14 人提出了要求。 仅来自已知身份的人的预订请求？研究员被接受。 监管机构的团队还在 Booking.com 的系统内向研究人员发送了一条消息，要求他们点击外部链接来确认其付款详细信息——预订网站通常会阻止这些信息，以防止客户被诈骗。 但哪个？表示在这种情况下，Booking.com 没有标记或删除其发送的外部链接。 Booking.com表示，它有“明显的提醒，不要点击客户不放心的链接，预订确认信息也提供了进一步的指导，...

reflection.en: This incident with Booking.com raises concerns about accountability and the diligence required in managing online platforms. Micah 6:8 calls us to act justly, love mercy, and walk humbly with our God. It prompts reflection on how businesses, especially those entrusted with facilitating trust, can better embody these principles in their operations.
reflection.zh: Booking.com发生的这一事件，引发了人们对责任以及管理在线平台所需勤勉的担忧。弥迦书6章8节呼吁我们行公义，好怜悯，谦卑地与我们的雅伟同行。这促使我们反思，企业，特别是那些被委托建立信任的企业，如何在运营中更好地体现这些原则。

verse.textEn: What does Yahweh require of you? To act justly and to love mercy and to walk humbly with your God.
verse.textZh: 雅伟向你所要的是什么呢？只要你行公义，好怜悯，存谦卑的心，与你的神同行。

title.en: Will self-flying planes transform the skies?
title.zh: 无人驾驶飞机将改变天空吗？

summary.en: Autonomous crop-spraying aircraft are at the forefront of pilot-free flight technology.
summary.zh: 自动喷洒农作物的飞机在无人驾驶飞行技术方面处于领先地位。

body.en:
Over an alfalfa field in California's San Joaquin Valley, a small crop-spraying plane is flying scarily low to the ground. There's little risk to humans though, as the plane is pilot-free.

"We can actually go lower than a human pilot can," says Russ Marotzke, as the aircraft skims over the crop.

Flying lower means less spray drift and therefore less chemicals are needed than in conventional manned crop-dusting, he says.

The pilotless plane belongs to Pyka, where Marotzke works as a flight test engineer.

Based in a converted Second World War hangar overlooking San Francisco Bay, the start-up makes self-flying aircraft without cockpits, designed either to spray crops or deliver cargo.

It is among a small group of companies racing to bring autonomous fixed-wing aircraft into commercial service.

Flying urban air taxis, so called electric vertical take-off and landing (eVTOL) aircraft, have captured much of the attention around autonomous aviation.

But a quieter race is also under way to deploy self-flying planes, first for jobs like crop spraying and cargo delivery – and eventually, many of their makers hope, carrying passengers too.

"A fully scaled, ubiquitous passenger operation is the holy grail," says Michael Norcia, Pyka's co-founder and CEO, who envisions a large fleet of minibus-capacity Pyka planes ferrying passengers up and down the US east and west coasts.

I've come to one of Pyka's crop-sprayer test sites, about 80km (50 miles) east of the company's factory and reached by a bumpy dirt road.

Today, Marotzke and a colleague are trying out a software update on a demonstration aircraft.

About a dozen Pyka aircraft are already in Brazil where they are used to spray crops such as cotton and soybeans, work previously carried out by human pilots.

The crop-spraying plane is fully electric, with its battery in the nose. It can fly for about 35 minutes and carries up to 300L of spray in a tank in its middle.

Pyka's planes are sometimes called large drones, but it seems an understatement: they all have 11.5m wingspans.

Inside a shipping container beside the field, the engineers highlight on a computer the area they want the aircraft to spray. The software then plans the route, taking account of obstacles such as nearby power lines that have already been mapped.

The take-off, down a runway beside the field, is seamless. About 15 minutes later, after sensing that it is running low on spray – water for today's purposes – the aircraft lands itself for a manual refill and demonstration battery swap. It then takes to the air again to resume spraying precisely where it left off.

Autopilot assists, much like cruise control and lane-keeping functions in a car.

Autonomous systems aim to handle the entire flight, including take-off and landing,...
body.zh: 在加利福尼亚州圣华金河谷的一片苜蓿田上空，一架小型农作物喷洒飞机正以惊人的低空飞行。不过，由于这架飞机是无人驾驶的，因此对人类来说几乎没有风险。 当飞机掠过农作物时，拉斯·马罗茨克 (Russ Marotzke) 说道：“我们实际上可以比人类飞行员飞得更低。” 他说，飞得更低意味着喷雾漂移更少，因此比传统的载人农作物喷粉需要更少的化学品。 这架无人驾驶飞机属于 Pyka，Marotzke 在 Pyka 担任飞行测试工程师。 这家初创公司位于一座俯瞰旧金山湾的二战机库内，经过改建，生产无驾驶舱的自动飞行飞机，旨在喷洒农作物或运送货物。 它是少数几家竞相将自主固定翼飞机投入商业服务的公司之一。 飞行的城市空中出租车，即所谓的电动垂直起降（eVTOL）飞机，吸引了人们对自主航空的广泛关注。 但一场更安静的部署自动驾驶飞机的竞赛也在进行中，首先是用于农作物喷洒和货物运输等工作——最终，许多自动驾驶飞机制造商希望也能运载乘客。 Pyka 联合创始人兼首席执行官迈克尔·诺西亚 (Michael Norcia) 表示：“规模化、无处不在的客运业务是我们的终极目标。”他设想组建一支由小型客车组成的大型 Pyka 飞机机队，在美国东海岸和西海岸之间运送乘客。 我来到了 Pyka 的农作物喷雾机试验场之一，位于该公司工厂以东约 80 公里（50 英里）处，通过一条崎岖不平的土路到达。 今天，马洛茨克和一位同事正在一架演示飞机上尝试软件更新。 大约有十几架 Pyka 飞机已抵达巴西，用于喷洒棉花和大豆等农作物，此前这项工作是由人类飞行员进行的。 这架农作物喷洒飞机是全电动的，电池位于机头。它可以飞行约 35 分钟，中间的水箱可携带多达 300 升的喷雾。 Pyka 的飞机有时被称为大型无人机，但这似乎是轻描淡写的：它们都有 11.5m 翼展。 在场地旁边的一个集装箱内，工程师们在计算机上突出显示他们希望飞机喷洒的区域。然后，该软件会考虑障碍物（例如已绘制在地图上的附近电力线）来规划路线。 沿着球场旁边的跑道起飞，一切顺利。大约 15 分钟后，在感觉到喷雾（用于今天的用途的水）即将耗尽后，飞机自行着陆以进行手动补充和示范电池更换。然后它再次飞向空中，从上次停止的地方继续喷洒。 自动驾驶辅助功能，很像汽车中的巡航控制和车道保持功能。 自主系统旨在处理整个飞行，包括起飞和着陆……

reflection.en: The skies are indeed changing, with technologies like pilot-free crop-spraying planes pushing the boundaries of what's possible. As human knowledge and innovation accelerate, Daniel's prophecy speaks to this era: 'many shall run to and fro, and knowledge shall increase.' This rapid advancement calls for wisdom and discernment, ensuring that our...
reflection.zh: 天空确实在改变，无人驾驶农用飞机等技术正在突破可能性的界限。随着人类知识和创新的加速，但以理的预言恰合这个时代：“必有多人来往奔走，知识就必增长。” 这种快速发展需要智慧和辨别力，以确保我们的技术飞跃能很好地服务于人类和受造界。

verse.textEn: But you, Daniel, roll up and seal the words of the scroll until the time of the end. Many will go here and there to increase knowledge.
verse.textZh: 但以理啊，你要隐藏这话，封闭这书，直到末时。必有多人来往奔跑，知识就必增长。

title.en: Here's our first look—and drive—of the 2027 Range Rover Electric
title.zh: 2027款路虎电动版首次亮相及试驾

summary.en: The 2027 Range Rover Electric promises 333 miles of real-world range, maintaining uncompromised comfort and off-road capability, marking a significant step in Jaguar Land Rover's transition to electrification.
summary.zh: 2027款路虎电动版承诺提供333英里的实际续航里程，并保持了无损的舒适性和越野能力，标志着捷豹路虎向电气化转型的重要一步。

body.en: Jaguar Land Rover provided flights from Washington, DC, to London and accommodation so Ars could visit its factory and drive the Range Rover Electric. Ars does not accept paid editorial content. Jaguar Land Rover was one of the first automakers to announce a transition away from combustion engines. That transition timeline might have slipped somewhat—pesky things like pandemics, supply chains, and revanchism have all been barriers to more rapid electrification—but it's still underway, and today is the debut of the Range Rover Electric, a new battery-electric vehicle variant that sits alongside the internal combustion and plug-in hybrid Range Rovers. Until now, the only way to get a fully electric Range Rover was by going the restomod route. But classic Range Rovers drive like classic cars, with all their inherent faults, and the price tag can be eye-watering . No Range Rover is exactly cheap, but with a starting price of $138,000, the 2027 Range Rover Electric is about half the cost of one of those restomods and benefits from 21st century safety systems like airbags, advanced driver assistance systems, modern crash protection standards, plus the support and warranty of a major OEM. And there's evidently demand: JLR told us that it already has 80,000 hand-raisers—half from North America—70 percent of whom are new to the brand, with 20 percent already owning an EV. (Obviously, only some fraction of those will translate to sales.) The smooth front grille is one of the only ways to spot a Range Rover Electric. Credit: Range Rover Because the idea was to make the Range Rover Electric a Range Rover first and an EV second, it looks virtually identical to the other versions, albeit with a slightly more aerodynamic front grille and more aero-efficient wheels that together conspire to shave off a fraction of the vehicle's drag coefficient. The lack of tailpipes at the back is probably the biggest giveaway that you're looking at the electric one. There's also a flat underbody, but hopefully you'll never need to look at that. Read full article Comments
body.zh: 捷豹路虎提供从华盛顿特区飞往伦敦的航班和住宿，以便 Ars 可以参观其工厂并驾驶路虎揽胜电动车。 Ars 不接受付费编辑内容。捷豹路虎是最早宣布放弃内燃机的汽车制造商之一。这个过渡时间表可能有所推迟——流行病、供应链和复仇主义等令人讨厌的事情都成为了更快电气化的障碍——但它仍在进行中，今天是路虎揽胜电动车的首次亮相，这是一种新的电池电动汽车变体，与内燃和插电式混合动力路虎揽胜并驾齐驱。到目前为止，获得全电动路虎揽胜的唯一方法是采用 Restomod 路线。但经典的路虎揽胜驾驶起来就像经典汽车一样，也有其固有的缺陷，而且价格也可能令人眼花缭乱。没有一款路虎揽胜绝对便宜，但 2027 款路虎揽胜电动车的起价为 138,000 美元，大约是其中一款改装成本的一半，并受益于 21 世纪的安全系统，如安全气囊、先进的驾驶员辅助系统、现代碰撞保护标准，以及主要 OEM 的支持和保修。需求显然存在：捷豹路虎告诉我们，它已经有 80,000 名举手者（一半来自北美），其中 70% 是该品牌的新用户，其中 20% 已经拥有电动汽车。 （显然，其中只有一小部分会转化为销量。）光滑的前格栅是识别路虎揽胜电动车的唯一方式之一。图片来源：路虎揽胜 因为我们的想法是让路虎揽胜电动车首先成为路虎揽胜，然后才是电动汽车，所以它看起来与其他版本几乎相同，尽管它具有稍微更符合空气动力学原理的前格栅和更具空气效率的车轮，这些共同作用共同减少了车辆阻力系数的一小部分。后面没有排气管可能是你看到的电动车的最大特点。还有一个平坦的车身底部，但希望你永远不需要看它。阅读全文 评论

reflection.en: The debut of the Range Rover Electric showcases human ingenuity and dedication to advancing technology. As we witness such innovation, we are reminded to approach all our endeavors, whether in engineering or daily tasks, with the same diligence and commitment, doing them "as unto Yahweh."
reflection.zh: 路虎电动版的推出展示了人类的智慧和在推进技术方面的奉献精神。当我们见证这样的创新时，我们被提醒要以同样的勤奋和承诺来对待我们所有的事业，无论是工程还是日常工作，都要“甘心事奉，好像服事主”。

verse.textEn: Whatever you do, work at it with all your heart, as working for Yahweh, not for human masters.
verse.textZh: 无论做什么，都要从心里做，像是给主做的，不是给人做的。

title.en: Tech Life
title.zh: 科技生活

summary.en: AI's communication is limited to trained languages, with English dominating online content. This raises questions about accessibility for speakers of less-represented languages. The report explores a project working to expand AI's linguistic capabilities and discusses the complexities of tech regulation and technology...
summary.zh: 人工智能的沟通能力仅限于其接受训练的语言，而英语是在线内容中最常用的语言。这引发了人们对母语在网上代表性不足的人群的担忧。本报道探讨了一个旨在扩展人工智能语言能力的项目，并讨论了科技监管以及面向老年人的技术的复杂性。

body.en: English is the most widely-used language online. Internet material helps to train AI tools. So where does that leave people whose native language barely features on the web? We find out about a project helping AI to work in more of the world’s languages. Also this week: regulating tech might sound about as appealing as a trip to the dentist. But, like your check-up, it is important. With Europe and the United States taking different approaches, we’ll ask who gets to set the rules, and what that means for the rest of us. And there’s a growing range of technology aimed at older people. We’ll look at some of the products out there, and ask how useful they really are. Presenter: Shiona McCallum Producer: Tom Quinn (Photo: A young woman holds a smartphone to her mouth while sitting at a table. She is using a smartphone AI voice assistant. Credit: Getty Images)
body.zh: 英语是网上使用最广泛的语言。互联网材料有助于训练人工智能工具。那么，那些母语在网络上几乎没有出现的人会怎样呢？我们发现了一个帮助人工智能以世界上更多语言工作的项目。同样在本周：监管科技可能听起来就像去看牙医一样有吸引力。但是，就像您的检查一样，这很重要。随着欧洲和美国采取不同的方法，我们会问谁来制定规则，以及这对我们其他人意味着什么。针对老年人的技术也越来越多。我们将研究一些产品，并询问它们到底有多有用。主持人：Shiona McCallum 制片人：Tom Quinn（照片：一名年轻女子坐在桌旁，将智能手机放在嘴边。她正在使用智能手机人工智能语音助手。图片来源：Getty Images）

reflection.en: The digital world, like many human endeavors, risks leaving behind those whose voices are not amplified. This project's work to train AI in more languages echoes the call to speak for the voiceless. It reminds us that true progress includes ensuring all people can participate and be understood, not just the dominant few.
reflection.zh: 数字世界，如同许多人类的努力一样，存在着将那些声音不被放大的人们抛诸脑后的风险。这个项目致力于让更多语言的人工智能得以训练，这呼应了为无声者发声的呼召。它提醒我们，真正的进步包括确保所有人都能够参与并被理解，而不仅仅是占主导地位的少数人。

verse.textEn: Speak up for those who cannot speak for themselves, for the rights of all who are destitute. Speak up and judge fairly; defend the rights of the poor and needy.
verse.textZh: 你当为不能自辩的开口，为孤独的伸冤。你当开口按公义判断，为困苦和穷乏的辨屈。

title.en: Research roundup: 7 cool science stories we almost missed
title.zh: 研究集锦：我们差点错过的7个酷科学故事

summary.en: This roundup features intriguing scientific discoveries such as 'black hole stars,' the creation of edible cookies from plastic waste, and the connection between whale calls and Einstein's theory of relativity, among other fascinating findings.
summary.zh: 本期研究集锦包括了引人入胜的科学发现，例如“黑洞星”、利用微生物将塑料转化为可食用饼干，以及鲸鱼叫声与爱因斯坦相对论的联系等。

body.en: It’s a regrettable reality that there is never enough time to cover all the interesting scientific stories we come across. So every month, we highlight a handful of the best stories that nearly slipped through the cracks. August’s list includes the discovery of a new celestial object astronomers have dubbed a "black hole star"; breaking down plastics with microbes and turning them into edible cookies; how whale calls are connected to Einstein's special theory of relativity; and how avocado tree flowers switch sex during the day, among other highlights. Discovery of a "black hole star" Credit: Rohan Naidu (University of Hawai'i) In 2024, astronomers combing through datasets taken by the James Webb Space Telescope noticed hundreds of mysterious little red dots lurking therein, believed to be baby quasars. They existed when the Universe was just a few hundred million years old. One such object in particular captured scientists' interest: a red dot that was extremely red and very bright, but whose properties didn't fit with any known astrophysical object. Astronomers have now concluded that the little red dot is a " black hole star ," so named because it is the size of a large star but produces far more energy than would be possible via nuclear fusion—energy comparable to what an active black hole would produce. Read full article Comments
body.zh: 令人遗憾的现实是，我们永远没有足够的时间来涵盖我们遇到的所有有趣的科学故事。因此，每个月我们都会重点介绍一些差点被遗漏的最佳故事。八月的名单包括发现了一个被天文学家称为“黑洞星”的新天体；用微生物分解塑料并将其变成可食用的饼干；鲸鱼的叫声如何与爱因斯坦的狭义相对论联系起来；以及鳄梨树花如何在白天改变性别等亮点。发现“黑洞星” 图片来源：Rohan Naidu（夏威夷大学） 2024 年，天文学家梳理詹姆斯·韦伯太空望远镜拍摄的数据集，发现其中潜伏着数百个神秘的小红点，据信是婴儿类星体。它们在宇宙诞生时就已经存在了几亿年。其中一个物体特别引起了科学家的兴趣：一个红点，颜色极红且非常明亮，但其特性与任何已知的天体物理物体都不相符。天文学家现已得出结论，这个小红点是一颗“黑洞星”，之所以如此命名，是因为它的大小与一颗大恒星相当，但产生的能量远多于通过核聚变产生的能量——与活跃黑洞产生的能量相当。阅读全文 评论

reflection.en: The universe is a vast library of wonders, from the enigmatic 'black hole stars' to the intricate biological processes of avocado flowers. These discoveries remind us that Yahweh's creation is a source of profound wisdom and awe, inviting us to explore and understand its intricate designs. As Job 12:7-9 says, 'But ask the animals, and they will teach you,...
reflection.zh: 宇宙是一个充满奇迹的浩瀚图书馆，从神秘的“黑洞星”到鳄梨花精密的生物过程，这些发现提醒我们，雅伟的创造是智慧和敬畏的深邃源泉，邀请我们去探索和理解其精妙的设计。 正如约伯记12:7-9所说：“但你且问走兽，它们必指教你；天空飞鸟，也必告诉你；或与地说话，地必指教你；海中鱼类，也必向你说明。这几样谁不知道是雅伟的手所做的呢？”

verse.textEn: But ask the animals, and they will teach you, or the birds in the sky, and they will tell you; or speak to the earth, and it will teach you, or let the fish in the sea inform you.
verse.textZh: 你且问走兽，走兽必指教你；又问空中的飞鸟，飞鸟必告诉你。或与地说话，地必指教你；海中的鱼也必向你说明。

title.en: A newborn and child reportedly died of measles; CDC isn't counting them
title.zh: CDC报告后又删除两个被RFK Jr.质疑的麻疹死亡病例

summary.en: The Centers for Disease Control and Prevention (CDC) has excluded two measles deaths, previously reported by Pennsylvania health officials, from its latest national data update. This action challenges the state's determination of these deaths, a departure from the precedent where states are the final arbiters of such...
summary.zh: 美国疾病控制与预防中心（CDC）在其最新的全国数据更新中，删除了宾夕法尼亚州卫生官员此前报告的两例麻疹死亡病例。此举挑战了该州对这些死亡的判定，打破了由州一级决定病例和死亡认定的先例，据报道，CDC新任主任下令排除这些病例并附带说明。

body.en: The Centers for Disease Control and Prevention is excluding two measles deaths reported by Pennsylvania health officials last week from its latest update of national measles data. The move publicly challenges the accuracy of the state's death determinations in an extraordinary move that breaks precedent that states are the arbiters of case and death determinations, not the CDC. The New York Times reported Monday that the CDC's new director, Erica Schwartz, is behind the decision . Schwartz—less than a month into the job—reportedly ordered CDC staff to add an unusual statement onto the CDC's website for measles surveillance data . The statement notes that the update will not include the deaths reported by Pennsylvania and continues: "At this time, available information does not establish whether measles caused or contributed to the deaths or whether the individuals died from other causes while infected with measles." The Washington Post reported Monday that the CDC had actually changed the information provided on that page multiple times over the weekend. On August 29 at 2:33 pm ET, the website listed the total measles deaths for 2026 as "0" in a chart. On August 30 at 12:09 pm ET, the chart was updated to list the total deaths for 2026 as "2." There was also a note underneath the chart that read: "Health departments make determinations about measles-associated deaths and share relevant information with CDC." By 3:23 pm ET on August 30, the chart was changed again to delete the two deaths, replacing them with an asterisk as a reference to the unusual statement about the deaths not being included. The asterisk and statement remain as of Tuesday. Read full article Comments
body.zh: 美国疾病控制与预防中心在其最新更新的全国麻疹数据中排除了宾夕法尼亚州卫生官员上周报告的两例麻疹死亡病例。此举公开质疑该州死亡判定的准确性，这是一个非同寻常的举动，打破了各州而非疾病预防控制中心才是病例和死亡判定的仲裁者的先例。 《纽约时报》周一报道称，疾病预防控制中心新任主任埃丽卡·施瓦茨是这一决定的幕后推手。据报道，施瓦茨上任不到一个月，就命令疾病预防控制中心工作人员在疾病预防控制中心的麻疹监测数据网站上添加一份不寻常的声明。声明指出，更新将不包括宾夕法尼亚州报告的死亡人数，并继续说道：“目前，现有信息无法确定麻疹是否导致或促成死亡，或者这些人在感染麻疹时是否因其他原因死亡。” 《华盛顿邮报》周一报道称，疾病预防控制中心实际上在周末多次更改了该页面上提供的信息。美国东部时间 8 月 29 日下午 2:33，该网站在图表中将 2026 年麻疹死亡总数列为“0”。美国东部时间 8 月 30 日中午 12:09，图表已更新，将 2026 年的总死亡人数列为“2”。图表下方还有一条注释，上面写着：“卫生部门对与麻疹相关的死亡做出决定，并与疾病预防控制中心分享相关信息。”到 8 月 30 日下午 3:23（美国东部时间），图表再次发生变化，删除了两例死亡病例，并用星号代替，作为对未包括死亡病例的不寻常声明的参考。截至周二，星号和声明仍然有效。阅读全文 评论

reflection.en: In matters of public health and data, accuracy and transparency are paramount. When official bodies like the CDC and state health departments disagree on critical information, such as the cause of death, it erodes public trust. The prophetic call to 'act justly' urges us to seek truth and accountability, ensuring that data serves the public good without...
reflection.zh: 在公共卫生和数据方面，准确性和透明度至关重要。当美国疾病控制与预防中心和州卫生部门等官方机构在死亡原因等关键信息上发生分歧时，会侵蚀公众的信任。先知们呼吁“秉持公义”，敦促我们寻求真相和问责，确保数据服务于公众利益，不受政治干预或不当压力。

verse.textEn: What does Yahweh require of you? To act justly and to love mercy and to walk humbly with your God.
verse.textZh: 雅伟向你所要的是什么呢？只要你行公义，好怜悯，存谦卑的心，与你的神同行。

title.en: New Android Drop adds remembered items in Find Hub, makes anti-nausea dots official
title.zh: 新版安卓更新：查找网络新增记忆物品功能，并正式推出防晕车点

summary.en: New features are rolling out across the Android ecosystem starting today, including AI-powered location logging and the widespread release of Motion Assist dots.
summary.zh: 新功能即日起在整个安卓生态系统中推出，包括人工智能驱动的位置记录功能以及广泛发布的运动辅助点。

body.en: Let's be frank: Some of Google's recent Android feature Drops have been duds, offering little more than an expansion of Gemini summaries and chat functions. The new September Drop does have some Gemini flavor, but there are non-AI goodies, too. Your messaging threads are getting prettier and more useful, and those nifty Motion Assist dots that began appearing last week are rolling out widely. And even the Gemini expansion is not without utility. Since this is an Android Drop rather than a Pixel Drop, these features are coming to a wider range of devices. The OS version does matter, though. If you're on Android 16 or higher, you can now tell Gemini to log the location of items that don't have a tracker tag attached. Just tell the AI where you put something, and include a photo if you like. Remembered items in Find Hub Remembered items in Find Hub This information will be logged in Find Hub, which has thus far been used for locating phones, earbuds, and tracker tags. You can ask Gemini to recall that information or simply check Find Hub yourself the next time you forget where you put that item. Read full article Comments
body.zh: 坦白说：谷歌最近推出的一些 Android 功能 Drops 很糟糕，只不过提供了 Gemini 摘要和聊天功能的扩展。新的九月掉落确实有一些双子座的味道，但也有非人工智能的好东西。您的消息线程变得越来越漂亮和更有用，上周开始出现的那些漂亮的运动辅助点正在广泛推广。甚至双子座扩张也并非没有用处。由于这是 Android Drop 而不是 Pixel Drop，因此这些功能将应用于更广泛的设备。不过，操作系统版本确实很重要。如果您使用的是 Android 16 或更高版本，您现在可以告诉 Gemini 记录未附加跟踪器标签的项目的位置。只需告诉人工智能你把东西放在哪里，如果你愿意的话还可以附上照片。 Find Hub 中记住的项目 Find Hub 中记住的项目 此信息将记录在 Find Hub 中，迄今为止，Find Hub 已用于定位手机、耳塞式耳机和跟踪器标签。您可以要求 Gemini 回忆起该信息，或者在下次您忘记将该物品放在哪里时自己检查“查找中心”。阅读全文 评论

reflection.en: The relentless pace of technological advancement, as seen in this Android update, mirrors the prophecy of knowledge increasing in the latter days. As we integrate more sophisticated tools like AI into our daily lives, may we seek wisdom to use them for good, remembering that true understanding comes from a source beyond mere data.
reflection.zh: 安卓此次更新所展现的技术进步的迅猛步伐，恰似末世知识增长的预言。当我们日益将人工智能等先进工具融入日常生活时，愿我们寻求智慧，善用它们，并铭记真正的理解源于超越数据的源头。

verse.textEn: But you, Daniel, roll up and seal the words of the scroll until the time of the end. Many will go here and there to increase knowledge.
verse.textZh: 但以理啊，你要隐藏这话，封闭这书，直到末时。必有多人来往奔跑，知识就必增长。

title.en: FTC alleges Amazon illegally made $20 billion by rigging billions of ad auctions
title.zh: FTC指控亚马逊通过操纵数十亿次广告拍卖非法获利200亿美元

summary.en: The Federal Trade Commission (FTC) and 22 states have sued Amazon, accusing the company of a seven-year scheme to secretly overcharge advertisers by manipulating ad auction prices on its platform to increase profits.
summary.zh: 美国联邦贸易委员会（FTC）和22个州已起诉亚马逊，指控该公司七年来秘密实施了一项计划，通过操纵其平台上的广告拍卖价格来多收广告商的费用，以增加利润。

body.en: The Federal Trade Commission and 22 states sued Amazon yesterday, alleging that it has conducted a secret scheme to overcharge advertisers for seven years. "Since 2019, Amazon.com, Inc. has secretly and systematically overcharged its approximately 1.2 million advertising customers by manipulating the 'auctions' that it uses to set the price of ads on its platform," the lawsuit said. "Amazon represents, and advertisers believe, that competitive auctions set the prices for advertising on its leading e-commerce website. But, in reality, Amazon overrides and replaces the actual auction results with higher prices set by Amazon to increase its profits." The FTC said it obtained internal documents and messages that reveal how Amazon secretly inflated auction prices for Sponsored Products, Sponsored Brands, and Sponsored Display advertisements that appear alongside results seen by consumers when they search for a product. The FTC investigation began in 2024. Read full article Comments
body.zh: 联邦贸易委员会和 22 个州昨天起诉亚马逊，指控其七年来实施秘密计划，向广告商收取过高费用。诉讼称：“自 2019 年以来，亚马逊公司通过操纵‘拍卖’来设定其平台上的广告价格，秘密、系统地向约 120 万广告客户收取过高费用。” “亚马逊表示，广告商也相信，竞争性拍卖决定了其领先电子商务网站上的广告价格。但实际上，亚马逊以更高的价格取代了实际的拍卖结果，以增加其利润。”联邦贸易委员会表示，它获得的内部文件和信息揭示了亚马逊如何秘密抬高商品推广、品牌推广和展示型推广广告的拍卖价格，这些广告出现在消费者搜索产品时看到的结果旁边。 FTC 调查于 2024 年开始。阅读全文 评论

reflection.en: The FTC's lawsuit against Amazon highlights a deep concern about fairness in business dealings. The accusation that Amazon manipulated ad auctions to replace competitive pricing with self-set higher prices raises questions about integrity and justice in the marketplace. Micah 6:8 calls us to act justly, love mercy, and walk humbly with our God, principles...
reflection.zh: 联邦贸易委员会对亚马逊的诉讼凸显了对商业交易公平性的深切担忧。亚马逊被指控操纵广告拍卖，用自行设定的更高价格取代竞争性定价，这引发了关于市场诚信和公正的问题。弥迦书6:8呼吁我们行公义，好怜悯，谦卑地与我们的雅伟同行，这些原则应指导所有商业往来。

verse.textEn: What does Yahweh require of you? To act justly and to love mercy and to walk humbly with your God.
verse.textZh: 雅伟向你所要的是什么呢？只要你行公义，好怜悯，存谦卑的心，与你的神同行。

title.en: Who is John Ternus, Apple’s new CEO?
title.zh: 约翰·特纳斯是谁，苹果新任CEO？

summary.en: Hardware engineering executive succeeding Tim Cook is a longtime Apple insider, indicating the company will continue a strategy that has led to record profits. Tim Cook stepped down as CEO of Apple on 31 August. John Ternus, a longtime company veteran, succeeded him the next day as the company’s new chief executive....
summary.zh: 接替蒂姆·库克的硬件工程主管是一位长期在苹果公司任职的内部人士，这表明公司将继续其带来创纪录利润的战略。蒂姆·库克于8月31日卸任苹果公司首席执行官。约翰·特纳斯，一位在公司任职多年的老将，于次日接任公司新任首席执行官。库克已转任苹果董事会执行主席。特纳斯是一位硬件工程主管，是苹果公司的一位资深内部人士，他的晋升表明公...

body.en: Hardware engineering executive succeeding Tim Cook is a longtime Apple insider, indicating company will continue strategy that has led to record profits Tim Cook stepped down as CEO of Apple on 31 August. John Ternus, a longtime company veteran, succeeded him the next day as the company’s new chief executive. Cook has transitioned to the role of executive chairman of Apple’s board of directors. Ternus, a hardware engineering executive, is a tenured Apple insider, and his ascension indicates the company will stay the course that has led to record profits under Cook’s leadership. Apple’s yearly profit now tops $100bn, the company is worth about $4.5tn, and it has notched record revenue from its iPhones this year, boosted by renewed demand in China . Continue reading...
body.zh: Hardware engineering executive succeeding Tim Cook is a longtime Apple insider, indicating company will continue strategy that has led to record profits Tim Cook stepped down as CEO of Apple on 31 August.约翰·特努斯 (John Ternus) 是公司的资深人士，第二天接替他成为公司的新任首席执行官。库克已转任苹果董事会执行主席。特努斯是一名硬件工程高管，也是苹果的终身内部人士，他的晋升表明该公司将坚持在库克领导下实现创纪录利润的方针。 Apple’s yearly profit now tops $100bn, the company is worth about $4.5tn, and it has notched record revenue from its iPhones this year, boosted by renewed demand in China .继续阅读...

reflection.en: The transition of leadership at Apple, with John Ternus stepping into the CEO role, signifies continuity and a focus on proven strategies. This dedication to executing well in one's role, whether in engineering or leadership, reflects the biblical call to 'whatever you do, work at it with all your heart, as working for Yahweh, not for human masters.' The...
reflection.zh: 苹果公司领导层的过渡，约翰·特纳斯接任首席执行官一职，标志着公司将继续沿用经过验证的战略。这种在各自岗位上出色执行的奉献精神，无论是工程还是领导岗位，都呼应了圣经的呼召：“无论做什么，都要从心里去做，像是为主做的，不像为人做的。” 该公司持续的成功表明了他们对其技艺的精益求精的承诺。

verse.textEn: Whatever you do, work at it with all your heart, as working for Yahweh, not for human masters.
verse.textZh: 无论做什么，都要从心里做，像是给主做的，不是给人做的。

title.en: Why does everyone hate datacentres?
title.zh: 为什么每个人都讨厌数据中心？

summary.en: AI datacenters are facing widespread unpopularity due to their noise, visual blight, and significant environmental resource consumption. Furthermore, the majority of profits generated by these centers are repatriated to the US companies that construct them. Guardian reporter Hettie O’Brien investigates local...
summary.zh: 人工智能数据中心因其噪音、视觉污染和巨大的环境资源消耗而普遍不受欢迎。此外，这些中心产生的大部分利润都流回了建造它们的美国公司。英国《卫报》记者海蒂·奥布莱恩在伦敦东区实地采访，当地居民正试图抵制一项由政府推动的、占地5200平方米的数据中心项目，以探究公众为何如此憎恨它们。

body.en: AI datacentres are almost universally unpopular . They are loud, unsightly and drain environmental resources, with most of the profits generated flowing back to the US companies that build them – and the statistics against them are piling up. Guardian reporter Hettie O’Brien visits Brick Lane in east London, where people are trying to resist plans for a 5,200-sq metre datacentre being pushed through by the government, to find out why people hate them so much Continue reading...
body.zh: 人工智能数据中心几乎普遍不受欢迎。 They are loud, unsightly and drain environmental resources, with most of the profits generated flowing back to the US companies that build them – and the statistics against them are piling up. Guardian reporter Hettie O’Brien visits Brick Lane in east London, where people are trying to resist plans for a 5,200-sq metre datacentre being pushed through by the government, to find out why people hate them so much Continue reading...

reflection.en: The rapid expansion of AI datacenters, while promising technological advancement, raises significant environmental concerns. This news prompts reflection on our stewardship of the Earth's resources, reminding us that all creation ultimately belongs to the Creator. As we pursue innovation, may we do so with a deep respect for the planet entrusted to us.
reflection.zh: 人工智能数据中心的快速扩张，在带来技术进步的同时，也引发了严重的环境问题。这则新闻促使我们反思对地球资源的管家职分，提醒我们所有受造之物最终都属于造物主。愿我们在追求创新的同时，能深深敬畏那托付给我们的地球。

verse.textEn: The earth is Yahweh's, and everything in it, the world, and all who live in it.
verse.textZh: 地和其中所充满的，世界和住在其间的，都属雅伟。

title.en: ‘Not perfectly aligned’ with human values: Anthropic admits security failures behind AI hacking incidents
title.zh: “与人类价值观不完全一致”：Anthropic承认AI黑客事件背后的安全漏洞

summary.en: The US owner of the Claude chatbot previously said its models had hacked three organizations during testing. The US startup behind the Claude chatbot has admitted a series of hacking incidents involving its models reflected a “failure of operational security” and revealed it has tightened its testing procedures....

title.en: AI could cause global economic downturn, Andrew Bailey warns G20
title.zh: 人工智能可能导致全球经济衰退，安德鲁·贝利警告G20

summary.en: The governor of the Bank of England has warned G20 finance ministers that artificial intelligence could lead to a global economic downturn and pose significant cybersecurity risks to financial systems. Andrew Bailey stated that a collapse in the AI sector could trigger a worldwide market correction, and urged...
summary.zh: 英格兰银行行长警告G20财政部长，人工智能可能导致全球经济衰退并对金融系统构成重大的网络安全风险。安德鲁·贝利表示，人工智能行业的增长崩溃可能引发全球市场调整，并敦促公司为广泛的安全漏洞做好准备。

body.en:
The governor of the Bank of England has warned G20 finance ministers that artificial intelligence could cause a global economic downturn and pose a significant cyber security risk to financial systems.

Andrew Bailey said any collapse of growth in the AI sector could lead to a "future market correction" that spreads worldwide.

In an open letter to finance ministers in the US on Monday, he said companies around the world should prepare for security breaches "involving simultaneous disruption across multiple firms".

Earlier this month, a group of 100 firms , including Google, Microsoft, Anthropic and OpenAI, urged countries and groups to beef up their cyber defences before AI grows powerful enough to override them.

Bailey told the G20 finance ministers that a combination of highly priced stock markets, increased borrowing by investors, and the growing concentration of money into a small number of major technology companies could amplify any future market correction.

"The issue is not simply that investors are borrowing more, but that leverage is interacting with high valuations and market concentration, in particular the increasing cross-investment between artificial intelligence (AI) companies and hyper scalers, in a way that could amplify a future market correction," he said.

Bailey has called on those in charge of financial security to develop "appropriate steps to support safe and responsible model release and deployment on a global basis".

Bailey, who was writing in his capacity as chairman of the Financial Stability Board international watchdog (FSB), expressed concern about the "volatility" prompted by the effect of energy supply shocks caused by the US-Iran war.

His warning comes as the UK government is seeking to grow the country's "sovereign AI" capacity, developing homegrown AI technology to ensure the UK is not dependent on services from abroad.

Ministers want to see companies compete for the funding to help tackle challenges like cutting waiting lists in the NHS and bolstering cybersecurity and defence.

But there is growing concern that AI companies are increasingly developing models that can easily override the safeguarding systems of banks and financial centres.

This summer has seen OpenAI, Anthropic and Meta all reveal their AI tools doing things they should not, with some AI agents going so far as to impersonate real people in order to get past security hurdles.

The FSB which Bailey leads is a global watchdog which monitors finance ministry officials, banks and securities regulators. It includes officials from the US, UK, France, Germany, Canada, Japan, Australia, China and Saudi Arabia.
body.zh: 英国央行行长警告二十国集团财长，人工智能可能导致全球经济衰退，并对金融系统构成重大网络安全风险。 安德鲁·贝利表示，人工智能行业增长的任何崩溃都可能导致全球范围内的“未来市场调整”。 他在周一致美国财政部长的公开信中表示，世界各地的公司应该为“涉及多家公司同时中断”的安全漏洞做好准备。 本月早些时候，包括谷歌、微软、Anthropic 和 OpenAI 在内的 100 家公司敦促各国和组织加强网络防御，以免人工智能强大到足以超越它们。 贝利向二十国集团财长们表示，股市价格高昂、投资者借贷增加以及资金日益集中于少数主要科技公司，这些因素结合在一起可能会放大未来的市场调整。 他表示：“问题不仅仅是投资者借入更多资金，而是杠杆与高估值和市场集中度相互作用，特别是人工智能（AI）公司和超大规模企业之间日益增加的交叉投资，从而可能放大未来的市场调整。” 贝利呼吁负责金融安全的人员制定“适当的措施，支持在全球范围内安全、负责任地发布和部署模型”。 贝利以金融稳定委员会国际监管机构（FSB）主席的身份撰写文章，对美伊战争造成的能源供应冲击所引发的“波动”表示担忧。 几个月前，英国财政大臣约翰·希利宣布设立一项旨在支持英国人工智能初创企业的 1 亿英镑基金。 这是政府增强国家“主权人工智能”能力、开发本土人工智能技术以确保英国不依赖国外服务的努力的一部分。 部长们希望看到企业争夺资金，以帮助应对诸如减少 NHS 等候名单以及加强网络安全和防御等挑战。 英国政府发言人表示，其新成立的人工智能经济研究所正在与国际合作伙伴合作，“就人工智能如何改变世界各地的经济建立更强有力的共识”。 该发言人表示：“该研究所是同类中第一个由政府支持的机构，专注于人工智能的经济影响，帮助政策制定者了解随着技术的快速发展，人工智能对增长、生产力、就业和公共服务意味着什么。” 但人们越来越担心人工智能公司正在越来越多地开发可以轻松超越银行和金融保护系统的模型......

reflection.en: The rapid advancement of artificial intelligence brings both immense promise and potential peril, as highlighted by the Bank of England's warning. Like the testing of character through praise, the development and integration of AI require careful discernment and preparation for unforeseen consequences, lest our ambition outstrip our wisdom. As we navigate...

title.en: Amazon rigged $20bn worth of ad prices, US lawsuit alleges
title.zh: 亚马逊被指控操纵广告定价，面临美国各州和监管机构的诉讼

summary.en: Amazon is facing a lawsuit from the U.S. Federal Trade Commission and 22 states, which alleges the company secretly overcharged over a million advertising customers by manipulating online auction prices since 2019, potentially netting $20 billion. Amazon disputes these claims, stating the FTC misunderstands their ad...
summary.zh: 美国联邦贸易委员会（FTC）和22个州联合对亚马逊提起诉讼，指控该公司自2019年以来通过操纵在线拍卖价格，秘密向超过一百万的广告客户收取过高费用，可能已获利200亿美元。亚马逊对此表示强烈反对，认为FTC误解了其广告市场。

body.en:
Amazon secretly overcharged more than a million advertising customers by manipulating online auctions it uses to set ad prices, according to a lawsuit filed by the US Federal Trade Commission (FTC) and a bipartisan group of 22 states.

According to the lawsuit, filed on Monday, the alleged scheme has likely netted the firm $20bn (£14.8bn) from advertising customers since 2019.

"Amazon overrides and replaces the actual auction results with higher prices set by Amazon to increase its profits," says a complaint filed in the company's home state of Washington.

In a statement to the BBC, Amazon said it "strongly disagrees" with the premise that it misled advertisers and called the suit "misguided."

In addition to advertisers, the FTC, a US consumer watchdog, and the states say Amazon customers have also been harmed as extra costs are passed onto shoppers.

"Consumers are suffering, have suffered, and will continue to suffer substantial injury as a result," the complaint states, prompting swift pushback from Amazon.

"The FTC wants the public to believe this case is about higher prices for consumers. It is not," Amazon said in its statement.

The company's shares fell following the announcement of the lawsuit, closing 2.5% lower on Monday.

Many brands and sellers compete on Amazon to place Sponsored Product ads and Sponsored Brands ads when consumer search for products using keywords on Amazon's e-commerce platform.

The complaint accuses Amazon of secretly charging advertisers more in so-called "second price" auctions, whereby prospective advertisers expect to pay one cent more than the next highest bidder for each bid they win.

But in practice, the complaint alleges, Amazon has charged its Sponsored Products advertisers their own winning bid close to 80% of the time.

The lawsuit states that Amazon's methods were spurred because "it was unhappy about how much revenue its advertising auctions were generating".

Amazon responded by saying the FTC "fundamentally misunderstands how advertisers operate".

"Advertisers adjust bids based on real-world performance, not descriptions of auction mechanics," Amazon said in its statement.

"Average winning bids fell 50% from 2019 to 2025 on Sponsored Products search ads, and roughly 92% of placed ads are not given to the highest bid," the company added.

Last year, it settled a case with the FTC that alleged that it enrolled millions of consumers in its Prime subscription offering without their consent, and knowingly made it difficult for consumers to cancel.

Amazon settled the case for $2.5bn, including civil penalties and consumer refunds.

Sign up for our Tech Decoded newsletter to follow the world's top tech stories and trends. Outside the UK? Sign up here .
body.zh: 美国联邦贸易委员会 (FTC) 和一个由 22 个州组成的两党组织已提起诉讼，指控亚马逊通过操纵用于设定广告价格的在线拍卖，秘密向超过 100 万广告客户收取过高费用。 美国联邦贸易委员会 (FTC) 和各州在周一提起的诉讼中表示，自 2019 年以来，涉嫌的计划可能已使该公司从广告客户中获利 200 亿美元。 在该公司总部华盛顿州提交的一份投诉称，“亚马逊为了增加利润而设定了更高的价格，从而推翻并取代了实际的拍卖结果。” 在给 BBC 的一份声明中，亚马逊“强烈不同意”其误导广告商的前提，并称该诉讼“具有误导性”。 除了广告商之外，美国消费者监管机构联邦贸易委员会和各州表示，由于额外成本转嫁给购物者，亚马逊的客户也受到了伤害。 投诉称：“消费者正在遭受、已经遭受并将继续遭受重大伤害。”这引发了亚马逊的迅速反击。 亚马逊在声明中表示：“联邦贸易委员会希望公众相信此案是为了向消费者收取更高的价格。但事实并非如此。” 诉讼公告公布后，该公司股价下跌，周一收盘下跌 2.5%。 当消费者在亚马逊电子商务平台上使用关键字搜索产品时，许多品牌和卖家都在亚马逊上竞争投放商品推广广告和品牌推广广告。 起诉书指控亚马逊在所谓的“第二价格”拍卖中秘密向广告商收取更高费用，即潜在的广告商希望为他们每次获胜的出价比第二高出价者多支付一美分。 但在实践中，投诉称，近 80% 的情况下，亚马逊都会向其商品推广广告商收取自己的中标费用。 该诉讼称，亚马逊的做法之所以受到刺激，是因为“它对其广告拍卖产生的收入感到不满”。 亚马逊回应称，联邦贸易委员会“从根本上误解了广告商的运作方式”。 亚马逊在声明中表示：“广告商根据现实世界的表现调整出价，而不是根据拍卖机制的描述。” 该公司补充道：“从 2019 年到 2025 年，商品推广搜索广告的平均中标出价下降了 50%，大约 92% 的投放广告没有给出最高出价。” 去年，该公司与美国联邦贸易委员会 (FTC) 达成和解，指控该公司在未经数百万消费者同意的情况下将其纳入其 Prime 订阅服务，并故意让消费者难以取消。 亚马逊以 25 亿美元和解，包括民事罚款和消费者退款。 订阅我们的 Tech Decoded 时事通讯，了解世界顶级科技故事和趋势。在英国以外？在这里注册。

reflection.en: This lawsuit highlights the tension between corporate profit and fair practice. The allegations suggest a deliberate manipulation of pricing, raising questions about accountability and justice in the digital marketplace. Micah 6:8 calls us to act justly, love mercy, and walk humbly with our God, principles that should guide all economic interactions.
reflection.zh: 这项诉讼凸显了企业利润与公平交易之间的紧张关系。这些指控暗示了故意的价格操纵，引发了对数字市场中问责制和公正性的疑问。弥迦书6章8节呼吁我们行公义、好怜悯、存谦卑的心与我们的神同行，这些原则应指导所有经济往来。

verse.textZh: 雅伟向你所要的是什么呢？只要你行公义，好怜悯，存谦卑的心，与你的神同行。

He questions why the UK is so reliant on gas boilers, explaining that their ubiquity stems from a state-owned enterprise that installed them at no...
summary.zh: 《权力与人民：英国能源史》一书的作者亚瑟·唐宁认为，全面而快速的能源转型需要一个共有的体系。他质疑英国为何如此依赖燃气锅炉，并解释说燃气锅炉的普及源于一家国有企业免费为所有家庭安装了适合天然气的电器，从而塑造了国家的能源基础设施。

body.en: Arthur Downing, author of Power and the People: A History of British Energy, says all-encompassing rapid transition will need a mutualised system Have you ever wondered why it is that most houses in the UK are reliant on gas boilers? Not what’s stopping more people from replacing them with heat pumps, but instead why and how the gas boiler became so ubiquitous in the first place? Arthur Downing, the author of the new book Power and the People: A History of British Energy, can tell you exactly why. “We only have boilers in our houses because of a state-owned enterprise that went into everybody’s home and installed natural gas-suitable appliances at no direct cost,” he says. The nationalised gas industry of the 1940s to the 1980s, which oversaw this huge project, was for three decades one of the “most dynamic, innovative, efficient industries in Britain”, Downing says. Yet few of us would use these terms to describe it as such now. Continue reading...
body.zh: 《权力与人民：英国能源史》一书的作者阿瑟·唐宁表示，全方位的快速转型需要一个互惠互利的系统。您是否想过为什么英国大多数房屋都依赖燃气锅炉？不是阻止更多人用热泵取代它们的原因，而是燃气锅炉为什么以及如何变得如此普遍？新书《权力与人民：英国能源史》的作者阿瑟·唐宁（Arthur Downing）可以准确地告诉你原因。 “我们家里只有锅炉，因为一家国有企业进入每个人的家中，免费安装了适合天然气的设备，”他说。唐宁表示，20 世纪 40 年代至 80 年代的国有化天然气行业负责监督这一庞大项目，在过去的三十年里一直是“英国最具活力、创新、高效的行业之一”。然而现在我们很少有人会使用这些术语来描述它。继续阅读...

reflection.en: The installation of gas boilers across Britain, driven by a state-owned enterprise, highlights how past decisions, even those made with public benefit in mind, can shape present realities and future challenges. This prompts reflection on the principles of justice and responsible stewardship in public infrastructure projects. Micah 6:8 calls us to act...
reflection.zh: 英国燃气锅炉的普及，源于一家国有企业的推动，这表明过去的决策，即使是出于公共利益的考虑，也会塑造现实和未来的挑战。这促使我们反思公共基础设施项目中公正和负责任管理的基本原则。弥迦书6:8呼吁我们行公义，好怜悯，谦卑地与我们的神同行，提醒我们即使是大型公共工程也应以这些持久的道德原则为指导。

verse.textEn: What does Yahweh require of you? To act justly and to love mercy and to walk humbly with your God.
verse.textZh: 雅伟向你所要的是什么呢？只要你行公义，好怜悯，存谦卑的心，与你的神同行。

title.en: Almost half of world’s farmers poisoned by pesticides every year, experts find
title.zh: 专家发现：近一半全球农民每年遭受农药中毒

summary.en: A study reveals that nearly half of the world's farmers experience pesticide poisoning annually, resulting in 11,000 deaths each year, with India bearing the brunt of nearly 60% of these fatalities. The research, based on data from 2006-2023, estimates 402-433 million cases of unintentional acute pesticide poisoning...
summary.zh: 一项研究显示，全球近一半的农民每年都会遭受农药中毒，每年导致11,000人死亡，其中印度占近60%的死亡人数。这项基于2006-2023年公开数据进行的研究估计，每年有4.02亿至4.33亿农民和农场工人遭受非故意急性农药中毒。

body.en: Study reveals that pesticide poisoning kills 11,000 people each year, with India accounting for nearly 60% of fatalities Almost half of the world’s farmers are poisoned by pesticides every single year, a study has found. Using publicly available data from 2006-2023, the study, which was commissioned by Pesticide Action Network , found there to be an estimated 402-433m cases of unintentional acute pesticide poisoning of farmers and farm workers every year. Continue reading...
body.zh: 研究显示，农药中毒每年导致 11,000 人死亡，其中印度占死亡人数的近 60%。一项研究发现，全球每年有近一半的农民因农药中毒。这项由农药行动网络委托进行的研究利用 2006 年至 2023 年的公开数据发现，每年估计有 4.02 亿至 4.33 亿农民和农场工人意外急性农药中毒病例。继续阅读...

reflection.en: This study paints a grim picture of the daily reality for millions of farmers, who face severe health risks from the very tools they use to sustain us. Their plight often goes unnoticed, a silent crisis affecting those who feed the world. We are called to lend our voices to their cause, advocating for safer conditions and greater protection for these...
reflection.zh: 这项研究描绘了数百万农民日常现实的严峻景象，他们面临着使用以维持我们生计的工具所带来的严重健康风险。他们的困境常常被忽视，这是一场影响着养活世界的人们的无声危机。我们被呼召为他们的事业发声，倡导更安全的环境和为这些重要的劳动者提供更大的保护。

verse.textEn: Speak up for those who cannot speak for themselves, for the rights of all who are destitute. Speak up and judge fairly; defend the rights of the poor and needy.
verse.textZh: 你当为不能自辩的开口，为孤独的伸冤。你当开口按公义判断，为困苦和穷乏的辨屈。

title.en: Wednesday briefing: ​What’s behind the global backlash against datacentres?
title.zh: 数据中心全球反对浪潮的背后是什么？

summary.en: Communities from Scotland to India are resisting the imposition of datacentres, citing threats to energy supplies and the climate. This resistance has emerged as big tech lobbies for new facilities to support AI development, while campaigners argue these centres deplete resources and worsen the climate crisis.
summary.zh: 从苏格兰到印度，社区都在抵制数据中心的建设，认为它们威胁到能源供应和气候。随着科技巨头游说建设支持人工智能发展的新设施，而活动人士则认为这些中心消耗资源并加剧气候危机，这种抵制情绪日益高涨。

body.en: In today’s newsletter: Communities from Scotland to India are pushing back against datacentres they feel have been forced upon them, warning they threaten energy supplies and the climate Good morning. This summer, datacentres have become targets of resistance across the world. Ever since the arrival of ChatGPT, big tech has been lobbying for the creation of enormous new facilities. Many governments claim they’re essential in any country that wants to cash in on AI. Campaigners argue datacentres drain resources and exacerbate the climate crisis. The Scottish National Party has backed a moratorium on new developments; so has the Greens. The boom has been immense, and so has the backlash. Today’s newsletter explains why. UK politics | Andy Burnham has blamed Brexit and Margaret Thatcher for a decade of low growth in the UK, arguing that Britain needs to be brutally honest about having taken “a series of wrong turns” in the last 40 years. Nepal-Tibet | A week on from the flash flooding disaster, authorities are urging relatives of the thousands of missing and dead to provide blood samples. Middle East | The US has launched new airstrikes on Iranian targets, prompting counter strikes by Tehran targeting American interests in Bahrain, Kuwait, Jordan and Iraq, fuelling concerns about a ⁠wider renewal of hostilities. Ukraine | Russia has opened a deadly new phase in its war against Ukraine by deliberately targeting the country’s railway network, with six employees killed on Tuesday in the latest strikes on Kyiv. US news | Mark Carney has rebuked Donald Trump’s administration and urged officials in Washington to “start being serious” amid escalation trade tensions between the US and Canada. Continue reading...
body.zh: 在今天的时事通讯中：从苏格兰到印度的社区正在抵制他们认为强加给他们的数据中心，警告说它们威胁到能源供应和气候早上好。今年夏天，数据中心已成为世界各地抵制的目标。自从 ChatGPT 出现以来，大型科技公司一直在游说创建巨大的新设施。许多政府声称，它们对于任何想要从人工智能中获利的国家来说都是必不可少的。活动人士认为，数据中心会耗尽资源并加剧气候危机。苏格兰民族党支持暂停新的开发项目；绿党也是如此。繁荣是巨大的，反弹也是如此。今天的时事通讯解释了原因。英国政治 |安迪·伯纳姆 (Andy Burnham) 将英国十年来的低增长归咎于英国脱欧和玛格丽特·撒切尔 (Margaret Thatcher)，他认为英国需要残酷地诚实地面对过去 40 年来“一系列错误的转变”。尼泊尔-西藏|山洪灾害发生一周后，当局敦促数千名失踪者和死者的亲属提供血样。中东 |美国对伊朗目标发动了新的空袭，促使德黑兰针对美国在巴林、科威特、约旦和伊拉克的利益进行反击，加剧了人们对更广泛的敌对行动重新爆发的担忧。乌克兰 |俄罗斯蓄意瞄准乌克兰铁路网，开启了针对乌克兰的致命战争新阶段，周二基辅发生的最新袭击造成六名员工死亡。美国新闻 |马克·卡尼谴责唐纳德·特朗普政府，并敦促华盛顿官员在美国和加拿大之间的贸易紧张局势升级之际“开始认真起来”。继续阅读...

reflection.en: The Genesis account declares creation 'very good.' As communities push back against datacentres, they voice concerns about the impact on energy and climate, echoing a deep-seated human desire to protect the natural world. This resistance calls us to consider our responsibility as stewards of the Earth, ensuring our technological advancements do not harm the...
reflection.zh: 创世记宣告万物“甚好”。当社区抵制数据中心时，他们表达了对能源和气候影响的担忧，这呼应了人类保护自然世界的深切愿望。这种抵制促使我们反思作为地球管家所承担的责任，确保我们的技术进步不会破坏造物的微妙平衡。

verse.textEn: God saw all that he had made, and it was very good.
verse.textZh: 神看着一切所造的都甚好。

title.en: Southeast Asia’s oak trees highly threatened as report warns of lack of protection
title.zh: 东南亚橡树面临高度威胁，报告警告保护不足

summary.en: A recent report indicates that many native oak species in Southeast Asia are under significant stress from human activities and lack adequate protection. Out of 430 oak species globally, 172 are native to Southeast and East Asia. An analysis of 54 threatened or data-deficient species found that 46 experienced high or...
summary.zh: 根据一份最新报告，东南亚许多本地橡树物种正承受着人类活动的巨大压力，并且缺乏足够的保护。在全球430种橡树中，有172种原产于东南亚和东亚。对54种被列为受威胁或数据不足的橡树进行的分析发现，在2024年，有46种橡树在其原生分布区的一半以上区域经历了“非常高”或“高”度的人类压力。

body.en: Many of Southeast Asia’s native oak species are under high stress from human pressures and lack protection, according to a recent report, reports contributor Sean Mowbray for Mongabay. Of the 430 known oak species in the world, 172 are native to Southeast and East Asia. The report, produced by the Morton Arboretum, a nonprofit that studies plants globally, evaluated 54 oak species across Southeast and East Asia listed as threatened or data-deficient by the IUCN. The analysis found that 46 species experienced “very high” or “high” human pressure across more than half of their native ranges in 2024. “While it may not be the region that first comes to mind when we think of oaks, it’s a really important region for oak biodiversity and as a result, oak conservation,” study author Kate Good, a research manager at the Morton Arboretum, told Mongabay in an interview. “Many of these species are under dire threat,” added Good. The researchers found that agricultural expansion, specifically rubber, oil palm, and wood and pulp plantations, were the major threats to two-thirds of the analyzed species. The report identified Vietnam as the center of Southeast Asian oak biodiversity, hosting 33 threatened or data deficient species, 15 of which are found nowhere else. Furthermore, three of Southeast Asia’s four designated oak biodiversity hotspots lie within the Annamite mountain range, which spans Vietnam, Laos and Cambodia, while the fourth is located in Doi Inthanon National Park in Thailand. “Vietnam is an important country for the conservation of Asian…This article was originally published on Mongabay
body.zh: Mongabay 撰稿人肖恩·莫布雷 (Sean Mowbray) 报道称，根据最近的一份报告，许多东南亚本土橡树品种面临着来自人类压力的巨大压力，并且缺乏保护。世界上已知的 430 种橡树品种中，有 172 种原产于东南亚和东亚。这份报告由研究全球植物的非营利组织莫顿植物园 (Morton Arboretum) 制作，评估了东南亚和东亚被 IUCN 列为受威胁或数据不足的 54 种橡树品种。分析发现，2024 年，有 46 个物种在其一半以上的原生栖息地经历了“非常高”或“高”的人类压力。“虽然这可能不是我们想到橡树时首先想到的地区，但它对于橡树的生物多样性和橡树的保护来说确实是一个非常重要的地区，”研究作者、莫顿植物园的研究经理凯特·古德 (Kate Good) 在接受 Mongabay 采访时告诉 Mongabay。 “其中许多物种都面临着严峻的威胁，”古德补充道。研究人员发现，农业扩张，特别是橡胶、油棕、木材和纸浆种植园，是对三分之二的分析物种的主要威胁。该报告将越南确定为东南亚橡树生物多样性的中心，拥有 33 种受威胁或数据缺乏的物种，其中 15 种在其他地方没有发现。此外，东南亚四个指定的橡树生物多样性热点地区中的三个位于横跨越南、老挝和柬埔寨的安南山脉内，第四个位于泰国茵他侬国家公园。 “越南是亚洲保护的重要国家……本文最初发表于 Mongabay

reflection.en: The Earth, in its vastness, teems with life and intricate systems, a testament to Yahweh's profound wisdom. The report on Southeast Asia's threatened oak species reminds us that human activity can disrupt this delicate balance. May we be called to greater stewardship, recognizing the inherent value in every part of creation.
reflection.zh: 大地广袤，生机勃勃，系统精妙，彰显了雅伟深邃的智慧。关于东南亚受威胁橡树物种的报告提醒我们，人类活动会破坏这种微妙的平衡。愿我们被呼召承担更大的管理责任，认识到造物中每一个部分固有的价值。

verse.textEn: How many are your works, Yahweh! In wisdom you made them all; the earth is full of your creatures.
verse.textZh: 雅伟啊，你所造的何其多！都是你用智慧造成的；遍地满了你的丰富。

title.en: Global heating will hit at least 1.8C, UN warns, and there are ‘no good outcomes’
title.zh: 联合国警告：全球变暖至少升至1.8摄氏度，“没有好结果”

summary.en: A UN report indicates that global heating will reach at least 1.8C, exceeding the Paris Agreement's goal of 1.5C, even under the most optimistic scenarios. Scientists suggest a return to 1.5C is possible through drastic emissions cuts and carbon removal, but the report warns that every increment of warming intensifies...
summary.zh: 联合国的一份报告显示，即使在最乐观的情况下，全球变暖也将至少达到1.8摄氏度，超过了《巴黎协定》设定的1.5摄氏度目标。科学家们认为，通过大幅减排和清除大气中的碳，有可能回到1.5摄氏度，但报告警告说，每升高一点温度都会加剧极端天气、冰川融化、生态系统丧失以及海平面上升。

body.en: But scientists say the world could get back to 1.5C through deep, rapid emissions cuts and removing carbon from the atmosphere Global heating will reach at least 1.8C under even the most optimistic future, well beyond the Paris agreement goal of 1.5C, according to a UN report that warns every fraction of temperature rise intensifies destructive extreme weather, glacier melt, ecosystem loss, and island and coastal city submersion. The report by the Nairobi-based UN Environment Programme confirmed overshooting the 1.5C goal inscribed in the landmark Paris agreement of 2015 was now “unavoidable” and, despite some progress in addressing the human-caused climate crisis driven by burning fossil fuels, likely in the next few years. Continue reading...
body.zh: 但科学家表示，通过深度、快速的减排和消除大气中的碳，世界可以回到1.5摄氏度。根据一份联合国报告，即使在最乐观的未来，全球升温也将至少达到1.8摄氏度，远远超出《巴黎协定》1.5摄氏度的目标。该报告警告说，气温的每一次上升都会加剧破坏性的极端天气、冰川融化、生态系统丧失以及岛屿和沿海城市的淹没。总部位于内罗毕的联合国环境规划署的报告证实，超越2015年具有里程碑意义的《巴黎协定》中规定的1.5摄氏度目标现在是“不可避免的”，尽管在解决燃烧化石燃料引发的人为气候危机方面取得了一些进展，但很可能在未来几年内实现这一目标。继续阅读...

reflection.en: The UN report paints a stark picture of our planet's future, warning that even optimistic scenarios will lead to significant warming. This underscores the intricate and delicate balance of the natural world, a creation so full of wonder and wisdom. As we face these challenges, we are reminded of the profound order Yahweh established, which we are called to...
reflection.zh: 联合国报告描绘了我们星球未来的严峻景象，警告即使是最乐观的设想也将导致显著的升温。这突显了自然界错综复杂且脆弱的平衡，一个充满奇迹和智慧的造物。当我们面对这些挑战时，我们被提醒雅伟所设立的深刻秩序，而我们被呼召去管理它。

verse.textEn: How many are your works, Yahweh! In wisdom you made them all; the earth is full of your creatures.
verse.textZh: 雅伟啊，你所造的何其多！都是你用智慧造成的；遍地满了你的丰富。

title.en: Logging operations uncovered at Cambodian senator’s dam in the Cardamoms
title.zh: 柬埔寨参议员大坝在Cardamoms发现伐木作业

summary.en: Logging operations are reportedly underway to clear forests for the reservoir of a hydropower dam in Cambodia's Pursat province, with local residents observing a consistent flow of timber trucks, especially during the dry season.
summary.zh: 据报道，柬埔寨菩萨省的一处水力发电大坝正在进行伐木作业，为水库清理森林。当地居民观察到，尤其是在旱季，木材运输卡车川流不息。

body.en: “They are clearing the forest for the reservoir,” said Phan, a resident of O’Soam commune in Cambodia’s western province of Pursat. “These days, every few days, there is only one timber truck because it is the raining season, but during the dry season, there are three or four timber trucks [per day].” Phan, who spoke to Mongabay by phone, requested that neither his full name nor his village name be published for fear of retribution from the developers of the 70-megawatt (MW) Stung Russei Chrum Kandal hydropower dam, also known as the Middle Russei Chrum River dam. Construction on the dam, which spans the Russei Chrum River in neighboring Koh Kong province, began in 2023 inside Phnom Kravanh National Park, one of Cambodia’s largest protected rainforests. The dam is one of many being built in the Cardamoms as Cambodia pushes for “clean” energy security, but recent satellite imagery indicates that large-scale logging is happening beyond the authorized construction sites. This map shows where the two dams are being built inside Cambodia’s protected Kravanh National Park. Image by Emilie Languedoc/Mongabay. Access to the site, Phan added, has been restricted and checkpoints are closely guarded by armed men in Royal Cambodian Armed Forces (RCAF) uniforms. “We used to enter for fishing and laying fishing equipment, yet we are not allowed to enter anymore,” he said. “They have checkpoints, they have troops — they say the troops came to protect the forests. But the company set them up as security guards; we cannot…This article was originally published on Mongabay
body.zh: “他们正在为水库清理森林，”柬埔寨西部菩萨省奥索姆公社的居民潘说。 “现在，每隔几天就会有一辆木材卡车，因为现在是雨季，但在旱季，[每天]就会有三四辆木材卡车。”潘通过电话与 Mongabay 交谈，要求不要公开他的全名和村庄名称，因为担心 70 兆瓦 (MW) Stung Russei Chrum Kandal 水电站大坝（也称为中 Russei Chrum 河大坝）开发商的报复。该大坝横跨邻国戈公省的 Russei Chrum 河，于 2023 年开始在柬埔寨最大的受保护热带雨林之一的金边国家公园内施工。该水坝是柬埔寨推动“清洁”能源安全而在小豆蔻地区修建的众多大坝之一，但最近的卫星图像显示，大规模伐木活动正在超出授权的施工地点进行。这张地图显示了柬埔寨受保护的克拉万国家公园内正在修建的两座水坝的位置。图片来源：Emilie Languedoc/Mongabay。潘补充说，进入该地点已受到限制，检查站由身穿柬埔寨皇家武装部队（RCAF）制服的武装人员严密把守。他说：“我们曾经进去捕鱼和放置捕鱼设备，但现在不被允许进入了。” “他们有检查站，有军队——他们说军队是来保护森林的。但公司把他们设置为保安；我们不能……这篇文章最初发表在 Mongabay

reflection.en: The news from Cambodia speaks of forests being cleared for a dam's reservoir. This raises questions about how we steward the earth and treat its resources. Micah 6:8 calls us to act justly, love mercy, and walk humbly with our God, principles that should guide our development and resource management.
reflection.zh: 来自柬埔寨的消息称，为了修建水库而砍伐森林。这引发了我们如何管理地球及其资源的问题。《弥迦书》6章8节呼吁我们行公义、好怜悯、存谦卑的心与我们的雅伟同行，这些原则应当指导我们的发展和资源管理。

verse.textEn: What does Yahweh require of you? To act justly and to love mercy and to walk humbly with your God.
verse.textZh: 雅伟向你所要的是什么呢？只要你行公义，好怜悯，存谦卑的心，与你的神同行。

title.en: Togo cosponsors proposal to review commercial whaling ban
title.zh: 多哥国提议审查商业捕鲸禁令，引发环保组织批评

summary.en: Togo is co-sponsoring a proposal to review commercial whaling quotas, drawing criticism from whale conservation groups. The draft resolution was submitted for discussion at the upcoming 70th meeting of the International Whaling Commission (IWC). Togo was the only African nation to support the proposal, which was...

body.en: Togo is cosponsoring a proposal to review commercial whaling quotas, drawing criticism from whale conservation groups. The draft resolution was submitted for discussion at the upcoming 70th meeting of the International Whaling Commission (IWC), which will be held Sept. 27 to Oct. 2. Togo was the only African nation to support the proposal, which was spearheaded by the Caribbean island nation Antigua and Barbuda. Neither of these countries conduct commercial whaling themselves. In response, the West and Central African Coalition for Whales which facilitates dialogue about whaling among African nations, issued a public statement calling on governments to remove support initiatives that weaken international whale protections or revive commercial whaling. The resolution “is hard to reconcile with West and Central African priorities, where no country conducts commercial whaling and where the urgent issues are bycatch, habitat degradation and the protection of marine ecosystems,” Colonel Abba Sonko, a Senegalese wildlife conservation expert and representative of Senegal’s CITES Management Authority, told Mongabay via email. In 1986, the IWC global moratorium on the exploitation of whales went into effect and set catch limits for all whales to zero. However, a few countries, including Japan, Norway and Iceland, continue whaling. Togo’s support of the recent proposal is not the first time an African nation has backed a review of whaling. Countries such as Senegal, Guinea and Côte d’Ivoire have endorsed similar proposals before and played a key role in blocking the creation of a South Atlantic Whale Sanctuary between Latin America and Africa, which…This article was originally published on Mongabay
body.zh: 多哥正在共同提出一项审查商业捕鲸配额的提案，此举引起了鲸鱼保护组织的批评。该决议草案已提交即将于9月27日至10月2日举行的国际捕鲸委员会（IWC）第70次会议上讨论。多哥是唯一支持该提案的非洲国家，该提案由加勒比岛国安提瓜和巴布达带头。这两个国家本身都不进行商业捕鲸。作为回应，促进非洲国家之间捕鲸问题对话的西非和中非鲸鱼联盟发表了一份公开声明，呼吁各国政府取消削弱国际鲸鱼保护或恢复商业捕鲸的支持举措。该决议“很难与西非和中非的优先事项相协调，那里没有国家进行商业捕鲸，紧迫的问题是兼捕、栖息地退化和海洋生态系统的保护，”塞内加尔野生动物保护专家、塞内加尔濒危野生动植物种国际贸易公约管理局代表阿巴·松科上校通过电子邮件告诉Mongabay。 1986年，IWC全球暂停鲸鱼捕捞禁令生效，并将所有鲸鱼的捕捞限额降至零。然而，包括日本、挪威和冰岛在内的一些国家仍在继续捕鲸。多哥对最近提案的支持并不是非洲国家第一次支持对捕鲸活动进行审查。塞内加尔、几内亚和科特迪瓦等国此前曾支持过类似的提议，并在阻止拉丁美洲和非洲之间建立南大西洋鲸鱼保护区方面发挥了关键作用，这……本文最初发表于 Mongabay

reflection.en: The proposal to review whaling quotas, spearheaded by nations that do not whale commercially, raises concerns for the future of whale populations. Conservation groups are voicing their opposition, acting as advocates for these magnificent creatures. Proverbs 31:8-9 reminds us to "Speak up for those who cannot speak for themselves, for all their rights."...
reflection.zh: 审查捕鲸配额的提案，由不进行商业捕鲸的国家牵头提出，引发了对鲸类种群未来的担忧。保护组织正在为这些壮丽的生物发声，充当它们的倡导者。《箴言》31:8-9提醒我们：“要为不能说话的开口，为所有孤苦者争讼。”当弱势群体，无论是人类还是动物，面临政策决策可能带来的伤害时，这种倡导的呼吁至关重要。

verse.textEn: Speak up for those who cannot speak for themselves, for the rights of all who are destitute. Speak up and judge fairly; defend the rights of the poor and needy.
verse.textZh: 你当为不能自辩的开口，为孤独的伸冤。你当开口按公义判断，为困苦和穷乏的辨屈。

title.en: Rooting tree seed production in local knowledge boosts forest restoration outcomes (commentary)
title.zh: 将树木种子生产扎根于当地知识可提高森林恢复成果（评论）

summary.en: Since the launch of global restoration initiatives such as the U.N. Decade on Ecosystem Restoration (2021-2030), large-scale tree planting has become the hallmark of many restoration projects. Ambitious targets, such as The Nature Conservancy’s Plant a Billion Trees campaign and the World Economic Forum’s One Trillion...
summary.zh: 自联合国生态系统恢复十年（2021-2030年）等全球恢复倡议启动以来，大规模植树造林已成为许多恢复项目的标志。诸如大自然保护协会的“种植十亿棵树”活动和世界经济论坛的“万亿棵树倡议”等宏伟目标，凸显了基于树木的恢复在实现减缓气候变化、保护生物多样性和促进社会福祉这三重目标方面的潜力。然而，对植树数量的这种迷恋常常掩盖...

body.en: Since the launch of global restoration initiatives such as the U.N. Decade on Ecosystem Restoration (2021-2030), large-scale tree planting has become the hallmark of many restoration projects. Ambitious targets, such as The Nature Conservancy’s Plant a Billion Trees campaign and the World Economic Forum’s One Trillion Tree Initiative, highlight the potential of tree-based restoration in achieving the triple goals of climate change mitigation, biodiversity conservation, and social well-being. However, this fascination with the number of trees planted often obscures the more complex challenges of ensuring tree survival, resilience, and adaptation in the face of climate change. Addressing these challenges requires not only technical expertise but also place-based knowledge that communities living within and around these forests have accumulated over generations. In the tropical forests of Southeast Asia, forest restoration does not occur in a vacuum: Indigenous peoples and local communities (IPLCs) are dependent on forests for their livelihoods and subsistence. Their familiarity with the local species, landscapes, and ecological rhythms makes them indispensable partners in restoration efforts. Engaging IPLCs is especially important when it comes to the delicate process of collecting, storing, and caring for plant propagules and seedlings (hereafter referred to as seed), which can contribute to higher survival rates and more resilient forest stands over time. This commentary examines how integrating IPLC knowledge into the upstream process of seed propagation can strengthen forest restoration outcomes in Southeast Asia, and what enabling conditions are needed to support their meaningful participation. Natural forest in Indonesia. Image by Rhett A. Butler/Mongabay.…This article was originally published on Mongabay
body.zh: 自联合国生态系统恢复十年（2021-2030）等全球恢复倡议启动以来，大规模植树造林已成为许多恢复项目的标志。大自然保护协会的种植十亿棵树运动和世界经济论坛的一万亿棵树计划等雄心勃勃的目标强调了基于树木的恢复在实现​​减缓气候变化、保护生物多样性和社会福祉三重目标方面的潜力。然而，这种对种植树木数量的迷恋往往掩盖了在气候变化面前确保树木生存、恢复力和适应的更复杂的挑战。应对这些挑战不仅需要技术专业知识，还需要生活在这些森林内部和周围的社区几代人积累的基于地方的知识。在东南亚的热带森林中，森林恢复并不是凭空发生的：土著人民和当地社区 (IPLC) 的生计和生存依赖于森林。他们对当地物种、景观和生态节奏的熟悉使他们成为恢复工作中不可或缺的合作伙伴。在收集、储存和照料植物繁殖体和幼苗（以下简称种子）的精细过程中，IPLC 的参与尤其重要，随着时间的推移，这有助于提高成活率和增强森林恢复能力。本评论探讨了如何将 IPLC 知识整合到种子繁殖的上游过程中，以加强东南亚的森林恢复成果，以及需要哪些有利条件来支持他们有意义的参与。印度尼西亚的天然森林。图片来源：Rhett A. Butler/Mongabay。…本文最初发表于 Mongabay

reflection.en: The ambition to restore ecosystems through massive tree planting is commendable, aiming for climate mitigation and biodiversity. Yet, as this commentary notes, the sheer number of trees can overshadow the critical need for their long-term survival and adaptation. This reminds us that Yahweh declared all of creation 'very good,' implying a call for...
reflection.zh: 通过大规模植树来恢复生态系统的雄心值得称赞，旨在实现气候减缓和生物多样性。然而，正如这篇评论指出的那样，树木的数量可能掩盖了它们长期生存和适应的关键需求。这提醒我们，雅伟宣告万物“甚好”，这暗示着需要审慎、有韧性的管理，而不仅仅是数量上的追求。

verse.textEn: God saw all that he had made, and it was very good.
verse.textZh: 神看着一切所造的都甚好。

title.en: Christiana Figueres & Garik Israelian on Jane Goodall’s legacy and the search for truth
title.zh: 克里斯蒂安娜·菲格雷斯和加里克·伊斯拉埃利安谈简·古道尔的遗产和对真相的追寻

summary.en: A new award, the Jane Goodall Earth Medal, has been established by the Starmus Festival board to honor conservationist Jane Goodall. Christiana Figueres, former executive secretary of the UN Framework Convention on Climate Change, is the inaugural recipient. Figueres will discuss the medal's significance, science...
summary.zh: 为纪念已故的保护主义偶像简·古道尔，星际艺术节理事会设立了新的简·古道尔地球奖。联合国气候变化框架公约前执行秘书克里斯蒂安娜·菲格雷斯是首位获奖者。菲格雷斯将讨论该奖项的意义、科学传播和真相。

body.en: A new award has been created in honor of late conservation icon Jane Goodall by the board of the Starmus Festival, an international gathering of scientists and artists to be held from Oct. 17-22 in Tenerife, Spain. Christiana Figueres has been selected as the recipient of this inaugural Jane Goodall Earth Medal. Figueres is the former executive secretary of the United Nations Framework Convention on Climate Change and is known for her work in securing the negotiations leading to the Paris climate agreement. She joins the podcast this week to discuss the significance of this medal and her thoughts on the future of science communication and truth — both of which are focal points of the upcoming festival. “What an absolute giant [Goodall] was to her very last day,” says Figueres. “The fact that a medal has been made in her honor, and that I will debut that is just an unbelievable honor.” Astrophysicist and co-founder of the Starmus Festival, Garik Israelian, also joins the podcast to discuss the festival theme, “The Search for Truth.” He credits the idea for the medal to his advisory board, which includes Starmus co-founder Brian May, also an astrophysicist but better known as the guitarist for the rock band Queen, and fellow musician Peter Gabriel. “Brian was very active in protecting animals, and he had a foundation called Save Me. And another member of our advisory board, Peter Gabriel, was also very active in human rights, and also he knew Jane Goodall very well,”…This article was originally published on Mongabay
body.zh: Starmus Festival 董事会为纪念已故自然保护偶像珍·古道尔 (Jane Goodall) 设立了一个新奖项，Starmus Festival 是一项科学家和艺术家的国际盛会，将于 10 月 17 日至 22 日在西班牙特内里费岛举行。克里斯蒂娜·菲格雷斯被选为首届珍·古道尔地球奖章的获得者。菲格雷斯是《联合国气候变化框架公约》的前执行秘书，因其在确保巴黎气候协议谈判方面的工作而闻名。她本周加入播客，讨论这枚奖章的意义以及她对科学传播和真理的未来的想法——这两点都是即将到来的节日的焦点。 “在她的最后一天，[古道尔]绝对是一个巨人，”菲格雷斯说。 “事实上，为她颁发了一枚奖牌，而我将首次亮相，这真是令人难以置信的荣誉。”天体物理学家兼 Starmus 音乐节联合创始人加里克·以色列 (Garik Israelian) 也加入播客讨论音乐节主题“寻找真理”。他将奖章的想法归功于他的顾问委员会，其中包括 Starmus 联合创始人布莱恩·梅（Brian May）和音乐家彼得·加布里埃尔（Peter Gabriel）。布莱恩·梅也是一位天体物理学家，但更出名的是摇滚乐队 Queen 的吉他手。 “布莱恩非常积极地保护动物，他有一个名为“拯救我”的基金会。我们顾问委员会的另一位成员彼得·加布里埃尔也非常积极地致力于人权，而且他也非常了解珍·古道尔，”……这篇文章最初发表在 Mongabay

reflection.en: The establishment of the Jane Goodall Earth Medal celebrates a life dedicated to understanding and protecting the natural world. It reminds us that all of creation, from the smallest organism to the vastest ecosystems, is a testament to the Creator's wisdom and power. As Psalm 24:1 declares, 'The earth is Yahweh’s, and everything in it.'
reflection.zh: 为纪念简·古道尔而设立的地球奖，颂扬了致力于理解和保护自然世界的一生。它提醒我们，从最小的生物到最广阔的生态系统，一切受造之物都是造物主智慧和能力的明证。正如诗篇24:1所宣告的：“地和其中所充满的，世界和居住在其中的，都属于雅伟。”

verse.textEn: The earth is Yahweh's, and everything in it, the world, and all who live in it.
verse.textZh: 地和其中所充满的，世界和住在其间的，都属雅伟。

This human ingenuity, seeking to understand and coexist with the ocean's inhabitants, echoes the Psalmist's awe at the vastness and intricate design of the natural world. The wisdom displayed in creation, from the smallest creature to...
